title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI. Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème. Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré. L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet. État de l’art Les problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3] De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5] Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques : demande hétérogène, capacité limitée des professionnels, accessibilité spatiale, distances maximales, concurrence entre sites et incertitude sur l’offre médicale. Une réflexion sur la définition et la mesure de l’accessibilité permettra de proposer une modélisation plus fine des interactions entre la localisation de l’offre de soins, les distances et les besoins des populations. Le problème étudié dans le cadre de ce stage se situe ainsi à l’intersection des problèmes de localisation, des problèmes d’accessibilité spatiale et des problèmes d’organisation territoriale des soins. Une seconde dimension concerne le lien avec les problèmes de districting et de territory design [6], [7]. Alors que ces derniers cherchent principalement à construire des territoires cohérents sous différentes contraintes géographiques et démographiques, le couplage avec un problème de localisation permet d'introduire explicitement la question de l'organisation de l'offre de soins au sein de ces territoires. Ce couplage constitue une étape importante vers le développement d'un modèle de maillage territorial adapté aux spécificités des zones rurales. Profil recherché Nous cherchons un.e candidat.e en M2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, spécialisé.e en Recherche Opérationnelle, Optimisation Combinatoire, Informatique ou domaine connexe. Compétences attendues : Formalisation de problèmes complexes (PL, PLNE) Compétences solides en algorithmique et programmation (de préférence Python) Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais pour la documentation et la communication des résultats Modalités Date de début : à partir de février 2027 (flexible) Durée : 5-6 mois Laboratoire : Centre Génie Industriel, IMT Mines Albi. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results. Who You Are We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a demonstrated ability to lead and grow distributed teams of strong engineers working remotely around the world. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership. Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change. Responsibilities Lead and empower several teams, working closely with their team leads, to deliver outcomes that matter to our users and the business, from long-term planning through to execution Spot early risks to releases, team performance, or the business, and plan how to address them Stay close to the technical work through design discussions, investigations, reviews, and guidance Communicate clearly and early with other teams, departments, and stakeholders to meet release deadlines and business objectives Cultivate a supportive team environment that encourages transparency and collaboration; support the personal and professional growth of everyone on your teams Make the most of AI tools in your own work, and support your teams as they find new ways to build with AI Minimum qualifications 5+ years in a technical leadership role (3+ years in an Engineering Manager role) Have managed more than one engineering team, working alongside team leads The technical depth to serve as a partner to your engineers; you can challenge technical direction and identify risks early Experience with a JVM-based product Proven track record of leading complex initiatives that ship customer-facing products Strong product and business mindset, coupled with a get-things-done attitude Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills Experience in leading and growing software teams and engineers Excellent collaboration and communication skills A genuine interest in how AI is changing software development, and hands-on experience using AI tools in your own work Preferred qualifications Expertise in developer tooling, developer experience, or developer productivity Experience managing remote, distributed teams Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up Experience with AI-powered developer products, such as agents or MCP servers What We Offer Work on a widely used product with a clear vision for the future Contribute to how software teams build and ship in the age of AI agents Close interactions with customers from leading tech organizations Close collaboration with experienced and dedicated peers and engineers Room to grow your leadership scope In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings Work from home in a remote-first environment Competitive salaries and equity grants Location Remote, Europe-friendly timezone, with working conditions allowing seamless collaboration with your colleagues through email, chat, and video calls Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Entrepreneur in Residence | Working Student (m/w/d)
description: Who Are We ? 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO. At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital. Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow. We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 💼 About This Role As an Entrepreneur in Residence Working Student at CONROO, you will turn ideas into business opportunities and help shape the future of our company. Working closely with our founding team and Sales team, you will explore untapped markets, build new business areas from the ground up, and translate strategic ideas into actionable solutions. 🎖️What Success Looks Like In your first month You will collaborate closely with the founding team to explore new business opportunities and strategic initiatives. You will conduct in-depth analyses and prepare decision-making frameworks for the founding team. By 3 months You will identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities and untapped market potential. You will develop innovative strategies and actionable proposals to improve our operations and expand our market presence. You will oversee and optimize the execution of marketing campaigns, track performance metrics, and ensure alignment with business goals. By 6 months You will collaborate with the founding team to develop and launch new business areas from the ground up. You will support cross-departmental initiatives that contribute to the company's growth. You will continuously explore emerging trends and technologies to keep our offerings at the forefront of the logistics and IT sectors. 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Information Technology, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or a related field You have relevant professional experience in entrepreneurship, business development, strategy, or project management. You have excellent written and spoken skills in English. You have strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You take ownership of your work, and are motivated to take on responsibility and make a meaningful impact. You continuously look for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of your work. You bring a hands-on mindset, with a 'never-stop-learning' attitude and a desire to grow alongside the team You take accountability for your tasks, follow through on commitments, and proactively address challenges. This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 2-3 days per week on site. 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us. Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities. Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business. HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes. Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür. A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions. Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured. We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly. 👥 About Our Team We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way. 🤝 Why Us 💫 A mission that matters : Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind. 🏝️ Workation : Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy. 🎉 CONROO Time Off : Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member. 👊 Witness your actions shape our direction : You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible. 🏔️ Company getaway : Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next? 🎟️ Employee discounts : Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store. 🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together. 🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities. Our Recruitment Process Application review Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind. Deep dive into your experience in a 45 minute interview with the CEO & hiring manager, Felix. Complete a take-home case study. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview at our Munich office, where you’ll present your case study and discuss your experience further with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia. We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements. 💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics. title: Founders Associate - Product & Strategy (m/w/d)
description: Du suchst eine strategische Rolle mit Product Fokus in einem Tech-Startup? Du willst Teil unserer Mission sein, den Weiterbildungsmarkt zu revolutionieren und eine Plattform zu bauen, die Menschen eine neue Perspektive gibt und sie auf ihrem beruflichen Weg unterstützt ? Für viele Menschen wächst damit die Unsicherheit: Wird mein Beruf morgen noch gebraucht? Welche Fähigkeiten werden wichtig? Und wie finde ich meinen Platz? Weiterbildung ist ein Schlüssel, damit Menschen diesen Wandel mitgestalten können und neue Perspektiven gewinnen. Mit GenauMeinKurs wollen wir ihnen dabei als verlässlicher Partner zur Seite stehen. Wir wollen Orientierung geben, alle verfügbaren Informationen verständlich zusammenführen und Menschen helfen, den bestmöglichen nächsten Schritt ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung zu finden . Über uns Wir sind Edtelligent, ein Tech-Unternehmen aus München mit rund 20 Mitarbeitenden. Wir sind gebootstrappt und profitabel. Unser Gründerteam hat bereits mehrere erfolgreiche Unternehmen aufgebaut und skaliert. Wir haben bereits eine Software für den Weiterbildungsmarkt entwickelt, die von über 100 Bildungsanbietern genutzt wird , um ihre Kurse zu verwalten. Dadurch bringen wir eine umfangreiche Datenbasis und ein tiefes Verständnis des Weiterbildungsmarktes mit. Jetzt wollen wir diese Expertise nutzen, um mit GenauMeinKurs eine Plattform für Weiterbildung zu bauen, die den Endnutzer im Fokus hat . Wir entwickeln einen digitalen Begleiter, der Menschen von der ersten Orientierung bis zur passenden Entscheidung unterstützt. GenauMeinKurs ist ein zweiseitiger Marktplatz: Für Nutzer ist die Plattform kostenlos, Bildungsanbieter zahlen für qualifizierte Anfragen. Beides zusammenzubringen ist ein zentraler Teil deines Jobs. Du entwickelst ein Produkt, dem Menschen vertrauen, weil es ihnen bei ihrer Entscheidung hilft, und das gleichzeitig für Bildungsanbieter so wertvoll ist, dass ein tragfähiges Geschäft entsteht. Aufgaben Gemeinsam mit unserem Co-Founder und CTO Stefan und kleinen Team von erfahrenen Entwicklern entwickelst Du GenauMeinKurs zu einem vertrauenswürdigen Begleiter für den nächsten beruflichen Schritt. GenauMeinKurs ist seit Herbst 2026 live und wird bereits von einer vierstelligen Anzahl von Nutzern monatlich genutzt - wir stehen noch am Anfang und du kannst entscheidend mitprägen, wohin sich das Produkt entwickelt. In deiner Rolle verbindest du analytische Arbeit mit praktischer Umsetzung : Du denkst strategisch und bringst Eigeninitiative, Drive und Lernbereitschaft mit – wir bieten dir den Einblick, den Gestaltungsspielraum und die Unterstützung, um mit deiner Verantwortung zu wachsen. Konkret bedeutet das: Du gibst der Produktentwicklung Fokus. Du erkennst was wirklich zählt, setzt klare Prioritäten und entwickelst unsere Produktvision und Roadmap weiter. Du arbeitest strategisch in engem Austausch mit unserem Gründerteam und hast einen gesamtheitlichen Blick auf das Unternehmen Du bist in der Lage dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, führst Nutzer Interviews und leitest daraus neue Features ab Du suchst die besten Lösungen – auch außerhalb unserer Branche. Du untersuchst, wie führende digitale Produkte Orientierung geben, Entscheidungen erleichtern und komplexe Suchen einfach machen. Relevante Erkenntnisse übersetzt du in eigene Ideen für GenauMeinKurs. Du denkst AI first. Du nutzt KI selbstverständlich, um Nutzerprobleme zu analysieren, Ideen zu prüfen und produktiver zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du mit uns, wie KI Suche, Matching und persönliche Begleitung grundlegend verbessern kann. Du baust selbst mit. Mit KI entwickelst du funktionsfähige Prototypen und setzt erste Produktverbesserungen selbst in Code um. Du testest deine Lösungen und bereitest deine Codebeiträge so vor, dass unsere Entwickler sie reviewen, weiterentwickeln und in das Produkt übernehmen können. Qualifikation Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du: bereits erste Berufserfahrung in einer namhaften Unternehmensberatung oder einem schnell wachsenden Startup gesammelt hast - idealerweise in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte; Verantwortung in einem kleinen Team übernehmen möchtest und die Energie mitbringst, Dinge voranzutreiben; einen hohen Anspruch an Produktqualität hast und dich mit unserer Mission identifizierst; aus vielen Möglichkeiten das Wesentliche herausfilterst und einem Team Orientierung gibst; KI bereits praktisch in deinem Arbeitsalltag nutzt und Lust hast, damit auch selbst Software zu entwickeln – von ersten Prototypen bis zu Codebeiträgen, die du gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam zur Umsetzung bringst; fließend Deutsch sprichst Erfahrung im Weiterbildungsmarkt oder im Produktmanagement ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du Lust hast, dich schnell einzuarbeiten und mit der Rolle zu wachsen. Benefits 🚀 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an – bei einem Produkt, das du sichtbar mitprägen kannst. 💡 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Gründerteam sowie mit Tech, Growth, Sales und Customer Success. 🤖 KI als fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeit und Raum, neue Möglichkeiten im Produkt praktisch zu erproben. 🧪 Die Freiheit, Ideen schnell zu testen, aus Nutzerfeedback und Daten zu lernen und erfolgreiche Ansätze weiterzuentwickeln. 📈 Eine Rolle, mit der du wachsen kannst, während wir GenauMeinKurs weiter aufbauen. 🛠️ Ein modernes Toolset mit Google Workspace, Slack, Claude, HubSpot und weiteren Tools. ☕ Modernes Büro , mit kostenlosen Snacks, Siebträgermaschine und hochwertiger Ausstattung. 🏡 30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit für regelmäßiges Homeoffice. 🧘 Subventionierte Wellpass Mitgliedschaft mit unlimitierten Zugang zu über 16.000 Sport- und Wellnesspartnern. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Être Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li><strong>Créer un environnement Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li><strong>Diriger avec Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <h4>Rôle et Impact :</h4> <p>En tant que <strong>Programmatic Account Manager Junior</strong>, vous rejoignez notre équipe d'experts pour accompagner nos clients dans le déploiement de leurs stratégies d'achat média (programmatique et gré à gré). Ce poste est une opportunité idéale pour monter en compétences et consolider votre expertise digitale.</p> <p><strong>1. Veille marché & Formation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Rencontre régulière des différents partenaires (média, data, techno) pour comprendre l'écosystème.</li> <li>Participation active aux <em>product updates</em> des différentes plateformes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Programmation & Pilotage des campagnes</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Programmatique :</strong> Programmation des campagnes dans les DSP sélectionnés (DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon, Google Ads), intégration des paramètres de qualité (visibilité, listes d'exclusion) et pilotage quotidien des budgets et de la diffusion.</li> <li><strong>Gré à Gré :</strong> Envoi des éléments aux partenaires, intégration des paramètres de qualité, vérification des mises en ligne (<em>piges</em>) et suivi des performances.</li> </ul> <p><strong>5. Suivi, Optimisation & Bilans</strong></p> <ul> <li>Suivi quotidien de la bonne livraison des campagnes et édition de reportings hebdomadaires.</li> <li>Identification et mise en place d'optimisations pour maximiser les performances de vos campagnes.</li> <li>Participation à la rédaction et à la présentation des bilans de campagnes (analyse des résultats, enseignements et pistes de réflexion pour la suite).</li> </ul> <p><strong>6. Gestion financière & Proximité Agence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Suivi budgétaire rigoureux des campagnes et réalisation des bilans d'achat de fin de campagne.</li> <li>Participation aux points physiques et journées de partage (<em>space planning</em>) chez nos agences partenaires.</li> </ul> <h4>Profil Recherché :</h4> <p><strong>Expérience Professionnelle :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une première expérience significative (stage de fin d'études ou alternance) en <strong>achat programmatique</strong>, idéalement acquise en agence média.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences Techniques (Hard Skills) :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bases du Programmatique :</strong> Première manipulation d'au moins un DSP majeur (DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon Ads, Google Ads).</li> <li><strong>Analyse de données :</strong> Bonne maîtrise d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules de base) pour analyser les données de diffusion et construire des reportings.</li> <li><strong>Sensibilité technique :</strong> Une première approche des outils d'Ad Verification (IAS, DoubleVerify...) ou de Web Analyse (Google Analytics) est un plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences Comportementales (Soft Skills) :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Rigueur et Organisation :</strong> Vous êtes attentif aux détails. Le setup de campagne sans erreur et le respect des budgets sont vos priorités.</li> <li><strong>Curiosité et Soif d'Apprendre :</strong> Le marché du programmatique évolue vite, vous aimez comprendre comment fonctionnent les technologies.</li> <li><strong>Esprit d'équipe & Communication :</strong> Vous aimez travailler de manière collaborative et savez partager vos alertes ou vos réussites avec clarté.</li> <li><strong>Sens du Service :</strong> Vous avez à cœur de répondre efficacement aux demandes de nos partenaires et agences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Langues :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Anglais professionnel</strong> (écrit et oral) pour interagir avec certains partenaires technologiques et participer à des formations globales.</li> </ul> <h4>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</h4> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you. Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Knowing when the AI is right : calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions. Evaluating accounting agents : an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring. Learning from accountants' corrections : turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees. Bank reconciliation : matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation. An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets : from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production. Data foundations for AI : evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own. AI will be part of how you work You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug. We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent. OUR CULTURE You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase. You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset. The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship. description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1,250,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! Our electronic invoicing track represents a core strategic priority for Pennylane. This dedicated team is responsible for developing our comprehensive electronic invoicing offering for our accounting firm partners and their SME clients (Small and Medium-sized Enterprises), accelerating client acquisition, enhancing customer satisfaction, and establishing operational excellence within this segment. As our cross-functional initiatives expand, we now require robust frameworks for end-to-end process management, data-driven performance analytics, and a relentless focus on operational efficiency and scalability. We are seeking an exceptional, impact-oriented Strategy & Operations professional who will be instrumental in building these critical capabilities and propelling our electronic invoicing track toward market leadership. Why this role matters at Pennylane The Strategy & Operations role will serve as the critical link between our strategic vision and day-to-day execution, working directly with the General Manager for the track. You will help translate ambitious goals into actionable, measurable roadmaps, establish best-in-class metrics, and develop the operational infrastructure needed to scale the business rapidly and sustainably. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with significant opportunity for leadership and professional growth. Your responsibilities Strategic planning and execution - Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives - Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth Data-driven decision making - Lead comprehensive analyses to identify market opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and growth levers - Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative research Project leadership - Spearhead strategic initiatives and pilot programs from ideation through implementation and measurement - Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities Cross-functional orchestration - Serve as the operational nexus between the track and horizontal teams including care, sales, and the other product teams impacted by the electronic invoicing reform - Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries Performance management - Own the OKR process for the track, ensuring clarity of objectives and accountability for results - Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics - Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them Who we’re looking for Experience - 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments - Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact - Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently Core competencies - Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals - Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes - Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation - Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders - Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions ⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup. You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role. title: Account Executive, Payments (Existing Merchants)
description: Account Executive, Payments (Existing Merchants) Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might be in the right place! We are looking for an Account Executive, Payments, who is responsible for driving the adoption of Lightspeed Payments within Lightspeed's existing merchant base in the Netherlands. This is a dedicated cross-sell/upsell position focused on transitioning current Point of Sale (POS) customers to our proprietary, integrated payment processing solution. Lightspeed Payments has been continually invested into since launch in 2019, integrating a number of unique value drivers into the combined POS-payments solution. Building off of success our new business teams have experienced in selling the combined POS-payments solution, we are scaling our ability to sell payments into our existing merchant base, many of which became clients before we scaled Lightspeed Payments. This position reports to the Global Payments Sales Manager and is part of the Global Payments GTM team. Your Mission The primary responsibility is to meet and exceed sales targets for Lightspeed Payments adoption among existing merchants. Pipeline Management: Generate and manage sales opportunities using leads sourced from Account Managers, direct phone/email outreach, and follow-up on company-led marketing campaigns. Sales Execution: Manage the complete sales cycle from initial qualification and value presentation through pricing negotiation and contract closure. Customer Launch: Partner with Onboarding teams to ensure a smooth transition and launch for merchants adopting Lightspeed Payments. Internal Expertise: Serve as the internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) on payment processing for other units, providing guidance and training as required. Product Feedback: Collect and relay merchant feedback regarding the payments product to the Product Management teams. Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all sales activities, pipeline status, and opportunity notes in Salesforce Other Duties: Handle additional duties and responsibilities as defined by management. What you’ll be bringing to the team Payments Experience: Direct experience (3+ years) in the payment processing industry. Sales Closing Role: Demonstrated experience (3+ years) in a closing role focused on technology or solution sales. Opportunity Development: Proven ability to proactively generate and qualify new opportunities. Target Achievement: Documented history of success in a revenue target or quota-based environment. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch language skills are a requirement. What’s in it for you? Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story ... and further Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Healthy snacks and after work organized by the company To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. title: Head of Hardware
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took. A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly. Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before. Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Nice to Have Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé. Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization. Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures. Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time. Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong. Open-source hardware or firmware contributions. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, UGV Platforms (m/f/d)
description: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real world operations. As Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, you will own electromagnetic compatibility across our UGV platforms, starting with our Mandrill UGV: from the grounding and shielding concept on the drawing board to the certificate that puts our vehicles on public roads and into military service. Your goal is one robust E/E design baseline that passes civil homologation (UN ECE R10) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461, AECTP 500) without costly redesign loops. This is a senior engineer role with real ownership and room to grow. You build our EMC capability from the ground up, set the strategy, decide early in the design, and lead campaigns through to certification. You will work at the intersection of high power electronics, vehicle E/E, radios and mission payloads, autonomy compute, suppliers, test houses and authorities. As the platform family and team grow, this role can develop into leading our EMC and compliance function. What is your Day to Day Mission: EMC Strategy and Compliance Ownership Define and own the EMC and E3 compliance strategy for our UGV platforms, covering civil vehicle approval (UN ECE R10, E mark for vehicle and ESA) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461G, MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500 / AECTP 250, MIL-STD-1275). Translate customer, NATO and national requirements into an EMC control plan, requirement matrix and test strategy, and keep them current as configurations evolve. Act as the technical interface to accredited test houses, technical services, type approval authorities and defence customers during qualification and acceptance. EMC by Design Develop and integrate the grounding, bonding, shielding and harness concept for the complete vehicle, with special focus on high voltage and high power electronics: traction inverters, DC/DC converters, battery systems and chargers together with outstanding team of engineers Run EMC design reviews for schematics, PCBs, harnesses, enclosures and connectors; specify filters, transient protection and shielding concepts. Manage RF coexistence on a dense platform: datalinks, GNSS, tactical radios and payload emitters working side by side without degrading each other. Flow down EMC requirements to suppliers, run component level reviews and assess their test evidence. Test, Troubleshooting and Qualification Build our in house pre compliance lab (LISN, spectrum analyser, near field probes, current clamps, automated measurement scripts) so issues are found on the bench, not in the chamber. Plan, witness and lead full compliance campaigns at component, subsystem and vehicle level; drive root cause analysis and verified fixes when tests fail. Use simulation (e.g. FEKO, CST, LTspice) where it saves test iterations. Cross Functional Collaboration and Standards Work closely with payload integration, vehicle E/E, mechanical, autonomy and manufacturing teams so EMC is built in, not bolted on. Create EMC control plans, test procedures, reports and qualification evidence, and turn lessons learned into internal EMC design rules for every future platform and payload. What you bring to the team: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics or a comparable technical field. 8+ years of EMC experience in automotive, commercial vehicle, rail, aerospace or defence , including ownership of at least one product through formal qualification or type approval. Deep knowledge of automotive EMC (e.g. UN ECE R10, CISPR 25, ISO 11452, ISO 7637, ISO 10605) and working knowledge of military EMC (MIL-STD-461; ideally MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500, DEF STAN 59-411 or VG 95370/95373). Strong automotive profiles willing to extend into the military world are very welcome. Solid experience with EMC of high voltage and power electronics systems. Practical measurement expertise at component and vehicle level, and the ability to set up and automate test systems (e.g. Python, Matlab). Structured root cause analysis, ideally backed by methods such as Six Sigma, and audit ready documentation. Confident communication with engineers, suppliers, test labs, authorities and military customers. Fluent in German and English. High ownership, focus on teamwork, pragmatic, and happy to work directly on vehicles and in the workshop. Your Benefits: Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. title: End-of-Line Robotics Engineer
description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your mission We are looking for an exceptional End-of-Line Robotics Engineer to take ownership of the automated stations that check every produced drone before it flies. These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will be at the heart of our quality control: understand how a drone can fail, find the best way to detect it, and turn that into a reliable validation test on the production line. You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time. Core responsibilities Explore different ways to detect each drone defect, choose what to measure and set pass/fail criteria based on data. Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number. Program handling routines for our collaborative robot and integrate them safely with fixtures and sensors. Move proven tests into the Calibration & Validation room, make them robust for daily use by operators, and improve cycle time, coverage and uptime as volumes grow. Analyse results across the fleet, spot trends and drifts, and report defects to design and production so they are fixed at the source. Requirements Your profile You combine strong engineering and analytical skills with solid software craft. You break complex problems down, reason from data rather than assumptions, and enjoy getting a station working hands-on, not only in code. At least 2 years in test engineering, validation, test automation or production test, ideally on robotic or electromechanical products. Solid robotics fundamentals: modelling system dynamics, choosing sensors and actuators: understanding their trade-offs (noise, bias, bandwidth, cost). Comfortable with reference frames and transforms: relating to IMU, camera and robot or vehicle frames, and how their data is fused together. General knowledge of state estimation and control theory (e.g. Kalman filtering, PID and feedback loops), enough to understand how a drone or robot behaves and why a test result looks the way it does. title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
description: <div class="gmail_default" style="font-size: small;"> <div> <p><strong>Why Mozilla?</strong></p> <p>Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.</p> <p>The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.</p> <h4><strong>About this team and role:</strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.</span></p> <h4><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h4> <p><strong>Risk Management</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance and Audit</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Program Support</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support data classification and data governance efforts by maintaining documentation, tracking adoption, and coordinating with data owners</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Assist with business impact analysis (BIA) and business continuity/disaster recovery (BC/DR) activities, including plan maintenance, exercise coordination, and follow-up on gaps</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>GRC Operations and Tooling</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation</span></li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h4> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with technical and non-technical stakeholders</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A collaborative, curious mindset and a genuine desire to learn and take on new challenges</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hands-on experience with a GRC platform (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience supporting an audit (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Exposure to any of: vulnerability management, third-party risk, BC/DR, secure development practices, or penetration test coordination</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, SQL, or workflow tools) to improve GRC processes</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A relevant certification or one in progress (e.g., Security+, CISA, CISM, CISSP)</span></li> </ul> <strong>What you'll get:</strong> <ul data-start="3001" data-end="3640"> <li data-section-id="131m0bb" data-start="3001" data-end="3104">Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees—we share in our success as one team.</li> <li data-section-id="1tom7yi" data-start="3105" data-end="3149">Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage.</li> <li data-section-id="5ugc8y" data-start="3150" data-end="3253">Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute).</li> <li data-section-id="m1g0av" data-start="3254" data-end="3330">Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together.</li> <li data-section-id="mby2ad" data-start="3331" data-end="3392">Country-specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday.</li> <li data-section-id="15ntbic" data-start="3393" data-end="3424">One-time home office stipend.</li> <li data-section-id="r9ac9u" data-start="3425" data-end="3466">Annual professional development budget.</li> <li data-section-id="7ti1pq" data-start="3467" data-end="3498">Quarterly well-being stipend.</li> <li data-section-id="1htbsxd" data-start="3499" data-end="3534">Considerable paid parental leave.</li> <li data-section-id="1vv9zik" data-start="3535" data-end="3569">Employee referral bonus program.</li> <li data-section-id="1a08eks" data-start="3570" data-end="3640">Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc.—varies by country).</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Mozilla </strong></p> <p>Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.</p> <p><strong>Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging</strong></p> <p>Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation<span style="color: #003366;">s, </span>gender identities, and expressions.</p> <p>We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at <a class="external-link" ---------- to request accommodation.</p> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.</p> <p>Group: C</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> <

title: Enterprise Core Sales Engineer - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’ll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.</p> <p>Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France.  This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world:</strong> Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career:</strong> If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.</li> <li><strong>You’re energized by our opportunity:</strong> The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best:</strong> At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. </li> <li><strong>You are a team player:</strong> At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.</li> <li>Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.</li> <li>Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara’s products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.</li> <li>Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.</li> <li>Have the ability to be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.</li> <li>Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.</li> <li>Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.</li> <li>Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 2+ years of pre-sales experience</li> <li>Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.</li> <li>Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.</li> <li>Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.</li> <li>Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.</li> <li>Fluent in English.</li> <li>Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT and/or Value Selling sales concepts.</li> <li>Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, Fleet or general operations background a huge plus</li> <li>Previous experience working in a Fleet Sales environment</li> <li>Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.</li> <li>Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.)</li> <li>Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our <a href="https://samsara.com/blog/avoiding-fake-job-offers">blog post here</a>.</p>&l

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
