As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  </p> <p>This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.</p> <p><strong>This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. </li> <li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers:</strong> The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best:</strong> Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. </li> <li><strong>You are a team player:</strong> At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.</li> <li>Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.</li> <li>Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.</li> <li>Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.</li> <li>Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.</li> <li>Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.</li> <li>Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.</li> <li>Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.</li> <li>Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.</li> <li>Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.</li> <li>4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.</li> <li>Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding title: Senior Territory Account Executive, the Baltics
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Hybrid - </strong><strong>London or Munich</strong></p> <div><strong>About the Department</strong></div> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.<br><br><strong>About this Role</strong><br><br>The Senior Territory Account Executive position effectively delivers the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiating and closing sales with new & existing customers in line with business plans. Identify and progress cross sell opportunities to maximise revenue goals. Selling new products and generating additional sales revenue through effective sales outreach activity.</p> <div>The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement from administrative through executive levels within network operations, development and technical infrastructure teams.<br><br><strong>Regional Focus:</strong> the Baltics<br><br><strong>The Ideal Candidate:</strong><br> <ul> <li>Passionate about sales: You have a hunger to win and a desire to exceed your targets and reap the rewards.</li> <li>Strong customer service skills: You put the client first and you do what you say you’ll do.</li> <li>Personable, resilient and a culture champion: A friendly, warm and professional demeanour will get you far. You celebrate the ups and bounce back quickly from your missteps.</li> <li>Cool and calm under pressure: The ability to effectively manage competing priorities and solve multiple problems quickly is in your DNA.</li> </ul> <strong>Main Responsibilities:</strong><br> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan to achieve quarterly sales and annual revenue targets in a defined territory and/or account list.</li> <li>Drive new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline through continual engagement and nurturing of key prospect accounts.</li> <li>Understand customer use-cases and how they pair with Cloudflare’s portfolio solutions in order to identify new sales opportunities.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.</li> <li>Effectively scale the territory with partners</li> <li>Accurately forecast commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.</li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> <li>Direct B2B sales experience, adept at new business acquisition and account management.</li> <li>Experience selling a technical, cloud-based product or service</li> <li>Working knowledge of the cloud infrastructure and security space</li> <li>Solid understanding of computer networking and Internet functioning.</li> <li>Keenness for learning technical concepts/terms. Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS is advantageous.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills (both verbal and written) and organizational skills</li> <li>Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic environment.</li> <li>Willingness to travel frequently to visit customers and prospects</li> <li>Fluency in one of the following - Estonian, Latvian or Lithuanian</li> </ul> <strong>Knowledge/Experience:</strong><br> <ul> <li>6+ years of B2B selling experience and selling Enterprise Software or SaaS (network security preferred) or Hardware solutions and services to Mid-Enterprise/ Enterprise customers</li> <li>Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships within enterprise and mid-market accounts in the Baltics territory</li> <li>New Business & Expansion</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles</li> <li>Fast paced environment</li> <li>Enterprise IT/Cyber Security background</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €152,000 - €209,000.</p> <p data-path-to-node="2">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Manager Data-analyse Nieuwsmedia
description: Rotterdam - Als Manager Data-analyse Nieuwsmedia ben je een analytisch sterk en verantwoordelijk voor inhoudelijke inzichten binnen het cluster AD.nl en de 7 regiotitels, zoals De Stentor of De Gelderlander. Je realiseert duurzame digitale groei door de inzichten strategisch te verankeren in de dagelijkse werking van de redacties. Zo helpen we de redacties om redactionele en operationele kansen in één oogopslag te signaleren en bepalen we samen de digitale koers van onze nieuwsmerken. Wat ga je doen? Je bent hands-on en nog steeds zeer vaardig met analytische tools. Jouw standplaats is Rotterdam en je bent bereid om te reizen naar de regionale titels van ADR (van Middelburg tot Enschede). title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation : Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten : Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen : Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkelin g: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld : Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen : Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer. Waarom CCS? Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data & Product Engineer (Dutch speaking)
description: Our mission Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen. Your impact and responsibilities Als Data & Product Engineer in het Financial Analytics Delivery & Service team draag je bij aan: Het ondersteunen van klanten bij het aanleveren van data, via een export en/of script vanuit hun systeem. Zelfstandig valideren en analyseren van data om de kwaliteitsstandaarden te garanderen. Resultaten van validaties nauwkeurig rapporteren aan klanten en data issues oplossen. Het coördineren van het proces van data-aanlevering en -validatie, samen met andere betrokken collega’s. Onderhouden van centrale en klantspecifieke data definities en standaarden. Ondersteunen van data governance initiatieven, inclusief het monitoren van de prestaties van onze dataprocessen en ondersteuning bij data audits. Identificeren en oplossen van problemen in data pipelines in samenwerking met Data Product & Ontwikkeling teams. Deelname aan projecten zoals vernieuwing van data pipelines en het bouwen van een centraal Data Platform voor dataverwerking en -validatie door klanten Your team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Je wordt onderdeel van het Data Management team, verantwoordelijk voor het beheren van alle datastromen die nodig zijn om onze financiële SaaS-producten aan klanten te leveren, met focus op zorgproductie (DBC) data, HR en financiële data van zorginstellingen. Your profile We geloven dat de volgende vaardigheden en kwalificaties bijdragen aan jouw succes in deze rol: Relevante Werkervaring: je hebt 2-4 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met data. Ervaring binnen de technologie- of gezondheidszorgsector is een pré. Enthousiast over geavanceerde data-analyse en het oplossen van big data vraagstukken in de gezondheidszorg. En daarnaast over ontwikkelingen in data en technologie, en bereid deze toe te passen in je werk. Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden met oog voor volledigheid en kwaliteit van data. Jij hebt een gestructureerde, pragmatische en resultaatgerichte aanpak. Daarnaast ben je proactief in het oppakken van nieuwe taken en het zoeken naar kansen om bij te dragen. Bereidheid om te leren en aan te passen aan innovatieve technologieën, tools en processen. Bereidheid om verantwoordelijkheden binnen projecten op te nemen en een betrouwbare teamgenoot te zijn. Masterdiploma in een kwantitatieve, financiële, technische of andere relevante richting. Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Zelfs als je niet aan 100% van de criteria voldoet, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren. We waarderen bereidheid om te leren boven alles. Why LOGEX? De gezondheidszorg is tegenwoordig meer op maat gemaakt en effectiever dan ooit tevoren, maar deze verbeteringen gaan gepaard met hogere kosten en een grotere complexiteit. De financiële last op de economie is aanzienlijk, terwijl de vele keuzemogelijkheden voor artsen en patiënten onzekerheid creëren en onaanvaardbare variaties in klinische uitkomsten veroorzaken. Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg. Naast een baan met een duidelijke missie bieden wij jou: Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, telefoon- en internetvergoeding) 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen Een informele werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken Een laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om thuis een comfortabele en ergonomische werkplek in te richten Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onze LOGEX Academy Toegang tot onze partner op het gebied van mentale gezondheid; OpenUp Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen Contact us! title: Engineering Manager, Security Platform: Authentication
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Engineering Manager on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll build and lead a team of engineers in Bangalore who own how users, applications, tokens, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents sign in to GitLab. At GitLab, we see our team as our product. You'll need to be technically credible in authentication protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML). Your main focus will be hiring well, growing your engineers, and helping the team deliver on commitments that other parts of GitLab depend on. You'll guide your team's work on OAuth across Cells, global identities, token consolidation, and moving authentication out of the Ruby on Rails monolith onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. You'll manage these multi-quarter programs with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams.</p> <p> </p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Hire, onboard, and grow a team of senior and intermediate engineers in Bangalore, working with talent acquisition during a high-volume hiring period.</li> <li value="2">Own delivery for your team's part of the authentication roadmap: plan in milestones, track risks early, and communicate clearly when a date is at risk and what would change it.</li> <li value="3">Work with your Staff Engineer and Product Manager to turn architecture decisions into shippable, feature-flagged increments.</li> <li value="4">Protect your team's focus. Manage requests from other teams through one intake path, and make trade-offs visible to leadership.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams across India, Europe, and the Americas.</li> <li value="6">Make sure the team runs what it builds, including on-call coverage, incident response for authentication issues, rate limits, and production readiness for new services.</li> <li value="7">Build a team culture where security comes first, decisions are written down, and code review is thorough and kind.</li> <li value="8">Give clear, regular feedback, run career conversations, and handle performance issues early.</li> <li value="8"><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Significant experience as an engineering manager of backend or platform teams, including hiring and growing senior engineers.</li> <li value="2">A background as an engineer in identity, authentication, or security systems, with enough depth in OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and JSON Web Tokens to review designs and ask probing questions.</li> <li value="3">Experience delivering complex, multi-team programs against fixed dates, including migrations that must not disrupt existing customers.</li> <li value="4">Experience running production services, including on-call coverage, incident response, and reliability work.</li> <li value="5">Working knowledge of Ruby on Rails or Go.</li> <li value="6">Experience building a new team or growing one quickly while keeping the hiring bar high.</li> <li value="7">Clear, concise written English and comfort leading a team in an all-remote, asynchronous company across time zones.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We're part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. You'll partner closely with our existing Authentication engineers in Europe and the Americas.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Distributed Systems Engineer - Data Platform (Delivery, Database, Retrieval)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Denver, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> <li>London, UK</li> <li>Lisbon, Portugal</li> <li>Toronto, Canada</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until February 16, 2027</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s Data Org builds the systems that ingest, process, store, and retrieve data generated across our global network. These systems power the logs, analytics, and alerts that give customers near real-time visibility into the security, reliability, and performance of their Internet properties.</p> <p>We are looking for systems-oriented backend engineers who enjoy solving distributed-systems problems at large scale. You will build primarily in Go, operate the systems you create, and work across the data lifecycle, from high-throughput ingestion and delivery to analytical storage and customer-facing retrieval.</p> <p>Engineers in this role typically develop depth in one of two areas:</p> <ol> <li>Analytical database systems: Building and operating our ClickHouse-based analytical platform, improving database performance, reliability, and scalability.</li> <li>Data delivery and retrieval: Building streaming pipelines, public APIs, log delivery integrations, and alerting systems that make customer data accessible and actionable.</li> </ol> <p>We are looking for strong backend and systems fundamentals, production operational experience, and demonstrated depth in at least one of these areas.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate reliable distributed systems that process very large volumes of data.</li> <li>Develop and optimise backend services and data platform components, primarily in Go.</li> <li>Improve data integrity, delivery latency, query performance, availability, and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Build systems that handle failure safely through techniques such as backpressure, retries, idempotency, replication, and graceful degradation.</li> <li>Define service-level objectives, monitor production health, plan capacity, and respond to incidents.</li> <li>Diagnose performance bottlenecks across ingestion, processing, storage, and retrieval.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Depending on your area of focus:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and operate large-scale ClickHouse clusters and contribute improvements to the ClickHouse ecosystem.</li> <li>Develop data delivery pipelines that route data from Cloudflare’s global network to customer destinations.</li> <li>Build and scale GraphQL APIs, log delivery integrations, and near real-time alerting products.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand their data needs and design pragmatic solutions.</li> <li>Evaluate technologies and contribute to the next generation of Cloudflare’s data platform.</li> <li>Participate in an on-call rotation for the production systems owned by your team.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>At least three years of professional software engineering experience building backend, infrastructure, database, or distributed-data systems.</li> <li>Strong Go programming skills, or substantial systems programming experience (Rust, C++) with the ability to become productive in Go quickly.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production services, including deployment, monitoring, capacity planning, incident response, and debugging.</li> <li>A solid understanding of distributed-systems concepts, including concurrency, consistency, fault tolerance, partitioning, and data integrity.</li> <li>Experience with high-throughput or low-latency data processing.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, including monitoring high-cardinality workloads.</li> <li>Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly for complex production problems.</li> <li>Clear communication and an ability to collaborate across engineering and product teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demonstrated depth in at least one of the following areas:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Database systems: SQL, analytical databases, database internals, query optimisation, performance tuning, or operating large database clusters.</li> <li>Data delivery and retrieval: Streaming systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, API development, or customer-facing data integrations.</li> </ul> <h2>Helpful Experience</h2> <ul> <li>ClickHouse or another large-scale analytical database.</li> <li>Kafka, Flink, or similar streaming technologies.</li> <li>GraphQL or other high-volume API technologies.</li> <li>Terraform, Salt, or other Infrastructure as Code tooling.</li> <li>Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux container technologies.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source database or distributed-systems projects.</li> </ul> <p>If you enjoy building efficient systems, understanding how they behave in production, and solving data problems at global scale, we would like to hear from you.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.</li> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000.</li> <li>For Washington and New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="1"> </h3> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span

Entreprise Familiale et leader mondial de la pétanque, OBUT allie innovation, savoir-faire et convivialité pour offrir à chaque joueur une expérience de jeu incomparable. Précurseur en matière de RSE, Obut est de nature ouverte et attentive au bien-être de ses collaborateurs. L’entreprise valorise la qualité, le savoir-faire français, l’engagement, le partage et la joie Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, OBUT recherche un(e) Technicien Bureau d'Études pour accompagner son service Technique dans la conception, le développement et l'amélioration de ses équipements et installations industrielles, pour une durée minimale de 6 mois. Votre Rôle : Au cœur de notre environnement industriel, vous contribuez à la conception et à l'évolution de nos équipements afin de répondre aux enjeux de performance, de sécurité et d'ergonomie de notre outil de production. Rattaché(e) au Responsable Technique, vous intervenez aussi bien sur la réalisation d'études et de plans que sur la recherche et la mise en œuvre de solutions techniques, en lien étroit avec les équipes Maintenance, Production et Qualité. Vos missions : Concevoir et réaliser des études techniques Vous analysez les besoins et les contraintes techniques afin de proposer des solutions adaptées à notre environnement industriel. Étudier la faisabilité des projets et rechercher des solutions adaptées Concevoir et modéliser des pièces, ensembles et sous-ensembles en 2D et 3D Réaliser les plans d'ensemble, plans de définition, nomenclatures, notes de calcul et schémas fonctionnels Élaborer les plans d'implantation des lignes de production Constituer les dossiers et notices techniques dans le respect des normes en vigueur Contribuer à l'amélioration de notre outil industriel Dans une logique d'amélioration continue, vous participez à l'évolution de nos équipements et à l'optimisation de nos méthodes de fabrication et de maintenance. Proposer des évolutions visant à simplifier et optimiser les techniques de fabrication et les méthodes de travail Identifier des solutions permettant d'améliorer l'ergonomie des installations Anticiper l'impact des améliorations sur les équipements existants et les futures installations Collaborer avec les équipes Maintenance, Production et Qualité dans la recherche de solutions techniques Participer à la mise en œuvre de nouvelles solutions techniques Vous contribuez à l'avancement des projets industriels, de la définition du besoin jusqu'aux essais de fonctionnement. Participer à l'élaboration des cahiers des charges avec les différents acteurs du projet Proposer des solutions en tenant compte des contraintes techniques, réglementaires, budgétaires en respectant les délais Analyser les choix techniques et définir les équipements et matériaux adaptés Consulter les fournisseurs, analyser les devis et les proposer au Responsable Technique Participer aux essais de fonctionnement des nouvelles installations Garantir le suivi et la mise à jour des informations techniques Vous veillez à la fiabilité et à l'accessibilité de notre documentation technique. Numériser les pièces, ensembles et sous-ensembles à partir des études réalisées Structurer et maintenir à jour les bases de données et les arborescences techniques Votre profil : Issu(e) d'une formation technique de niveau Bac+2/3 dans les domaines de la conception industrielle, des systèmes automatisés, du génie industriel ou de la maintenance, vous disposez d'une expérience en bureau d'études, idéalement dans un environnement industriel. Vous maîtrisez les outils de CAO et de dessin industriel en 2D et 3D. Vous possédez de solides connaissances en mécanique, complétées par des connaissances en électricité, automatisme, pneumatique et usinage. À l'aise avec la résolution de problématiques techniques, vous savez analyser les contraintes d'un projet, rechercher des solutions adaptées et coordonner les différents interlocuteurs impliqués dans son avancement. Rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et méthodique, vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de curiosité et de réactivité. Vous appréciez autant le travail de conception que les échanges avec les équipes sur le terrain. Le respect des règles Qualité, Sécurité et Environnement (QSE) fait naturellement partie de votre manière de travailler. Terrain de jeu et avantages : Rattaché(e) à notre site de production de Saint-Bonnet-le-Château, vous évoluez au cœur de notre outil industriel et travaillez quotidiennement au contact des équipes Technique, Maintenance, Production et Qualité. Vous aimez relever des défis techniques, passer d'un cahier des charges à un plan 3D et donner vie à de nouvelles installations ? Vous avez envie de travailler sur des projets industriels variés, où chaque étude contribue à faire évoluer nos machines et nos équipements ? Chez OBUT, chaque partie a son histoire. À vous de venir écrire la prochaine avec nous. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Personalsachbearbeiter (m/w/d)
description: YANMAR Energy System Europe – cool seit über 30 Jahren. Mit mehr als 120 Kolleginnen und Kollegen entwickeln und realisieren wir anspruchsvolle Lösungen in der Energie-, Kälte-, Klima- und Wärmepumpentechnik. Von der ersten Idee über Entwicklung und Fertigung bis hin zu Anlagenbau und Service begleiten wir den gesamten Lebenszyklus unserer Lösungen. Entwicklung, Fertigung und viele weitere Leistungen erbringen wir dabei aus eigener Hand an unserem Standort in Marl. Energieeffizienz, Dekarbonisierung und intelligente Versorgungslösungen gehören zu den großen Zukunftsthemen unserer Zeit. Genau hier gestalten wir die Zukunft mit. Für namhafte Kunden aus Industrie und Gewerbe entwickeln wir Lösungen, die einen messbaren Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energieversorgung leisten. Was uns als Arbeitgeber auszeichnet? Die kurzen Wege und die Kultur eines mittelständischen Unternehmens, verbunden mit den Möglichkeiten einer internationalen Technologiegruppe. Bei uns übernehmen Menschen Verantwortung, unterstützen sich gegenseitig und gestalten gemeinsam Lösungen, die bei unseren Kunden einen echten Unterschied machen. Zur Verstärkung unseres HR-Teams vor Ort in Marl suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Personalsachbearbeiter (m/w/d) Du betreust die laufende Personalarbeit für knapp 200 Kolleginnen und Kollegen in zwei Gesellschaften und hilfst uns, wiederkehrende Abläufe einfacher und digitaler zu gestalten. Deine Verantwortung: Die laufende Personalsachbearbeitung übernimmst du gewissenhaft. Du pflegst Personalstammdaten, bereitest Vertragsunterlagen vor und begleitest Ein- und Austritte. Du bearbeitest Bescheinigungen für Mitarbeitende, Behörden, die Agentur für Arbeit und Sozialversicherungsträger und behältst die Fristen im Blick. Du bereitest die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung für eine unserer Gesellschaften vor und übernimmst die Vertretung für die zweite. Du prüfst Zeiten, Zuschläge und Personaländerungen, übergibst die Daten an das jeweilige Steuerbüro und klärst Rückfragen. Du unterstützt das Recruiting, indem du mit unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus den Fachbereichen gemeinsam Stellen ausschreibst und das Bewerbermanagement übernimmst. Du wirkst an der Einführung von neuen Tools und Prozessen mit und hilfst, einfache HR-Auswertungen aufzubauen, zum Beispiel zu Fehlzeiten und offenen Planstellen. Stück für Stück übernimmst du eigene Projekte und entwickelst dich weiter. Dein Potenzial: Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Personalsachbearbeitung. Du arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Anwendungen, prüfst Daten sorgfältig und gehst verantwortungsvoll mit vertraulichen Informationen um. Du hast bereits eine monatliche Entgeltabrechnung vorbereitet. Wenn du einen vollständigen Abrechnungslauf selbst durchgeführt oder eng begleitet hast, ist das ein Plus. Wenn Daten doppelt gepflegt werden oder bei einem Vorgang regelmäßig dieselben Rückfragen aufkommen, suchst du nach einer einfacheren Lösung und hilfst, sie umzusetzen. Du hast Lust, dich in der Personalarbeit breiter aufzustellen und Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Darauf kannst du dich freuen Gestaltungsspielraum statt starrer Strukturen: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest aktiv mit. Wir investieren in deine Entwicklung: Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungen unterstützen dich dabei, deine Rolle kontinuierlich auszubauen. Flexibel arbeiten: Damit du auch aus dem Home Office effizient arbeiten kannst, erhältst du von uns moderne digitale Arbeitsausstattung. Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Beruf, Familie und Freizeit ihren Platz haben. Sicherheit für heute und morgen: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und eine private Krankenzusatzversicherung unterstützen dich in jeder Lebensphase. Gesund und erholt arbeiten: 30 Tage Urlaub, Fahrradleasing sowie kostenfreies Obst, Wasser und Kaffee gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu. Mehr drin für dich: Über Corporate Benefits profitierst du von attraktiven Rabatten bei zahlreichen Marken und Anbietern. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Named Account Executive, Norway & Finland
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Sweden</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Customer Success - all work together to help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</span></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You'll drive new business by identifying and qualifying target accounts for Cloudflare’s Enterprise service plan across the Finland and Norway regions. This is a great opportunity for a Sales Professional to help us build the Sales and Customer Development function at Cloudflare. Our highest-SLA customers depend on them to run their businesses. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to keep these systems reliable at scale.</p> <p>The role combines building and operating. Weekends are covered by a separate 24-hour rotation. You’ll take a weekend roughly once every six to eight weeks.</p> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and owning distributed systems in production.</li> <li>Strong production software skills, ideally in at least one object-oriented language. Familiarity with Honeycomb or Grafana is a strong plus.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Kubernetes as a user, and comfort with Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions to deliver your own services.</li> <li>Experience mentoring engineers and leading design discussions, supported by excellent written and verbal communication and a documentation-first mindset.</li> <li>A platform engineering mindset that treats internal developers as customers, with a bias toward shipping and iterating, comfort with ambiguity, and a habit of digging into root causes.</li> </ul> <h2 class="cui-headline-64we cui-headline-l-bth2 css-1cpk9mt e173j6r80">Why you should join SumUp</h2> <p class="cui-body-gccz cui-body-m-0hb4 cui-body-regular-g1zg cui-body-normal-pxkh css-k4eprn">🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. title: Director, Management & Technology (DACH) - CPG/Retail
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h2><strong>About Celonis</strong></h2> <p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.</p> <p>The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.</p> <p>Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Based at our global headquarters in <strong>Munich</strong>, as a <strong>Management & Technology Consulting Manager / Director</strong> (internal title: Value Engineering Manager / Director) for <strong>CPG & Retail</strong>, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the <strong>CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region</strong>. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.</p> <p>In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.</p> <p><strong>Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.</strong></p> <p><strong>The role is based in Munich.</strong></p> <h2><strong>What Sets Our Patch Apart</strong></h2> <p>The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators. </p> <p>As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth:</strong> Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership & Coaching:</strong> Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.</li> <li><strong>Executive Advisory & Player-Coach:</strong> Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise AI Champion:</strong> Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem & Partner Strategy:</strong> Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.</li> <li><strong>Thought Leadership:</strong> Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Leadership Behaviors We Value</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Deliver Business Outcomes:</strong> Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent:</strong> Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.</li> <li><strong>Lead by Example:</strong> Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.</li> <li><strong>Think BIG, Be BOLD:</strong> Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications & Scope</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Language Skills:</strong> Native or business-fluent <strong>German</strong> (spoken and written) and fluent <strong>English</strong> are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.</li> <li><strong>Location Presence:</strong> Based in or willing to relocate to <strong>Munich</strong>, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.</li> <li><strong>Proven Leadership Experience:</strong> Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.</li> <li><strong>Domain Expertise:</strong> Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.</li> <li><strong>People Management:</strong> Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong> Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.</li> <li><strong>Executive Presence:</strong> Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Pioneer Innovation:</strong> Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate Your Growth:</strong> Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Receive Exceptional Benefits:</strong> Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and <a href="https://careers.celonis.com/life-at-celonis/benefits">much more</a>. Interns and working students explore your benefits <a href="https://careers.celonis.com/early-careers">here</a>.</li> <li><strong>Prioritize Your Well-being:</strong> Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.</li> <li><strong>Connect and Belong:</strong> Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs. </li> <li><strong>Make Meaningful Impact:</strong> Be part of a company driven by strong <a href="https://careers.celonis.com/life-at-celonis/values">values</a> that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate Globally:</strong> Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Environment:</strong> Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>About Us:</strong><br>Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. title: Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What You Will Do Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform. Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams. Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build. Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use. Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails. Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior. Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features. Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping. Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed. Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root. Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on. Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur. Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI. Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams. What You Bring Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production. Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices. Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management. Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations. Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS. Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break. Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python preferred) to build tooling, automate checks, and prototype mitigations. Experience securing cloud-native systems, ideally on Azure, including CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub) and infrastructure-as-code. A proactive, builder mindset; you prevent problems by shipping guardrails and enabling teams, not just by finding issues. Strong communication skills; able to explain AI-specific risks and tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and leadership. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving scale-up, set technical direction, influence without authority, and mentor other engineers while defining a practice that doesn't yet have a playbook. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience red teaming or pentesting AI/LLM systems. Familiarity with the OWASP GenAI Security Project's agentic security work and emerging standards for securing autonomous agents. Experience with AI security tooling such as guardrail frameworks, LLM firewalls, prompt-injection scanners, or AI red-teaming tools. Experience implementing security controls in production agentic systems, including sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and runtime monitoring. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and tools like Vanta. Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana). Relevant security certifications (e.g. OSCP, GIAC, or AI-security-specific credentials). Experience in fintech, audit technology, or other regulated, trust-sensitive domains. Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, or AI safety concepts. What We Offer: Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing Recruitment Process Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online) Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online) Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site) Final Interview (30 minutes, online) At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you. What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call. The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation. Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly. title: Broker Development Manager
description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading. Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through. Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high. Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals. Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis. What you’ll need At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market. An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one. A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work. A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business. A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs. Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems. Ein zentraler Baustein ist der Nua Score, der bereits in einer ersten Version vorliegt.
