Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding. For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept. The opportunity New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way. Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources. Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product. Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time. title: Praktikum Product Marketing und Projektmanagement (m/w/d)
description: Dein Impact Du findest mit uns heraus, wie Menschen in beruflichen Umbruchphasen, etwa nach einer Kündigung, zu PAIDAI kommen. Welche Botschaft zieht, welcher Kanal, welche Seite überzeugt: Das klären wir durch Ausprobieren, nicht in Präsentationen. Deine Landingpages gehen live und werden von echten Menschen besucht. Nach ein paar Tagen siehst du, was funktioniert, und baust die nächste Version. Für dich heißt das: Du hast morgens eine Idee und kannst sie am Nachmittag testen. Wege sind kurz, Entscheidungen fallen im Team. Du pflegst unsere Projekt- und Wissensablage (u. a. Jira und Confluence), bereitest Meetings vor und nach und machst Ergebnisse für alle auffindbar. Du unterstützt die Abstimmung mit Partnern, Dienstleistern und Agenturen. Je nach Interesse übernimmst du ein eigenes Projekt und verantwortest es von der Planung bis zum Ergebnis. Dein Profil Du studierst, z. B. Eine steile Lernkurve in Product Marketing, Projektmanagement und dem Arbeiten mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen. Eine feste Ansprechperson, regelmäßiges Feedback und Mentoring. Hybrid, drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Büro mitten in Hamburg. Wir nehmen Rücksicht auf Vorlesungen und Prüfungen. Ein kleines, interdisziplinäres Team, das Lust auf Neues hat. Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie du denkst und arbeitest, als jedes Häkchen auf einer Liste. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Hintergründe und Lebenswege. Klingt nach dir? Du behältst den strategischen Überblick, triffst kluge Entscheidungen im Tagesgeschäft und befähigst deine Teamleitenden durch gezieltes, wertschöpfendes Feedback, jeden Tag ihr Bestes für unsere KundInnen zu geben.</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung:</strong> Du schaust hinter die Kulissen. Im FC Office (1–2 Tage/Woche) analysierst du Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe frühzeitig und leitest daraus clevere Maßnahmen ab – immer mit dem Blick darauf, ob deine Lösungen die Arbeit auf dem Shopfloor spürbar verbessern.</li> <li><strong>Projektmanagement: </strong>Echte Veränderungen entstehen bei uns direkt auf dem Shopfloor. Du hinterfragst den Status quo, sprichst Abweichungen offen an und hebst unsere Abläufe mit eigenen Logistikprojekten nachhaltig aufs nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Du führst deine Schichten, als wäre es dein eigenes Unternehmen. (Keine Sorge vor fehlender Lagererfahrung: Mit unserem intensiven Coaching wirst du in kürzester Zeit zum Vollprofi auf dem Shopfloor!)</li> <li>Du bist empathisch, nahbar und motivierst andere mit Leichtigkeit. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, löst Konflikte konstruktiv und hast Freude daran, Talente im Team gezielt zu fördern.</li> <li>Du triffst auf dem Shopfloor wie im Office immer den richtigen Ton, sprichst Dinge klar an und kommunizierst sicher und souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch.</li> <li>Du siehst Feedback als wichtigstes Werkzeug für gemeinsames Wachstum, nimmst Coaching dankbar an und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, inkl. Samstag) mit.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns:</strong> Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken:</strong> Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner:</strong> Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.</li> <li><strong>Lebensmittelretter:</strong> Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!</li> <li><strong>Lerne & wachse:</strong> Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.</li> <li><strong>Absicherung für morgen:</strong> Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong><br>This role builds testing into Dive-XL designs and gives Production the test capability to find faults early. The aim is that faults are found at the lowest level of assembly where they can be found, problems reach design teams with the data needed to fix them, and recurring problems are fixed at their source in the design. The role sits within the Platform Engineering organisation and works closely with Manufacturing Engineering and Manufacturing Operations.<br>The role starts with the Dive-XL vehicle, built in Australia. Once the approach is proven there, it extends in agreed stages to other Maritime Engineering products and our US sites. At each stage, the responsibilities below apply to the products and sites then in scope, and the role hands the capability it builds to the teams that will run it before moving on.<br>This is a senior technical leadership role at Staff level, and its output is engineering: test strategies, test modes and interfaces, test tooling and design changes. It needs deep technical judgement across electronics, firmware and software, and the credibility to influence design engineers and production teams. The role builds software and tooling for test stations and factory acceptance testing (FAT). Running them day to day, station hardware, fixtures and calibration, first-line triage and field support are outside its scope.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><br><strong>Test-Ready Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>From the start of each new Dive-XL design, set its test strategy with the design engineers: what is checked at board, subsystem and vehicle level (electrical performance as well as functional behaviour), with what limits, test points and firmware test modes, and how each test is run</li> <li>Own the firmware and software parts of each test strategy, and work with the electrical and mechanical design engineers on their parts. Specify and verify firmware test modes, and provide a reference implementation of each new kind for the owning firmware teams to adopt</li> <li>Within delegated authority, set testability requirements, sign off testability at design reviews, and own the standards that make products testable: the firmware test-mode specification, device interface definitions and the factory record (each unit's identity and as-built configuration). Work with Configuration Management to add a test-impact check to engineering changes</li> <li>Extend testability across existing Dive-XL boards and subsystems, in a priority order agreed with Platform leadership and informed by production data: built-in self-test, test modes, factory records and a defined starting software baseline for newly built boards</li> </ul> <p><strong>Test Platform and Tooling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build the shared software that engineering test and production test both use to talk to devices: machine-readable device definitions versioned with the firmware, versioned command interfaces, and a client library for hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) rigs and production stations. Keep it open and not tied to any one test framework</li> <li>With the firmware and application software teams, add an automated check to their release process that production test still works with each new firmware and application version</li> <li>With Manufacturing Engineering, deliver automated test for a first Dive-XL subsystem that runs independently of the application software release cycle, and hand it over, with acceptance tests, to Manufacturing Engineering's test engineers</li> <li>Treat production test tooling as a product, with users, requirements, releases, documentation and a roadmap, and hand it over to its long-term owner when it is ready. With Manufacturing Engineering, make the software on test stations repeatable to deploy from a version-pinned release (for example NixOS), so a new station or site is set up from a release, not by hand</li> </ul> <p><strong>Closing the Loop with Production</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take the software and test side of each first-of-type build of a new design through to readiness, so problems are found and fixed before volume production</li> <li>With Manufacturing Engineering and Manufacturing Operations, build fault-reporting and diagnostic tools so problems arrive with the data needed to solve them, and Production can resolve more problems itself</li> <li>Use escalations from Production to find systemic causes: lead the root-cause analysis of repeat and systemic problems across hardware, firmware, software and test, and drive a lasting fix at the source (the design, the test or the tooling) with the owning teams</li> <li>Build FAT tooling for Manufacturing Engineering and Manufacturing Operations to adopt: scripted acceptance runs with machine-readable results, automated unit setup and vehicle-level diagnostics. Use FAT data to propose procedure changes, with evidence, for the procedure owner to consider</li> <li>Decide software, configuration and test questions within delegated authority (for example, a firmware version mismatch on a built unit, or whether a failure is a defect or a design limit), and escalate decisions beyond that authority</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Leadership, Collaboration description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3>ABOUT THE TEAM</h3> <p>Product Support Engineering exists to maximise the operational availability of the Dive-XL fleet. We sit between the teams in the field who operate and sustain the system alongside our customers, and the engineering teams that design it. When something unexpected happens — at sea, at a maintenance facility, in the middle of the night — we are the engineering team that answers, works out what happened, and decides how to proceed. The other part of the job is making sure it does not happen twice. We drive reliability and supportability improvements into the system, and keep the fleet's configuration and documentation current as it evolves. Between us we cover every engineering discipline — software, electrical, mechanical, systems.</p> <h3>ABOUT THE JOB</h3> <p>We are looking for Senior Product Support Engineers to join the Dive-XL team, supporting the teams operating and maintaining Anduril's Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicles. You will be will support the operational fleet on a rotating roster that extends out-of-hours, providing anything from immediate technical guidance to formal root cause analysis. Each request means assessing severity, scoping the work and doing the investigation. From there you'll direct the engineering change, maintenance activity, workaround or documentation fix that resolves it, and own its rollout across every affected vehicle. You will also work to reduce support demand through sparing strategy, reliability and supportability improvements, better diagnostics and tooling, and supportability requirements fed into new variants during design. You will need genuine depth in an engineering discipline, enough breadth to triage across the others, and the judgement to make a call on limited data.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO</h3> <ul> <li>Provide Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service. You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. The Germany-based OTA engineering group works in close, daily collaboration with the core OTA development team headquartered in Palo Alto, California, extending platform architecture to European vehicle programs and regional ECU suppliers, and representing site-specific requirements back into the global roadmap. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to anchor and grow our Over-the-Air (OTA) engineering capability at our Germany site. In this role, you will own architecture-level decisions for OTA features spanning firmware updates, configuration updates, and software/hardware mismatch handling, working in tight lockstep with the OTA development team in Palo Alto. You will be the senior technical voice for OTA in Germany — driving site development activities, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and ensuring the Germany team's contributions integrate cleanly into a single, global OTA architecture. This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed. Responsibilities Develop OTA features and services covering firmware update delivery, ECU/software configuration updates, and software-hardware mismatch detection and remediation. Collaborate daily with the OTA development team in Palo Alto on system architecture, API contracts, and release planning; ensure Germany-site work streams stay aligned with the global OTA roadmap. Design update strategies (full-image, delta/differential, A/B partitioning) that guarantee safe, resumable, and rollback-capable updates across heterogeneous ECUs. Define and evolve the software/hardware compatibility (mismatch) framework, including version dependency graphs, pre-condition checks, and campaign eligibility rules. Drive interface and contract discussions with cloud/backend teams (campaign orchestration, telemetry ingestion, update eligibility services) to keep vehicle-side and cloud-side assumptions in sync. Work with communication protocol stacks used for in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud data exchange (e.g., UDS/ISO 14229, DoIP, SOME/IP, CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, TLS/mTLS, MQTT) to integrate OTA services with ECUs and cloud endpoints. Ensure OTA processes meet automotive security and safety expectations: secure boot, cryptographic signing/verification, key management, and compliance-oriented practices aligned with ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R156 (Software Update Management System). Partner with QA, functional safety, cybersecurity, and vehicle integration teams to validate updates through bench, HIL, and vehicle-level testing. Support root-cause analysis and resolution of field issues related to update failures, mismatches, or rollback scenarios. Take a leading role in architecture reviews and design decisions for the global OTA platform, representing Germany-site needs and constraints while upholding overall system coherence. Drive Germany-site development activities end-to-end: technical planning, design reviews, code quality standards, and delivery execution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to Senior and mid-level engineers on the Germany team; review designs and code for correctness, performance, and maintainability. Identify architectural risks and technical debt early; propose and lead initiatives to address them across the OTA stack. Act as a key escalation point for complex, cross-cutting technical issues spanning firmware, middleware, and cloud interfaces. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time in embedded, systems, or automotive software. Demonstrated experience owning system or platform architecture for a production software product, ideally in automotive, IoT, or another safety- or reliability-critical domain. Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple engineers or teams, including cross-site or cross-organization collaboration. Experience directly interfacing with a partner engineering team in a different location/time zone to align on architecture and delivery. Strong, hands-on proficiency in C++ and Rust — this is a core, non-negotiable requirement, as the majority of OTA services are implemented in these languages. Solid understanding of embedded Linux / POSIX-compliant operating environments and the constraints of resource-limited automotive compute platforms. Practical experience with in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud communication protocols (e.g., CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, UDS/DoIP, TLS, MQTT, gRPC/Protobuf, or comparable). Comfortable driving technical interface discussions directly with cloud/backend engineering teams — defining APIs, data contracts, and failure-handling behavior across the vehicle-cloud boundary. Experience with version control, code review workflows, and CI/CD for embedded or systems software. Working knowledge of cryptographic concepts used in secure software delivery: digital signatures, certificate/key management, and secure boot chains. Strong debugging skills across layers — application logic, OS/driver interaction, and hardware/bus-level communication. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Fluent English (spoken and written) for daily collaboration with the Palo Alto team; German language skills are a plus for local site interactions. Willingness to travel occasionally to Palo Alto, CA (or host virtual overlap hours) to support cross-site architecture and planning. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience specifically in OTA/software update systems for vehicles or other connected embedded devices. Experience establishing or scaling a new engineering site or team within a larger, distributed organization. Exposure to Machine Learning / AI techniques applied to edge compute — e.g., anomaly detection on update telemetry, predictive mismatch detection, or on-device inference constraints. Automotive middleware development experience on POSIX-based ECUs (e.g., AUTOSAR Adaptive, Linux-based domain/zone controllers, or similar middleware frameworks). Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test environments and automotive diagnostic tooling. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. title: Product Marketing Manager | Kimchi AI Coding Platform| EMEA
description: <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Kimchi is Cast AI’s newest product: an agentic platform for running AI workloads. We are building in a greenfield space where the technology, customer expectations, and the competitive landscape shift constantly. The problem space is broad and ambiguous by design. If you are at your best when the playbook is still being written, you will thrive here.</p> <p>This is not a role for maintaining a mature product line. It’s a hands-on, zero-to-one PMM job inside a startup-like team with the backing of a unicorn. You must be curious. You’ll speak directly with early customers, run messaging and channel experiments, and build Kimchi’s ICP and positioning from the ground up. Then you’ll turn that evidence into the business’s first go-to-market playbook.</p> <p>You’ll report to the Director of Product Marketing and work alongside Product, Engineering, and company leadership, with support from Content, Growth, Design, and Sales Enablement as the work scales. As a senior hire, you have the autonomy to identify quick wins independently and the judgment to balance short-term results with a longer-term roadmap.</p> <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.</p> <p>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.</p> <p>Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.</p> <p><strong>Global team, diverse perspectives<br></strong>We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead. </p> <p><strong>Unicorn momentum<br></strong>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>What success looks like in 90 days</h4> <ul> <li>You understand Kimchi’s product, the problems it solves, and its priority audiences.</li> <li>You scope the highest-priority PMM problems instead of trying to solve everything at once.</li> <li>You run small experiments that produce trackable wins, including ICP hypotheses you validate or invalidate.</li> <li>You take senior ownership: you work independently, bring clear recommendations and trade-offs, and balance short-term execution with a longer-term roadmap.</li> </ul> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of product marketing experience with technical audiences, preferably developer tools or AI tooling.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency. You can grasp nuances without an engineer walking you through every detail.</li> <li>Hands-on, sprint-based working style with an experimental mindset.</li> <li>Real experience building an ICP and messaging architecture from scratch for a product whose buying motion was not yet validated.</li> <li>A track record of running customer interviews and extracting patterns that refine positioning.</li> <li>Experience designing GTM experiments and changing direction based on what the data shows.</li> <li>Data literacy: you can define success criteria and read funnel or adoption data.</li> <li>Win/loss research and competitive deal support experience.</li> <li>Sound commercial judgment on pricing, packaging, and willingness to pay, even when Product owns the final call.</li> <li>Fluent English, written and spoken.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What would make you stand out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have thrived in an early-stage or ambiguous product environment.</li> <li>You can point to a PMM outcome that AI meaningfully improved, whether in speed, quality, reuse, or measurement.</li> <li>Excellent writing, backed by work samples such as positioning docs, launch content, and sales narratives.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities<strong>:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Run deep, direct customer research to define and validate Kimchi’s ICP.</li> <li>Own positioning and messaging, and keep it consistent as new features ship.</li> <li>Own the commercial hypothesis, audience, message, positioning, and experiment design for GTM tests across trial flow, content, and channels. Growth, Product, and Demand Gen will help execute the experiments and measure results.</li> <li>Translate Kimchi’s technical differentiation into a value story that technical buyers recognize as true.</li> <li>Manage feature launches end to end, from early positioning through GA.</li> <li>Build the first version of sales enablement assets, battlecards, proof points, and demo narrative.</li> <li>Maintain the feedback loop from customer and market signal back into roadmap input.</li> <li>Track the competitive landscape and share what is changing with Product and leadership.</li> <li>Partner directly with Engineering to keep messaging accurate as the product evolves quickly.</li> <li>Build and maintain AI-assisted workflows that make this function faster, more consistent, or easier to measure.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in AI.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="356">Equity options.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="451">Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="554">Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="628">Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="841">Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="917">Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="917">Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with a Recruiter.</li> <li>Interview with the Hiring Manager.</li> <li>Practical exercise.</li> <li>Panel interview with the Kimchi Product Leadership.</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>*As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>*Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities & Energy Trading practice is growing, and we are looking for (Senior) Managers (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich.</span> </span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">As a (Senior) Manager, you will lead or deliver complex management consulting engagements for clients across commodity and energy trading, build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and help grow our practice. You will combine deep industry expertise with consulting and leadership skills, taking accountability for client outcomes, team performance and commercial development.</span></span></p> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities and large energy consumers. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, commercial optimisation, risk and regulation, flexibility integration, and technology delivery.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to advise influential organisations on strategic priorities and deliver meaningful change across trading operations, commercial performance and new technologies, while playing a visible role in building our German and European business.</p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>You will take responsibility for delivering complex client engagements, leading project teams, building trusted client relationships and contributing to the growth of our Commodity & Energy Trading practice. The breadth of your responsibilities will reflect your experience and the level at which you join. Areas of work include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Client leadership and delivery:</strong> Build trusted relationships with executive and senior client stakeholders, translate strategic priorities into practical programmes whilst owning complex engagements or major programmes from shaping through delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes, strong governance and effective management of scope, risk and commercials.</li> <li><strong>Leadership & Business Development</strong><strong>:</strong> Identify and shape opportunities, lead proposals and pitches, develop propositions and account plans, and contribute to business development, revenue growth and capability building. Strengthen our market profile through thought leadership, external networks, sector insight and collaboration across Baringa capabilities and geographies.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Depending on your expertise, your client work may include:</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Operating model & business transformation: </strong>Leading trading operating model and business transformation engagements, helping clients optimise governance, processes and organisational structures to deliver sustainable operational change.</li> <li><strong>Digital & trading transformation: </strong>Delivering data, analytics and AI-enabled transformation initiatives, helping clients improve trading decision-making, operational efficiency and commercial performance.</li> <li><strong>Trading systems transformation:</strong> Leading ETRM/CTRM transformation engagements, supporting strategy, implementation and optimisation initiatives while aligning business and technology stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility services & integration: </strong>Leading the delivery of flexibility strategy and integration engagements, helping clients unlock value from battery storage, renewable assets and enabling technologies across evolving energy markets.</li> <li><strong>Risk and regulatory advisory: </strong>Advising clients on risk and regulatory challenges, enhancing risk management frameworks, governance and controls while supporting adaptation to evolving market and regulatory requirements.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"> </span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <p>We are looking for experienced professionals who combine management consulting experience with strong knowledge of commodity and energy markets, ideally within energy and commodity trading or trading transformation. title: Director, Enterprise Sales UK/IE
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <p><strong><span style="color: #072b55;">About Boomi and What Makes Us Special</span></strong></p> </div> </div> <div> <div> <p><span style="color: #072b55;">Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out <a href="http://www.boomi.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.boomi.com/&source=gmail&ust=1782843859988000&usg=AOvVaw3Yitd6hYQcya0j0B5k0__J">boomi.com</a>  or visit our <a href="https://boomi.com/company/careers/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://boomi.com/company/careers/&source=gmail&ust=1782843859988000&usg=AOvVaw2W_0H5BboonDUat_xHGW0d">Boomi Careers</a> page to learn more.</span></p> </div> </div></div><h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As the Director, Enterprise Sales, UK & Ireland, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive the next phase of growth. </strong>Formulate and execute a sales strategy for your region that builds on our strong UK presence and ladders up to our overall sales strategy.</li> <li><strong>Win and grow. </strong>Lead, plan and manage sales activity across your territory to acquire new customers, grow existing ones and keep every customer delighted.</li> <li><strong>Lead an established team. </strong>Take the lead of a team of sales professionals selling Boomi products, solutions and services, and drive training and development plans in partnership with product and enablement that help them grow.</li> <li><strong>Be a player-coach. </strong>Stay hands-on with your team: deeply involved in account planning, strategy and sales calls.</li> <li><strong>Create a high-energy culture. </strong>Inspire your team to generate new pipeline and position Boomi’s products and services with confidence for expansion and net new logos. </li> <li><strong>Be a trusted advisor. </strong>Work closely with current and prospective customers to understand their unique challenges and goals, and show them how the Boomi Enterprise Platform, the active data foundation for agentic infrastructure, can help them harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity and blaze new trails within their organisations.</li> <li><strong>Power up with partners. </strong>Work closely with our network of 800+ partners, including GSIs, to open doors and win together.</li> <li><strong>Sell with discipline. </strong>Apply our sales methodology (MEDDPICC) and processes consistently.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across Boomi. </strong>Work with other regional leaders to drive operational cadence, and partner with Sales, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Industry Specialists, Technology and Marketing to build compelling value propositions and business cases.</li> <li><strong>Deliver results. </strong>Consistently achieve revenue targets.</li> <li><strong>Enjoy the ride. </strong>Contribute to our growth in a fast-paced, collaborative and fun atmosphere, as a valued member of our inclusive sales community.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A successful and impressive direct sales career, with a focus on solution selling at C-suite.</li> <li>A strong track record of leading direct sales teams in the UK and Ireland, specifically selling Enterprise Software as a Service (SaaS).</li> <li>A consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue goals in the UK and Ireland.</li> <li>MEDDPICC practitioner.</li> <li>Strong forecasting capabilities, with a proven ability to build, drive and manage pipeline and achieve operational excellence.</li> <li>A high level of technical acumen and a good understanding of the customer and industry landscape Boomi operates in, including the shift to AI and agentic transformation. To the era of intelligence. </li> <li>Based remotely in the UK, covering the UK and Ireland territory.</li> <li>Competencies: adaptable, data-driven, inclusive and accountable for results.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.</li> <li>Experience in integration, iPaaS, API management, automation, AI or data management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Boomi?</strong></p> <p><strong>Market Momentum & Growth:</strong> Boomi is in one of its most exciting growth phases in EMEA. With strong investment and an established GTM team on the ground, you’ll have the support and infrastructure to succeed from day one.</p> <p><strong>Enterprise-Grade Technology:</strong> Recognised by Gartner, Forrester, and IDC as a leader, Boomi delivers a market-leading platform for integration, automation, and AI orchestration. You’ll be representing a solution that solves real, complex challenges for enterprise customers.</p> <p><strong>Career-Defining Opportunity:</strong> This is the perfect time to join. You’ll be part of shaping Boomi’s story in UKI, opening new markets, landing marquee logos, and making a visible impact on the company’s growth trajectory.</p> <p><strong>Culture That Wins Together:</strong> At Boomi, collaboration is everything. You’ll be supported by local leaders, marketing, presales, and partner teams.</p> <p><strong>Uncapped Potential:</strong> With a track record of overachievement across our sales teams, you’ll have the ability to maximise your opportunities.</p> <p><strong>Flexibility & Balance:</strong> We are a remote-first organisation, giving you the freedom to work from anywhere in the UK while connecting with colleagues in person when it matters most.<br><br><strong>Award-winning Employer of Choice:</strong> recognised by The Sunday Times Best Employers 2026 and at the Flexa Awards (Most Loved Company, Best Workplace Benefits, Most Family Friendly Company), among others!!</p> <p><strong>Highly Competitive Compensation Package: </strong>Ask our recruiter about the compensation range for the role!</p> <p>If you are a high-performing Enterprise Sales Director ready to represent a recognised market leader, capitalise on the incredible growth momentum in the UKI, and be part of a supportive GTM team where you can overachieve and truly shape the future, now is the best time to join Boomi.</p> <p>#LI-RS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #072b55;"><strong>Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi.</strong> We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.  </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #072b55;"><em>Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. </em>All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Sales | Fund Administration | VC & PE | Private Markets (f/m/d)
description: bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. Your Role As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets. You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability. You will: Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands About you You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins. Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals. Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first. You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes. You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth. You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines. You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals. You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching. You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders. You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling You communicate excellently in English Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus. What success looks like In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility. Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell. Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling. Workplace & Benefits Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more) 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office) Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year A great tech and work setup Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains Hiring process People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit Founder’s Interview (60 min) – Role deep dive, sales leadership, and commercial scope Sales Leadership Case (60 min) – Coaching, pipeline discipline, and complex deal execution Final Round (3 x 45 min) – Meet our leadership team (Tech, Ops, CS). In-person Meet & Greet with team members. Reference checks About bunch bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management. We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it. ____ At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. title: Senior Account Executive, FedCiv
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Washington DC, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>We are looking for a seasoned sales professional to help cover the Federal market for US. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations</li> <li>Maintain a robust sales pipeline</li> <li>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 3 years of experience selling technical solutions or products to the Public Sector (Federal Government) ; <strong>all</strong> FedCiv agency experience open to consideration</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles`</li> <li>Basic understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Experience selling to the Federal customer base</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Washington DC, based hires: The expected salary range for this role is $269,000 - $370,000,  depending on experience and qualifications. Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Programming Skills : Proficiency in a programming language such as C++ with the ability to write clean and efficient code. Domain Knowledge : An expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and data processing, with hands-on expertise in their practical application. Problem-Solving : Exceptional problem-solving abilities and a creative mindset for algorithm design, emphasizing real-world applications. Communication : Effective communication and collaboration skills, allowing you to work seamlessly within cross-functional teams. Independence : The capability to work independently and take ownership of algorithmic projects while also being a collaborative team player. Language Skills : Fluency in English is required, and French language skills are a valuable asset, given our international environment. Why join us? Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows. As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents. title: Senior Business Data Scientist - Data & Transformation services
description: Ekimetrics is a global leader in Marketing & Commercial effectiveness and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping businesses optimize marketing and operations by combining AI with business and tech expertise across 4 domains: Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability. With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, we deliver tailor-made solutions that turn data into real positive impact, leveraging our unique combination of technology and services. We excel at delivering AI impact at scale. Our mission is to harness this power to tackle the world’s most urgent issues. We commit to responsibility and frugality in AI, systematic AI impact at scale, and loyalty to our values and DNA. You join as Senior Business Scientist within our Data & AI Transformation Services (DATS). You bridge business, consulting, AI & data expertise: you frame high-value use cases, turn business needs into AI opportunities, and drive adoption. You work alongside AI, Data and Software Engineers. Clients' Projects Lead the day-to-day relationship with business and CDO/CIO sponsors, and understand their strategic and operational challenges. Frame high-value Data & AI use cases and translate business needs into AI opportunities, from AI ambition and roadmap to Proof of Value and MVP. Depending on the engagement, act as Data & AI Product Owner: own the product vision and backlog, prioritize with business sponsors, write and accept user stories, steer the squad's delivery with the Tech Lead from Proof of Value to MVP and production, and own the related delivery governance and planning. Align business teams, leadership and ExCo around the AI roadmap and the transformation priorities. Own the business value and adoption of the solutions built by the squad: operating model, usage, impact measurement, Responsible AI and governance. Challenge their feasibility and industrialization with the Tech Lead and the Tech Engineers; you do not build the models yourself, but you are technical enough to challenge and steer GenAI, LLM, agentic and ML solutions. Contribute to the Transformation Cockpit: maturity measurement, adoption KPIs and steering of AI value over time. Work within a multidisciplinary squad (Tech Lead, AI/Data/Software Engineers), apply Ekimetrics' DATS methods, templates and deliverables, and tailor them to each client. Coordinate the business side of the squad and monitor delivery and profitability with manager support. Strategic Projects Develop and share best practices, methodologies and DATS assets (how-tos, templates, typical deliverables) across the Data & AI Transformation community. Stay up to date with AI, GenAI, ML and agentic technologies, and with their impact on business models and operating models. Contribute to internal AI initiatives, accelerators and thought leadership. Business Development Identify opportunities for Data & AI transformation within existing client accounts (upsell and cross-sell). Contribute to account development, renewals and project scoping, alongside the Partner. Contribute to RFPs, proposals and pitches. Support the development of new DATS offerings and use cases. Transversal & People Development Contribute to recruitment, onboarding and development of Data & AI Transformation talent. Mentor and coach Junior Business Scientists and interns. Develop and deliver internal AI / Data training and knowledge-sharing sessions. Profile Senior level: you have already led client engagements, coordinated a team and contributed to business development. Hybrid business-tech profile: you can connect business value, data, AI/GenAI, technology and adoption, and talk credibly with both sponsors and engineers. Proven product ownership experience on data or AI products (backlog, prioritization, agile delivery). Experience facing senior stakeholders and driving change or transformation, beyond the delivery of pilots. Why join us? At Ekimetrics, we believe your ideas truly matter. Here, your ideas are yours to build and bring to life. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, encouraging you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. But it’s not just about individual success—we thrive on collaboration and enriching one another. Together, we’re constantly learning and growing, whether through personalized career paths and training, challenging projects, mentorship, or simply through the diverse perspectives we bring to the table. And perhaps more importantly, we believe in enjoying what we do. Ekimetrics is a stimulating and safe environment where you can thrive as your authentic self. In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our strong commitment to CSR. Our purpose: Accelerate organizations’ transformation towards sustainability, through the application of data science and artificial intelligence. We were also certified Great Place to Work© in France, the United Kingdom, and the United States in 2023, and our Hong Kong office received the Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023© award. Ekimetrics is part of the French Tech 120 ranking. We have been selected by La French Tech to join the prestigious group of the top 120 French scale-ups, recognized for their potential to become international leaders. You will have access to: · The Eki.Academy training catalog, which contains programs that will enhance your skills on our solutions and jobs, learning paths on our digital platform, as well as programs dedicated to our priority challenges, including awareness of environmental issues with the Climate School; · A sporty, artistic, musical, playful, charitable, and committed life: from our private gym to art exhibitions, video games, and concerts, or even CSR challenges on our dedicated platform (Vendredi); · Many events and seminars to stay close to your community; · Modern premises in a dynamic area of the city; · Flexible working-from-home policy. description: Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. description: <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm, working with the world’s leading companies to solve their most complex business challenges. We provide strategic counsel across communications, investor relations, financial transactions, restructuring, geopolitics, public affairs, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and people advisory.</p> <p>With more than 50 offices worldwide, Teneo partners with CEOs, boards and senior executives to help organisations earn trust, navigate disruption and deliver against their strategic objectives.</p> <h3>The Opportunity</h3> <p>Teneo is seeking a high-calibre Director to join our team in Berlin or Frankfurt. This is a senior, client-facing role with a focus on corporate communication and reputation.</p> <h3>Role Overview</h3> <p>As a Director in Teneo Strategy & Communications business in Europe, you will be responsible for building trusted senior client relationships, leading complex client mandates in collaboration with (Senior) Managing Director and contributing to the growth and reputation of the business.</p> <p>Based in Berlin or Frankfurt, you will work closely with Teneo colleagues across Europe and the global network to deliver integrated advice to clients. This will include collaboration with specialists in corporate reputation, crisis preparedness and response, public affairs, geopolitics, management consulting, risk advisory, people advisory, sustainability, digital and creative campaigning.</p> <p>This role requires both strategic advisory excellence and a strong commercial mindset. The successful candidate will be expected to bring market credibility, senior relationships, origination capability and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex, high-profile and often sensitive client situations.</p> <h3>Key Responsibilities</h3> <h3>Client Counsel</h3> <h3>o   Act as trusted adviser to clients across a diversity of sectors and industries.</h3> <h3>o   Provide leadership on corporate narrative, reputation, stakeholder engagement, issues management and crisis preparedness.</h3> <h3>o   Advise clients on how to communicate effectively with employees, media, government, regulators, customers, investors, partners and other key stakeholders.</h3> <h3>o   Bring judgement, discretion and confidence to high-pressure situations involving complex stakeholder dynamics, significant public scrutiny and reputational risk.</h3> <h3>Corporate Communications and Crisis Situations</h3> <h3>o   Develop communications strategies around major corporate events, business transformation, leadership change, restructuring, litigation, regulatory scrutiny, operational incidents, cyber incidents, activism and other significant or sensitive situations.</h3> <h3>o   Advise clients on crisis preparedness, scenario planning, crisis governance, response strategies, messaging and stakeholder engagement.</h3> <h3>o   Work closely with legal advisers, public affairs teams, risk specialists, management consultants and other advisers to ensure communications strategies are aligned with broader business objectives and stakeholder considerations.</h3> <h3>o   Provide leadership in fast-moving and high-pressure situations involving intense scrutiny, competing stakeholder expectations and significant reputational risk.</h3> <h3>Media, Reputation and Stakeholder Management</h3> <h3>o   Develop and execute media strategies involving German, European and international business, corporate and national media.</h3> <h3>o   Advise clients on reputation management, corporate positioning, proactive storytelling, executive positioning, crisis situations and complex issues.</h3> <h3>o   Help organisations build and protect trust with their most important stakeholders through clear, credible and consistent communications.</h3> <h3>o   Provide senior counsel on emerging reputational risks, stakeholder expectations and issues that may affect corporate licence to operate.</h3> <h3>Leadership</h3> <h3>o   Leading project teams to develop and deliver communications that have real impact for our clients </h3> <h3>o   Providing team direction and management whilst acting as the day to day point of contact for clients</h3> <h3>o   Challenging the status quo with new thinking, new product development, and new ways of working </h3> <p> </p> <h3>o   Responsible for leading client servicing, profitability, forecasting and budgeting </h3> <h3>o   Proactively contributing to and fostering the development of junior team members</h3> <h3> </h3> <p><strong>Skills and Experience </strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years’ experience of working in a senior role in corporate communications</li> <li>Prior experience in an advisory firm is a plus</li> <li>Demonstrable experience in managing project teams </li> <li>Excellent understanding of media, social media, and stakeholder environments</li> <li>Excellent ability to shape and deliver strategic advice to senior level clients </li> <li>Able to manage and mentor junior staff </li> <li>An engaging self-starter with high attention to detail </li> <li>Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills </li> <li>A collaborator who is able to foster good working relationships </li> <li>Time management and the ability to prioritise a varied workload </li> <li>Comfortable taking the lead on driving performance and revenue </li> <li>Native level German required</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <p><strong>About Teneo</strong></p> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.</p> <p>The firm has more than 2,000 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.</p> <h3> </h3> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong>Senior SEM Manager</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3">We’re looking for a Senior SEM Manager to run Paid Search execution across our European launch markets, reporting to the Director of SEM.
