title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
description: About Nivoda Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started. Our Mission For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry. The Fulfilment & Express Team The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world. About the Role As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead. What would YOU be doing? Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains What do we need from YOU? 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome Nice to have Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes) Our culture and what we offer Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way. Our current benefits ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture 🏡 Remote work 🩺 Private health insurance 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare) 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase Equal opportunity Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. title: Stage Développement C++ & Intelligence Artificielle générative
description: Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre logiciel Track Builder , outil d’aide à la génération de lignes ferroviaires destinées à la simulation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d’études pour concevoir un framework intelligent de migration et de compatibilité logicielle, développé en C++ et assisté par l’Intelligence Artificielle . Le Track Builder évolue régulièrement, entraînant des modifications de son architecture, de ses modèles de données, de ses couches SIG (QGIS), de ses formats de configuration (XML/XSD) et de ses composants logiciels. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données. L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants. Les principales missions seront : Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions. Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates). Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations. Participer à l'intégration du framework dans le processus de développement et le pipeline CI/CD du Track Builder. Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation , avec des applications concrètes dans le domaine ferroviaire. Compétences appréciées : Framework Qt. QGIS et systèmes d'information géographique (SIG). Formats XML/XSD et bases de données GeoPackage/SQLite. Python. Outils et pratiques CI/CD. Intelligence Artificielle générative, LLM et prompt engineering. Analyse statique de code et conception de systèmes logiciels complexes. Qualités attendues : Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse. Autonomie, rigueur et curiosité technique. Capacité à proposer des solutions d'architecture et à prendre du recul sur des problématiques complexes. Intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et l'innovation. Information importante : le stage est réservé aux candidats de nationalité française. title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an <strong>Applied AI Engineer</strong> at GitLab, you'll build and deploy AI-powered solutions for GitLab's own teams. You'll join Enterprise AI in the CIO organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write production code and partner with senior engineers and internal business stakeholders to solve problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Your focus is GitLab's internal operations, rather than customer implementations or development of the GitLab product.</p> <p>Building fast matters, and we want engineers who ship. But speed without understanding the problem leads to the wrong solution shipped quickly. You'll partner with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand the real problem first: how work moves across teams, where the real constraint lives, and whether AI is the right intervention. From there, you'll take ownership of the build and deployment, combining strong engineering skills with curiosity about the business systems you're improving.</p> <p>Your initial focus will span GitLab's own Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams, where you'll embed AI solutions into the systems and workflows they use every day. This role offers the opportunity to grow as an engineer while shaping how GitLab team members work, in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Contribute to problem diagnosis alongside the team. Engage with stakeholders to understand the real constraint before reaching for a solution, and be willing to flag when AI isn't the right answer.</li> <li>Own the build and deployment of AI solutions, from technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration. Partner with senior engineers on discovery and scoping.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Build solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Track flow, adoption, and ROI metrics defined for the work.</li> <li>Integrate AI capabilities into GitLab's internal business systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: use GitLab's AI products in our own internal workflows, assess how they perform in practice, and share feedback with R&D to help improve them.</li> <li>Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions. Ask good questions, surface assumptions, and align with the team on outcomes before jumping to implementation.</li> <li>Track success against defined business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.</li> <li>Contribute to documentation and reusable patterns that help the team scale its impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Technologist at Heart -</strong> Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energized by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills - You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.</strong><strong>AI & LLM Technical Depth - Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Practical, hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, specifically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Prompt engineering as a core discipline:</strong> designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.</li> <li><strong>Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs:</strong> developing judgment on when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to think about capability versus cost.</li> <li><strong>Agentic architecture patterns:</strong> tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.</li> <li><strong>Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem:</strong> hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and growing judgment about which to reach for and when.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>AI Safety & Risk Awareness -</strong> You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defenses, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity About Flow & Constraints -</strong> Comfortable engaging with workflow maps, end-to-end process diagrams, and constraint analysis. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?" You don't need to be the one leading the diagnosis yet, but you should be eager to learn and contribute.</li> <li><strong>Business System Awareness -</strong> Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems: CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but you should understand what they do, be willing to learn how they fit together, and be ready to build with and across them.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Communication -</strong> Comfortable having conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains, willing to invest in understanding their unique needs, and able to translate between technical and business language.</li> <li><strong>Ownership Mindset -</strong> Track record of taking scoped initiatives from design through delivery. Comfortable operating with some ambiguity, and knows when to push forward independently versus when to ask for guidance.</li> <li><strong>Product Mindset -</strong> Ability to scope MVPs, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows</li> <li>Background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or other stakeholder-facing technical roles, combining strong engineering skills with stakeholder engagement, solution design, and root cause analysis. Experience personally building and shipping production-quality solutions is especially relevant.</li> <li>Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking</li> <li>Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development</li> <li>Previous startup or high-growth company experience</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You will join the <strong>Enterprise Technology & AI</strong> team in the CIO organization. Your mission for 2027: make our German coding logic accurate and defensible enough that Medizincontrolling teams trust it, and be the person who proves it to them. What you will do Build our German coding logic with our AI engineers Turn the Deutsche Kodierrichtlinien (DKR), ICD-10-GM, OPS and aG-DRG logic into rules and specs our engineers can build on. Write annotation guidelines and build the German test sets our models are measured against. Review model errors every week, explain why they are wrong, and flag the edge cases that hurt accuracy. Settle the hard cases Be our reference on principal diagnosis, PCCL-relevant secondary diagnoses and OPS complex procedure codes (Komplexbehandlungen), using the SEG 4 and FoKA coding recommendations. Make every suggestion defensible in MD audits Pre-bill only (§17c KHG): every suggestion supported by documentation, with an audit trail. Help design our MD audit defense product (justifications for the MD, objections). Make pilots succeed Analyze each hospital's Medizincontrolling workflows before go-live. Run second-level review before our suggestions reach the hospital's coders. Present results to the head of Medizincontrolling and get their sign-off for go-live. Join sales meetings to show what our coding looks like up close. Build the German coding team Recruit and lead Kodierfachkräfte as pilots scale, with our team of 20 coding experts in France. Experience at a coding, Medizincontrolling or billing software vendor (for example ID Berlin, Tiplu, Damedic, Solventum) is a big plus. Builder: you are comfortable starting from scratch in a startup. Languages Native German, fluent English (our working language with Paris). Hiring process Intro call (30 min). title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
description: Over Noldus Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot ziekenhuizen en bedrijven. We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen. De stageopdracht Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers? Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: • Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke mogelijkheden ze bieden. • Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien. • Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek. • Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen. • Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot eindproduct. • Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de grootste kansen liggen. • Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning. • Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in gebruik. • Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt. • Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe huisstijl. • Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en andere digitale kanalen. Wat willen we bereiken? Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent die: • Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert. • Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden gebruikt. • Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl. • Op verschillende plekken binnen onze digitale klantreis kan worden ingezet. Naast concrete video’s werk je aan een herkenbare visuele stijl en aanpak, zodat we ook in de toekomst op een consistente manier nieuwe videocontent kunnen ontwikkelen. Wat bieden wij? • Een creatieve stage met veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief. • De mogelijkheid om een project van concept tot eindproduct zelfstandig vorm te geven. • Samenwerking met een enthousiast E-commerce team en verschillende productspecialisten. • Een internationale en innovatieve werkomgeving. • Concrete eindproducten die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt op onze website en digitale kanalen. • Een mooie kans om je portfolio uit te breiden met uiteenlopende videoproducties, animaties en softwaredemo’s. Het eindresultaat Je levert niet alleen een aantal professionele video’s op, maar helpt Noldus ook om een nieuwe standaard neer te zetten voor hoe we onze producten en technologie visueel presenteren. Jouw creativiteit maakt onze innovaties zichtbaar! Wie zoeken wij? We zoeken een creatieve, enthousiaste student die het leuk vindt om ideeën om te zetten in professioneel beeldmateriaal. Je volgt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in de richting van Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Audiovisuele Media of een vergelijkbare creatieve opleiding. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: • Je hebt affiniteit met videoproductie, editing en visuele storytelling. • Je kunt werken met tools zoals Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve of vergelijkbare software. • Je vindt het leuk om zowel te filmen als digitaal beeldmateriaal te creëren. • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op. • Je bent creatief, neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of aantrekkelijker kan. • Je vindt het interessant om complexe software of technologie op een toegankelijke manier uit te leggen. Ervaring met animatie of motion graphics is een pluspunt. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Hochbauprojekten wäre von Vorteil. Kenntnisse im Neubau und in der Sanierung von Wohnraum sind wünschenswert. Praktische Erfahrung in der Prüfung von Leistungsverzeichnissen und weiteren Projektunterlagen wäre ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Bauherren und der Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Projektbeteiligten würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern. Unsere Benefits: Attraktive Vergütung & Urlaub: Je nach Erfahrung liegt das Bruttojahresgehalt zwischen 65.000 und 75.000 Euro. Dich erwarten außerdem 30 Tage Jahresurlaub. Flexibles & familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, keine Schichtarbeit sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten. Mobilität & Zusatzleistungen: Fahrtkostenerstattung, Poolfahrzeug, JobRad und Deutschlandticket. Ein Dienstwagen ist bei Vollzeit möglich, auch zur privaten Nutzung; in diesem Fall reduziert sich das Jahresgehalt um etwa 10.000 Euro. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Onboarding & moderne Ausstattung: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding begleitet Deinen Einstieg. Für Deine tägliche Arbeit erhältst Du ein Arbeits-Smartphone und einen Arbeitslaptop. Teamkultur & Weiterentwicklung: Dich erwartet ein kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierarchien sowie regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Außerdem bieten wir Dir eine zukunftssichere Beschäftigung in einem regional verwurzelten Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH. Hospitation/persönliches Kennenlernen mit dem Team aus dem Fachbereich der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH. Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung! Du erreichst das Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe unter Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise bei der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH - Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Die sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH ist Teil der Arsipa Gruppe, einer schnell wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-and-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel ist es, eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt zu werden – unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. description: Service Designer Technology Transformation practice Anywhere in Germany, with travel availability Consultant/Senior Consultant About Us You want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready? Our solutions focus on the big-ticket value items on the C-Suite agenda, providing a deep link between business and IT to help you lead with influence beyond the back-office remit. For more information and details on the services we provide and the clients we serve, please visit or careers page. The role As a Service Designer at Infosys Consulting, you help our clients understand what their customers really need and turn those insights into services that work seamlessly across every touchpoint – digital and physical, frontstage and backstage. You make the entire customer journey smooth and enjoyable for users and successful for the business, driving satisfaction, retention and long-term growth. You bring a solid foundation in human-centered design, CX strategy and digital transformation, and you understand how service experiences connect to the client’s marketing, CRM, customer care and operations. Working directly with client stakeholders, you lay the groundwork for a holistic service and CX strategy, establish standards, processes and ways of working, and build the client’s own capability. Key Responsibilities : Service & CX Strategy Define a service vision and CX strategy that delivers consistent, high-quality experiences across all channels and aligns with business objectives. Translate business goals into service principles, experience goals and measurable KPIs (e.g. NPS, CSAT, CES, retention) Map and re-orchestrate the service ecosystem along the customer life cycle using ecosystem maps and stakeholder maps Develop service propositions and value propositions together with business owners Define the roadmap of guidelines, trainings and key projects needed to realize the strategy Shape the target operating model and team structure for service design and CX on the client side Work with leadership to embed Service Design and Design Thinking in the company’s culture Insight Management & Customer Understanding Turn customer data, research and behavior into actionable insights in collaboration with research and analytics teams. Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into personas, jobs-to-be-done, mental models and insight statements Use NPS, satisfaction and operational metrics to assess the current experience and spot patterns, trends and pain points Present data-driven recommendations that improve retention and satisfaction Set up an insight and requirements pipeline that continuously feeds product, channel and solution owners Journey Mapping & Service Blueprinting Make the end-to-end service visible and design how it should work in future – for customers, employees and systems. Facilitate as-is customer journey maps and service blueprints across channels, including frontstage, backstage and supporting processes Identify moments of truth, breakpoints and improvement opportunities online and offline Design to-be journeys and blueprints across multiple applications as well as in depth for specific services Connect journey and blueprint work to process, organizational and technology changes Co-Creation, Ideation & Prototyping Lead the double-diamond process from problem framing to tested solution together with clients and their customers. Plan and facilitate co-creation workshops, design sprints and ideation sessions with cross-functional teams Frame problems with How-Might-We questions, opportunity areas and design challenges Create and test service prototypes – storyboards, service walkthroughs, desktop walkthroughs, role-play and click dummies Run experiments and pilots, measure impact and iterate towards scalable solutions Service Standards & Guidelines Initiate and support standards that ensure high service quality across websites, native apps, phone, email, chat and in-person support. Create service design playbooks, journey and blueprint libraries, persona sets and design principles Establish service standards, benchmarks and end-to-end testing approaches Set up quality assurance processes to monitor and evaluate customer interactions Requirements Degree in Service Design, Interaction/UX Design, Design Management, Business, Psychology or a related field Consultant: 3–5 years of experience in service design, CX or UX, ideally in consulting or an in-house design team Senior Consultant: 5–8 years of experience, including leading projects and client workstreams Hands-on command of core service design methods: stakeholder and ecosystem mapping, personas, customer journey mapping, service blueprinting, co-creation and service prototyping Experience with design research (interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, diary studies) and synthesis (affinity mapping, insight clustering) Ability to link customer insight with business objectives, KPIs and business cases Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder management skills, from operational teams to C-level Confident with collaboration and visualisation tools such as Miro, Mural, Figma or similar Ability to integrate AI tools throughout every stage of the design process, from research and insight generation to ideation, prototyping, testing, and service optimization, enhancing both efficiency and innovation. Excellent communication and storytelling skills in both GERMAN and ENGLISH Preferred/Desirable experience Experience in CX strategy and digital transformation programmes Knowledge of adjacent areas on the client side: marketing, CRM and loyalty, customer care and contact centres Experience designing omnichannel services that combine digital and physical touchpoints Preferred tool proficiency: Miro, Figma, FigJam, Claude Code Familiarity with CX metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES) and Voice-of-Customer programmes Exposure to agile delivery, Lean UX and product operating models Experience applying AI and GenAI in services or CX operations Experience building design capabilities, playbooks or design systems at client organisations Industry experience in e.g. retail, automotive, financial services, telecommunications, utilities or the public sector Certification in Design Thinking, Service Design (e.g. SDN) or agile methods Level differentiation Consultant: delivers service design work within a project, applies methods confidently and facilitates workshops with guidance Senior Consultant: owns workstreams and client relationships, shapes the approach, coaches junior team members and contributes to proposals and business development Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for individuals who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey. Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our . Within Europe, we are recognized as one of the UK’s top firms by the Financial Times and Forbes due to our client innovations, our cultural diversity and dedicated training and career paths. Infosys is on the Germany’s top employers list for 2023. Management Consulting Magazine named us on their list of Best Firms to Work for. Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row. We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal ambitions. Curious to learn more? title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.</p> <p>As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design scalable and resilient systems that can keep up with company growth.</li> <li>Work with application teams to understand their needs and challenges, and help them choose the best way to architect their systems to run well in our Kubernetes environment.</li> <li>Harden the platform against security threats, noisy neighbours, and accidents.</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of our use of resources such as CPU, memory, bandwidth, and storage.</li> <li>Help respond to, resolve, and prevent incidents impacting the platform or our users.</li> <li>Contribute back to the open source community. Some of our favorite open source projects include: Envoy, Contour, Consul, etcd, cdk8s, Cloudprober, Calico, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, and more.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters.</li> <li>Experience operating systems on-premise at scale in roles such as SRE, systems design or architecture.</li> <li>Excellent debugging skills in a Linux environment.</li> <li>Knowledge of how container runtimes work inside of Linux (isolation, storage, and networking).</li> <li>A firm grasp of IP networking including routing and iptables/nftables.</li> <li>Ability to work with codebases in Go, TypeScript, and Bash/shell.</li> <li>The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade-offs, build consensus, and drive the effort to solve the problem.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with building platforms across multiple zones and regions as the foundation for other teams to build distributed highly-available applications.</li> <li>Experience with configuration management frameworks such as SaltStack or Ansible.</li> <li>Experience with continuous deployment tooling like ArgoCD and Argo Rollouts.</li> <li>Operational/administrator experience with etcd, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, CNIs, ClusterAPI, Envoy, and/or Contour.</li> <li>Experience as a user of Prometheus, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Vault, Redis, and/or Consul.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</li> <li>For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - title: Senior Named Account Executive, Digital Native
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Paris, France<br></strong></h3> <hr> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive<strong> </strong>to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree required</strong>, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel</strong> as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.</li> <li><strong>Language Skills: </strong>French & English</li> </ul> The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  </p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.</p> <h3><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT </strong><strong>STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY</strong><strong>  </strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a talented <strong>Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer</strong> with a drive to build quality products.</p> <p>This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.</p> <p>Based in Cologne, you will be a key player in the Engineering team working on the IMPECT family of applications. You’ll contribute to IMPECT’s internal services that power our data ecosystem, sourcing and managing data from external providers, ingesting and recording video content, and enabling large-scale event collection and annotation. You’ll also help build and evolve the systems that support our data collection workforce, including tools for task assignment, progress tracking, deadline management, quality assurance, and accurate compensation. In addition, you’ll develop database-driven tools that ensure consistency and detect anomalies, safeguarding data quality when integrating multiple data sources. IMPECT’s applications are written in modern frameworks and provide exciting challenges. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you’ll be part of a highly motivated team building and evolving the core services that power our data collection platform, forming the foundation for the applications we deliver to our customers.</p> <p>We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance.  Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.</li> <li>Build and maintain Angular web applications</li> <li>Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications</li> <li>Design and implement database schema</li> <li>Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications</li> <li>Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.</li> <li>Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features</li> <li>Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.</li> <li>Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of software development experience.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular</li> <li>Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin or Java.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema</li> <li>Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications</li> <li>Experience with Git code management is highly desired.</li> </ul> <p>Other Requirements:</p> <ul> <li>Very strong attention to detail.</li> <li>Proven self-starter.</li> <li>Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise and a “can-do” attitude.</li> <li>Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></p> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability </li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better.  There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! </p> <p>Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> <p><br><br></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Affiliate Manager
description: About Ledger We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. Ledger is seeking a sales-driven Senior Affiliate Manager for our Performance Marketing team. In this role, you'll drive Ledger's market growth by recruiting affiliates, showcasing our product benefits, and building strong partnerships. Responsibilities Overall in this role, you'll drive Ledger's market growth by recruiting affiliates, showcasing our product benefits, and building strong partnerships. 1. Key Account Management & Revenue Growth (50%) Revenue Ownership: Own the revenue target for your partner portfolio and report against it every week. Account Planning: Build growth plans for top partners, covering placements and promo participation. Turn transactional relationships into long-term strategic alliances. Promotional Alignment: Drive partner participation in Ledger's global commercial calendar (e.g., Product Launches, Black Friday, gated affiliate promos) to maximize share of voice. Retention: Spot declining accounts early and act before revenue drops. 2. New Business & Deal Closing (50%) Pipeline Building: Map the ecosystem to identify Tier 1 partners currently outside Ledger's network, with a focus on AI tools and fintech apps. Commercial Negotiation: Lead the end-to-end sales cycle, from first contact to signed contract. Autonomously approach industry leaders and structure the commercial agreement. Event Strategy: Represent Ledger at premier industry conferences (e.g., Token2049, Paris Blockchain Week) to source and close new partners. 3. Commercial Strategy & Financial Modeling Business Planning (BP): Develop tailored Business Plans for strategic partnerships and take each deal through finance validation. Profitability Analysis: Model complex deal structures (e.g., Hybrid CPA + Revenue Share) and defend their ROI to ensure sustainable partnership growth. Program Input: Bring field insight into the evolution of the affiliate program, including new payout models beyond hardware rev. share. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years in Affiliate Marketing or Business Development, with a track record of owning and beating a revenue target. Strong preference for FinTech or Cryptocurrency sectors. Sales DNA: Proven ability to close commission-based deals and defend margin in negotiation. Comfortable prospecting and handling rejection. Seniority: Experience managing a high-revenue partner portfolio with minimal supervision. Language Skills: Fluent English is mandatory. French is an advantage. AI-savvy: Demonstrated proficiency in using AI tools to optimize daily workflows. You must be capable of leveraging it for everyday efficiency. Bonus Points Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of the cryptocurrency ecosystem and self-custody principles. Network: Established professional network of crypto affiliates and creators. At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to: Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance. title: Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) Administrator - Infrastructure Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Atlanta, US</li> <li>Denver, US</li> <li>Washington DC, US</li> <li>Austin, US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until November 23, 2026.</strong></p> <h4>About the Role</h4> <p>We are seeking a DCIM Administrator to build and run our Data Center Infrastructure Management program.  This technical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running one of the world's largest and most important cloud networks. Cloudflare’s global network spans more than 330 cities, and is a key strategic asset that supports all of our customers and products.</p> <p>You are the operational backbone and workflow gatekeeper for all physical changes across our global network. Your meticulous work ensures every Move, Add, and Change (MAC) is executed only through a validated Nlyte work order, driving the highest level of data accuracy essential for supporting our edge and core security and performance services.</p> <p>We operate in a fast-paced environment where you will be expected to drive both project delivery and operational excellence through continuous improvement, standardization, and optimization. This isn't just about day to day operations; it's about building a scalable, performant, secure, and resilient infrastructure that plays a critical role in us building a better Internet.</p> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Assist with the successful deployment of CAPEX investments, ensuring our infrastructure scales ahead of demand.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional partners including Project Managers, Capacity Planning, Finance, and Security to deliver on ambitious group initiatives.</li> <li>Manage key third-party vendors and contractors, holding them accountable for performance and service level agreements (SLAs).</li> <li>Be a role model and champion for continuous improvement, standardization, optimization, and automation.</li> <li>Workflow Execution: Administer and manage the Nlyte Workflow/Work Order processes, including; issuing, tracking, and closing all physical MAC tickets.</li> <li>Enforce strict adherence to the defined process by global technicians.</li> <li>Data Integrity Champion: Perform daily data entry, manage automated asset discovery tools, and reconcile physical inventory against Nlyte records to guarantee 99.5%+ accuracy.</li> <li>Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM): Own the entire asset data chain from receiving (scanning/logging) through deployment and decommissioning.</li> <li>Model Library Management: Maintain the Nlyte Materials Catalog, ensuring all new hardware models have precise, validated resource profiles (power, cooling, rack elevations) to enable Analyst validation.</li> <li>Field Training & Support: Provide hands-on training and support for global technicians on using the Nlyte mobile app, scanning tools, and required workflow procedures.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <ul> <li>You are a DCIM expert, highly organized and efficient operator.   You have a track record of driving operational excellence through establishing and enforcing standard operating procedures and continuous improvement efforts. You are passionate about asset management and obsessed over data accuracy.  This role is for hands-on asset and infrastructure administrators who can rapidly learn, adapt, and apply learnings to enable fast and sustainable growth. You thrive in a hyper-growth environment and have an outstanding ability to get things done under pressure while maintaining optimism and grit.</li> <li>You are Transparent; you ensure every physical action is accurately logged and instantly visible to stakeholders globally.  You are Principled; you have an uncompromising commitment to data integrity and refuse to bypass established workflows.</li> <li>Education: <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Logistics, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience: <ul> <li>4+ years of hands-on experience in IT Asset Management or DCIM administration (Nlyte experience is a strong advantage).</li> <li>Direct experience administering a workflow or change management system, with a focus on discipline and process enforcement in a multi-site environment.</li> <li>Experience with change management in ERP and asset management transformation efforts.</li> <li>Experience operating in a high-velocity environment involving geographic dispersed Data Centers across various time zones.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Technical Competencies: <ul> <li>High proficiency in physical inventory control, including barcode/RFID systems.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with data center infrastructure, including server hardware, network hardware, rack elevation/density, and power distribution</li> <li>Knowledge of structured cabling, and cabling standards.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) or basic SQL.</li> <li>Expert in workflow Management (MAC Process): Proven experience managing a high-volume Move, Add, Change queue.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Soft Skills: <ul> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities.</li> <li>Meticulous Attention to Detail: A "Zero-Defect" mindset regarding data entry.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills.</li> <li>Documentation & SOP Creation: Experience writing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for remote hands technicians.</li> <li>Remote Training Ability: Experience training or guiding remote teams.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $98,000 - $135,000</li> <li>For Remote - Washington and Washington (Kirkland) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $120,000 - $165,000</li> <li>For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $120,000 - $165,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration.
