title: Enterprise Core Sales Engineer - France
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc. Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team. In this role, you will: Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform. Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform. Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows. Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs. Have the ability to be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches. Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base. Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement. Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 2+ years of pre-sales experience Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations. Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems. Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems. Fluent in English. Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT and/or Value Selling sales concepts. Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages. An ideal candidate also has: Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, Fleet or general operations background a huge plus Previous experience working in a Fleet Sales environment Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications. Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.) Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc. Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team. In this role, you will: Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform. Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform. Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows. Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs. Have the ability to be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches. Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base. Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement. Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 2+ years of pre-sales experience Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations. Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems. Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems. Fluent in English. Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT and/or Value Selling sales concepts. Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages. An ideal candidate also has: Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, Fleet or general operations background a huge plus Previous experience working in a Fleet Sales environment Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications. Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.) Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. description: 1KOMMA5° Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei? Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move. As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better. Tech stack Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs. What you will do Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends. Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners. Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters. Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly. Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on. Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production. Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback. Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore. In your first six months, you might Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers. What you bring At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails. Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes. Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS. Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own. Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan. Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you. A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones. Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must. You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense. Experience in trading, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech or other domains where data errors cost money is a bonus. In this role, you will combine strong technical abilities with excellent communication skills, working directly with customers to ensure they maximize the value of HappyRobot’s AI platform. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation. At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You’ll Do Customer-Facing Engineering – Work closely with customers from onboarding to ongoing usage, helping them integrate and optimize our AI solutions. Technical Development – Build new features, MVPs, and scalable solutions that directly impact customer outcomes. Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools. Integration & APIs – Manage APIs and integrations with third-party systems to ensure seamless functionality for customers. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. Talent Density and Meritocracy Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win. First-Principles Thinking Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not. What’s worth knowing Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites. So this probably isn't for you if: You want a settled process to run. You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way. You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work. You need a clear path with little ambiguity. What you'll bring You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted. You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view. You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it. You're fluent in English. German is a plus. It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way. How we hire A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron. A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager. A practical exercise: 60 minutes with one of our technical hiring managers, to work through a live role-intake and search calibration meeting to assess how you apply your knowledge, work directly with a key stakeholder and how you get to the most effective outcome together. **You can also have an informal coffee with the other team members at any point. Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed. If you've read this far and you're already thinking about what you'd change first, we'd like to hear from you! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Management : vous encadrez les équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance, et vous pilotez les prestataires intervenant sur le site. Capacité à réaliser et challenger des études de faisabilité, des prédimensionnements, des test fits, des bilans de puissance et des estimations économiques. title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description: TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies. Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Ce que nous vous offrons Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs). Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière. Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement. Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation. Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! TOPCHRONO s’engage en faveur de l’inclusion et de l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Tous nos postes leur sont ouverts. Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC. Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils. Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées. Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée. Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température). ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations. RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). En externe • Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques • Prestataires de métrologie • Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques. PROFIL RECHERCHE Formation • Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent. Expérience • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire. • Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne. Compétences techniques • Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision. • Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid. • Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15- 140 / COFRAC). • Analyse de données de température. • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique. Qualités personnelles • Sens de l'organisation. • Rigueur et méthode. • Esprit d'analyse. • Capacité de prise de décision. • Aisance relationnelle. • Force de proposition. • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs. • Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence. Objectifs du poste • Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules. • Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique. • Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température. • Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport. • Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Responsable qualité H/F
description: L’entreprise Acteur industriel reconnu sur son marché, notre client conçoit et fabrique des produits reconnus pour leur qualité, en s’appuyant sur un savoir-faire technique et exigeant. Dans un contexte de structuration et d’amélioration continue, il recherche aujourd’hui son/sa futur(e) Responsable Qualité. Le poste Rattaché(e) à la Direction Générale, vous êtes responsable de la performance et de la conformité qualité sur l’ensemble du cycle de production, depuis le contrôle des flux entrants jusqu’à la validation des produits finis. Vous intervenez de manière transversale en lien étroit avec les équipes production, méthodes, amélioration continue, bureau d’études, service après-vente et achats afin de sécuriser les produits et fiabiliser les processus. Vous encadrez une équipe d’une dizaine de collaborateurs composée de contrôleurs et techniciens qualité, que vous accompagnez au quotidien dans le développement de leurs compétences et dans la montée en exigence des pratiques. Au-delà du pilotage des fondamentaux de la fonction, tels que la définition de la politique qualité, le suivi des non-conformités, la mise en place de plans d’actions et le suivi des indicateurs de performance, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la structuration du service qualité. À ce titre, vous contribuez activement à l’harmonisation des pratiques, au déploiement d’outils adaptés et à la diffusion d’une culture qualité au sein de l’entreprise. title: Senior Business Security Consultant
description: About Northwave Defending the digital frontier is our mission. At Northwave, 275 cybersecurity specialists transform how organisations approach digital safety. From our HQ in Utrecht, our DACH HQ in Leipzig and offices in Austria, Sweden, and Belgium. Northwave combines ethical hacking expertise with behavioral psychology insights and cutting-edge security management at the highest level. We respond to threats and anticipate them, providing 24/7 managed security services and tailored solutions for each client's journey. By joining Northwave, you’ll become part of an organisation where innovation drives results, whether your talents lie in technical penetration testing or strategic client partnerships. Here, your expertise will grow and help shape the future of digital security across industries, leaving a lasting impact. Your Mission As a Senior Business Security Consultant , you act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner for our clients. You help organizations navigate their digital transformation in a secure, resilient, and sustainable way. By connecting business objectives with cybersecurity challenges, you translate regulatory requirements and evolving threat landscapes into practical strategies that create measurable business value. Drawing on your experience, you quickly understand complex organizational structures, identify both risks and opportunities, and engage with senior decision-makers as a trusted sparring partner. You take ownership of challenging client engagements, lead projects independently from initial concept through successful delivery, and ensure that recommendations are not only designed but also effectively embedded within the organization. Your projects cover a broad range of topics, including security strategy, risk management, compliance frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001, as well as Northwave's comprehensive Managed Security Services. In this role, you work with mid-sized and large organizations across the DACH region, supporting them in their cybersecurity and business transformation initiatives. As a Senior Consultant, you bring together Northwave's various areas of expertise. You coordinate collaboration between technical, behavioral, and incident response teams, provide functional leadership within multidisciplinary project teams, and ensure that individual measures are integrated into coherent and effective security programs. In addition, you actively contribute to the growth and development of our consulting business. You identify emerging client needs, participate in sales and business development activities, and leverage your expertise to expand our service portfolio. At the same time, you mentor and support colleagues, foster knowledge sharing, and help strengthen the capabilities of the consulting team as a whole. What You Enjoy Analyzing complex business models, industry-specific requirements, and organizational challenges, and translating these insights into tailored security strategies. Leading and successfully delivering large-scale, complex consulting and transformation projects with a high degree of ownership and accountability. Translating evolving threat landscapes and regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001 into practical and actionable strategic roadmaps. Advising and challenging executive leadership teams, board members, and other senior stakeholders on cybersecurity-related decisions. Providing guidance, coaching, and functional leadership to colleagues within project teams while actively promoting knowledge sharing across the organization. Facilitating workshops, executive presentations, and strategic decision-making processes at management and board level. Identifying business opportunities and actively contributing to sales, proposal development, and business development activities. Collaborating with interdisciplinary experts to design innovative and effective security solutions for our clients. Continuously expanding your cybersecurity expertise and contributing to the strategic direction and development of our consulting practice. What you can expect from us First things first: You will get 30 days' holiday per year and we contribute a minimum of 20% to your company pension plan (bAV). You can organise your own working hours in consultation with your colleagues and customers. A mobility budget , also for private use, makes trips to your customers easier. Of course, we also pay travelling allowances. What do you want to achieve and what support do you need? You will receive regular training and support in achieving your professional goals. You can also develop further within Northwave. It is important to us to respect and value each other - as professionals and as people. The best way to get to know your 275+ colleagues from the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Belgium and Sweden is to take part in one of our many activities , such as a trip to the theme park. You will be equipped with a modern MacBook and iPhone . We have height-adjustable desks in our offices and our CEO loves to kit us out with merchandise ;-) what else... No, the fruit basket in the office is not a benefit for us, but a matter of course - just like coffee, tea and lemonade. Have you ever tried Dutch caramel waffles? Consulting Expertise: You bring extensive experience in cybersecurity and/or management consulting and have successfully managed complex transformation and advisory projects in client-facing environments. Trusted Advisor Mindset: You are comfortable challenging and advising executive stakeholders, earning credibility quickly and acting as a trusted advisor throughout strategic decision-making processes. Commercial Awareness: You combine a strong consulting mindset with commercial acumen, helping to identify opportunities, shape client engagements, and support business growth initiatives. Leadership & Mentoring: You enjoy sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues, and contributing to the development of high-performing consulting teams. Languages: Full professional proficiency in German and English is required. Interested? If you are still not sure, see what Working at Northwave looks like. And when you are ready to come on board, we are looking forward to your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Business Performance Analyst (all genders)
description: Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich. Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten. Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen. AI-native arbeiten AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse. Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten. Das bringst du mit 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach. Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau. Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast. Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen. Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen. Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern. Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln. Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt. Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München. UNSERE BENEFITS Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. title: Senior Named Account Executive - Digital Natives and Startups, Benelux
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Available Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands</span></strong></p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during executive business reviews.</li> <li>Multi-thread across business units, engineering, security and finance leaders in each account to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Share best practices, mentor more junior team members and contribute to the playbooks that help the wider team succeed.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years of sales experience selling B2B SaaS, cloud or infrastructure technology, including experience owning named accounts</li> <li>Strong B2B discovery skills</li> <li>Candidates have a point of view on industry trends and are able to customize a client-centric "why change" narrative</li> <li>Proven track record of consistently exceeding annual quota and successfully managing complex six- and seven-figure deals</li> <li>Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle</li> <li>Experience selling to Digital Native, scale-up or high-growth technology companies is strongly preferred</li> <li>Knowledge of the Benelux technology and venture ecosystem</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Fluency in English and Dutch;</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> <li>Ability to travel as needed within Benelux and occasionally across EMEA</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">For Netherlands based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €169,000 - €232,000.</p> <p data-path-to-node="2">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3><strong>Equity</strong></h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Benefits vary by country; your recruiter will share the details that apply to your location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: About the team You'll join the Sell Online Tribe, the group shaping how merchants bring their businesses to life online. We design and build tools that help millions of entrepreneurs, from barbers to bakers, sell their products and services anywhere. You'll be working on some of SumUp's biggest merchant-facing online products as part of the Bifrost team, contributing to growing and scaling critical products like Payment Links and Gift Cards, while also working on integration products that provide essential features used across many other SumUp products. They're high-traffic, high-responsibility products that other SumUp teams depend on too. You'll join a small, cross-functional team and take on genuine ownership of the frontend - not just executing tickets, but shaping how the products evolve. title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon, Portugal </p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical Support Engineer for Zero Trust </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, Cloudflare Tunnels, Cloudflare WAN and the Cloudflare One client (formerly known as Cloudflare WARP client).</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.</li> <li>Communicating and working directly with the customers via phone, video conference (ie Zoom, Google Meet), chat and tickets in Salesforce</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.</li> <li>Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.</li> <li>Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Availability to work the weekend shift (Saturday & Sunday)</li> <li>You have a minimum of 3 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IdP, IAM, SCIM) systems, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, Ping, etc. Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC)</li> <li>Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience). This may also include specialized bootcamps. </li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.</li> <li>Experience with building projects on Cloudflare or using Cloudflare Products.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €37,000 - €51,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager
description: The Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager owns the standard, performance and quality of the Autoreverse process, from vehicle receipt through initial disassembly and handover to downstream activities. The role supports the four Operations sites, works daily with the Operations Managers and interfaces with the Product Manager to ensure that process, quality and product requirements are aligned. The objective is to deliver a safe, repeatable and scalable process for the A2MAC1 Data Factory. The role contributes to the Operations 2030 plan with the Transformation Project Team and helps build a common quality logic across processes and sites, based on shared principles, standards, routines and performance measures. As Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager your main challenges will be to: Standardize the Autoreverse process and quality expectations across four Operations sites. Improve first-time-right performance while protecting safety, throughput and delivery. Reduce rework, damage, missing parts and process variation. Build a common performance and quality baseline with comparable data across sites. Prepare the process for higher volumes, new vehicle architectures and Operations 2030. RESPONSABILITIES 1. Process Standards and Methods Own and maintain the end-to-end Autoreverse standard operating model. Define standard work, process instructions, checklists and escalation rules for the four sites. Ensure that process interfaces with scanning, photography, Advanced Services and data preparation are clearly defined. Identify and deploy practical improvements in methods, tools, workstation organization and flow. 2. Quality and Continuous Improvement Define quality criteria and monitor defects, rework, missing components, damage and deviations. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action plans with Operations and Quality. Verify the effectiveness of actions and prevent recurrence through standardization and error-proofing. Promote a first-time-right culture in all four sites. 3. Operations Performance Define and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, lead time, throughput, productivity, rework and cost per vehicle. Run regular performance reviews with the Operations Managers and escalate risks or gaps. Use data to prioritize improvement actions and compare performance across sites. Support daily operations when process or quality issues require technical analysis. 4. International Coordination and Deployment Coordinate the consistent deployment of process and quality standards across the four Operations sites. Build a common operating rhythm for process reviews, audits, lessons learned and action tracking. Develop and deploy common quality principles, standards, routines and indicators across processes and sites. Share best practices between sites and support local teams during implementation and ramp-up. Account for local constraints while protecting the global process standard. 5. Product and Industrialization Interface Work with the Product Manager to translate product and vehicle evolution into operational process requirements. Assess the impact of new vehicle architectures, components and product changes on Autoreverse methods and quality. Provide operational input to new tools, equipment, software, automation and Data Factory initiatives. Validate that solutions are practical, safe, cost-effective and scalable before wider deployment. 6. Operations 2030 and Transformation Contribution Contribute to the Operations 2030 roadmap with the Transformation Project Team and the Global Process Transformation Manager. Translate transformation priorities into practical process, quality and capability improvements for Autoreverse. Support POQs and improvement initiatives that can be standardized and deployed across the four sites. Provide operational feedback on automation, digitalization and Data Factory initiatives. 7. Team Capability, Safety and Governance Train and coach teams on standard work, quality requirements and safe operating practices. Develop competency assessments and practical onboarding for critical Autoreverse activities. Identify process, quality and safety risks and coordinate mitigation actions. Maintain clear documentation and ensure that process changes are communicated and implemented. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations management or a related discipline. Professional background: Approximately 5 years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, industrial operations, quality or process improvement. Experience in a hands-on production, workshop, laboratory or technical operating environment. Experience with quality tools, process audits, structured problem solving and corrective action plans. Experience coordinating improvement activities across several teams or sites is preferred. International exposure: Experience working with multicultural teams or across multiple operating locations. Lean, Six Sigma, quality or project management certification is an advantage. SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES Hands-on operational leadership in an industrial or technical environment. Strong quality and continuous improvement mindset, with practical root-cause and corrective-action experience. Ability to standardize processes and deploy them consistently across multiple sites. Analytical approach to KPIs, process performance and operational problem solving. Ability to work effectively with Operations Managers, Product, Quality and technical teams. Structured, pragmatic and able to influence without relying only on formal authority. Professional English; French or another A2MAC1 operating language is an advantage. title: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer (Azure) - H/F

title: Auditeur préleveur (H/F) en restauration collective
description: Le Groupe QUALTECH - 5 sociétés, 7 sites et 350 salariés - est un regroupement de Laboratoires spécialisés dans les analyses de laboratoire (microbiologie, biologie moléculaire, chimie, extraction d’ADN, etc), le conseil, la recherche et la formation. Notre but est de garantir une expertise qualitative à nos clients en termes de contrôle, de qualité et de fiabilité dans le secteur de l’agro-alimentaire. Nos valeurs : intégrité, innovation, expertise, engagement, orientation client. En rejoignant son laboratoire AGROBIO spécialisé en microbiologie, vous participez à son expertise dans le monde de la recherche et de l’analyse agro-alimentaire. title: Strategic Account Director, Developer Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Over time, the largest of these accounts will move to a dedicated 1:1 model. You'll partner with the account team to guide strategic decisions, lead engagement with key executives, and bring developer fluency married to deep business acumen.</p> <p>You'll collaborate as a peer with Cloudflare's sales leadership and work closely with Solutions Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineers, and Product. You are fluent in both developer workloads and commercial mechanics. You can set a multi-year account strategy in the morning and work through a live deal in the afternoon.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architect the account strategy.</strong> Build and execute a multi-year Developer Platform plan for each account: defining priority workloads, how adoption grows, competitive position, and the commercial path to get there.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate the customer journey (drive activation → expansion → commercial structure):</strong> Use usage telemetry to find next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks. Compete credibly against hyperscalers and other platforms.</li> <li><strong>Lead executive engagement.</strong> Build trusted relationships with CTOs and heads of infrastructure, AI, and engineering, as well as the commercial decision makers. Run impactful executive business reviews and leverage Cloudflare leadership at the right moments.</li> <li><strong>Mobilize Cloudflare.</strong> Align the account team, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Product, and Support on the account's priorities, establishing clear owners and driving flawless follow-through. Run GTM motions in step with the workloads where we've proven fit.</li> <li><strong>Close the loop with Product.</strong> Turn what you see in the account into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, limits, and roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the field:</strong> Turn your account experience into workload blueprints, deal patterns, and playbooks. Coach sales leaders and account teams in a train-the-trainer model to scale your impact globally..</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years in technology sales, including senior sales leadership (Director, VP, or CRO) or strategic named-account roles at developer-platform or consumption-based companies, such as AWS, GCP, Vercel, MongoDB, Databricks, Snowflake, or an AI lab.</li> <li>A track record of growing consumption and revenue in large, complex, highly technical accounts over consecutive years.</li> <li>Executive presence and credibility with C-level and VP audiences at the fastest-moving technology companies.</li> <li>The ability to turn technical workloads into compelling commercial outcomes, and to navigate complex deal approvals with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Security.</li> <li>Deep experience with usage-based pricing and commit structures.</li> <li>Analytical rigor: you can read product usage telemetry and size opportunities at the level of Sheets or SQL.</li> <li>A clear persuasive writer and presenter, equally effective with developer ICs and executive sponsors.</li> <li>A builder's mindset: you lead through influence and get cross-functional work done without relying on hierarchy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling to, or working inside, frontier AI labs or AI-native companies.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure workloads such as inference, agents, sandboxed code execution, large-scale storage, and globally distributed apps.</li> <li>Former startup CROs, sales leaders, and founders who thrive in hands-on environments</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with Cloudflare's Developer Platform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health &
