</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">A career that’s the whole package!</span></strong></p> <p>At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Conga</strong> lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.</span></p></div><p><strong>Location</strong>: Switzerland (remote) </p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>RVP Sales </p> <p><strong>Travel: </strong>within DACH </p> <p><strong>Languages: </strong>native/C2 level French and English </p> <p>  </p> <p><strong>A Quick Snapshot…..</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you'll be at the forefront of our revenue growth strategy, driving both new business acquisition and the expansion of existing enterprise accounts across key strategic industries in the DACH region. You will build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, understand complex business challenges, and position Conga's enterprise-wide solutions to deliver measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>Working closely with Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Transformation Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partners, and clients, you will manage the full sales lifecycle from prospecting through close. This role is focused on 40% new business generation and 60% growth within existing customers.</p> <p><strong>Why it's a big deal…</strong></p> <p>You'll have the opportunity to sell high-impact, mission-critical transformation initiatives that create substantial value for enterprise organizations. You will develop and execute territory, account, and opportunity plans, engage senior decision-makers, and lead complex sales cycles to drive predictable revenue growth within your assigned region.</p> <p><strong>Are you the person we are looking for?</strong></p> <p><strong>Proven Track Record</strong></p> <p>You have at least 20 years of successful B2B enterprise technology sales experience within the SaaS industry and a strong track record of success in DACH.</p> <ul> <li>Acts as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, aligning business challenges with measurable commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Consistently exceeds quota within complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environments.</li> <li>Builds and leverages executive, customer, partner, and ecosystem relationships to create, accelerate, and expand strategic opportunities.</li> <li>Demonstrates strong knowledge of AI, automation, and revenue management trends, effectively translating these into customer value and business outcomes.</li> <li>Drives predictable revenue growth through strategic account planning, executive engagement, and value-based selling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Hunter Mentality</strong></p> <p>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for identifying, pursuing, and winning new business opportunities. Through persistence, strategic thinking, and strong commercial acumen, you consistently create pipeline and close high-value enterprise deals.</p> <p><strong>Solution Selling</strong></p> <p>You take a consultative approach to understanding customer challenges, business priorities, and strategic objectives. You effectively position Conga's solutions and services, clearly articulating value and demonstrating how they help customers achieve their desired outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Drive</strong></p> <p>You proactively leverage available resources and take ownership of results. You are highly motivated, resilient, and committed to achieving success regardless of the challenges encountered along the way.</p> <p><strong>Communication</strong></p> <p>You can articulate complex technology concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You possess excellent listening, presentation, and negotiation skills, enabling you to address objections, build credibility, and influence stakeholders at every level.</p> <p><strong>Growth Mindset</strong></p> <p>You embrace change and continuously adapt to evolving market conditions, customer priorities, and competitive dynamics. You are innovative in your approach and seek new ways to create value for customers and the business.</p> <p><strong>Collaboration</strong></p> <p>You work effectively across cross-functional teams including Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partners to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You have the leadership presence and influence to align stakeholders, mobilize resources, and drive successful business results.</p> <p><strong>What will give you an edge...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling Revenue Lifecycle Management solutions with strong knowledge of CPQ, CLM, revenue optimization, document generation, and e-signature products.</li> <li>Education and/or experience in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Accounting, Marketing, Finance, or Operations Research is considered a plus.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Did we pique your interest? </strong> </p> <p>If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We'd love to hear from you! </span></p> <p><strong>Preferred Resume Format</strong> </p> <p>We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly. </p> <p><strong>Don’t meet every requirement for the role?</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong> </p> <p>Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.  </p> <div> <section id="st-additionalInformation" class="job-section"> <div> <h2 class="title">Additional Information</h2> </div> <div class="wysiwyg"> <p>Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.</p> </div> </section> </div> <section class="job-apply print-hidden"></section> <p><strong>Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement </strong></p> <p>The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (<a href="https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement">https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement</a>). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Designer (B2C)
description: Change the way the world travels Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step. Team mission Our Product Design team shapes how millions of travelers find, book, and enjoy activities, and how our supplier partners run their business on GetYourGuide. We combine strategic thinking, customer insight, and a high craft bar to make every step of the journey clear, trustworthy, and a little bit delightful. Within the team, the Ontrip group designs the support and communication experiences that connect travelers, suppliers, and customer care before, during, and after a trip. It's a mobile-first, high-stakes space with many stakeholders and plenty of open questions. As Staff Product Designer, you'll set the direction for these channels, see the in-flight redesign and brand refresh through to a polished result, and raise the design quality and standards for the whole group. Your mission Lead the design strategy and experience for the channels that connect travelers, suppliers, and customer care, from vision through shipped product. Land the in-flight communication redesign and the brand refresh across Ontrip, so the experience feels cohesive and unmistakably GetYourGuide. Shape the long-term vision for on-trip and manage design dependencies across adjacent groups. Make sense of ambiguous problems, and use future thinking to turn them into bold directions teams can actually build. Partner with product, engineering, research, and operations to align a wide set of stakeholders around clear decisions. Present your work and rationale in executive-level reviews, and bring senior leaders along with you. Design mobile-first for travelers but think beyond traditional surfaces and processes as supplier communication can involve different channels Raise the craft bar for the group through critique, clear standards, and mentoring other designers. Work in the open with AI tools, using them to explore faster, prototype sooner, and improve and raise the quality of what ships. Your toolkit Extensive experience designing complex, mobile-first products, with a portfolio that shows both strategic thinking and polished UI craft. Experience owning design across multiple teams or a product area A track record of leading ambiguous, cross-cutting problems and turning them into direction that teams can build against. Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to build alignment across many teams and explain your rationale clearly to executives. Experience setting and raising the quality bar for a design team through critique, mentoring, and leading by example. Deep understanding of experimentation. You work with research and analytics to validate hypotheses. Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows. You use AI tools consistently and effectively in your work and to drive innovation in UX, such as Claude and Figma Make, with concrete examples of how AI has improved your efficiency, quality, or impact. How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with a quarterly team event budget Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them Monthly transportation and fitness budget Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities Language reimbursement program Health and wellness benefits And more… How to apply Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘ how we hire ’ and ‘ our culture ’. description: Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better. Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care. Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time. Want to shape the future of healthcare? Join us ! Discover our company culture and values Here is a product teaser Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog ) Context We’re experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem, and we’re targeting €30M ARR by end of 2027. To get there, we need to triple the sales team while increasing productivity, and therefore the ARR signed per account executive. Your Mission At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which the sales team has tripled in size and increased ARR per sales rep by 50% (from €400K to €600K). To achieve this, you own Business & Revenue Operations end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Ops, Finance and Product. You report to Robin, Head of RevOps, and work hand in hand with the Head of Sales, your main internal client. Beyond the revenue engine, you are the go-to partner of leadership on revenue decisions: segmentation and targeting, pricing, sales capacity planning, and the operational setup of our US expansion. You turn ambiguous questions into structured, data-backed recommendations, then you build the solution yourself. This is an A-to-Z, hands-on role. You define the strategy, build, run, document and iterate. Responsibilities Sales & GTM Ops Own the CRM (Attio): pipeline structure, stages, fields, hygiene Define and track funnel metrics (SQL, win rate, cycle length, ARR) Build deal workflows, pricing logic and approvals Support sales with clean data, dashboards and forecasts Instrument meetings, calls, emails and demos in the CRM Define activity standards, ensure data completeness, provide visibility on activity vs results Implement compensation rules as the single source of truth; automate calculations, reporting and payout exports; make sure numbers are clear, trusted and undisputed Own the sales tool stack (demo platform, telephony, call recording, integrations): reliability, adoption and proper usage across the team Onboarding & Delivery Ops Structure deployment workflows (from signed deal to live) Track time-to-live, blockers and handoffs Standardize configs, templates and playbooks Billing & Revenue Own the contracts → billing → cash collection flow Work with tools like Hyperline, Stripe and invoicing Track MRR, ARR, churn, expansion and cohorts Ensure pricing is applied correctly (per site, per provider, per call) Revenue Analytics & Strategic Projects Build weekly and monthly revenue dashboards Track unit economics (ARPA, gross margin, CAC, LTV) Lead ad hoc analyses for leadership: market segmentation, territory design, pricing, capacity planning Surface issues early. No surprises. Process & Documentation Write everything down (Notion) Create SOPs so the company doesn’t rely on tribal knowledge Make the org scalable from [25] to 100+ people This role is for you if 3–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps in a SaaS / startup that scaled Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation) Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR. You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven You're comfortable working directly with founders You care about data, but even more about things actually working Fluent in French, Professional English Benefits Equity (BSPCE) Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays). Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote. MacBook provided. Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company). EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib). Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered. Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered. Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year. Recruitment process 1️⃣ Discovery call (30 min) with our Talent Acquisition Manager 2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of Revops 3️⃣ Case study (1hr) with Alexandre, and Robin 3️⃣ Culture / founder fit (1hr) with Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team 4️⃣ Reference check 5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉 We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout. Why should you join Vocca? An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team A product already live , with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI) A true scaling phase , with everything still to build Real responsibilities from day one We hire people, not roles. If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise. We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs. Why This Role Matters Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions. Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines. Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts. Organizational Structure: The Four Domains You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas: Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements. Core Accountabilities 1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities. AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows. Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity. Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access. 2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls. Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly. Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor. 3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection. Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function. Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter. DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting. Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets. Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors. 4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team. Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines. Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board. 12-Month Success Metrics: Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company. Candidate Profile: Practitioner Foundations: Proven background as a hands-on security practitioner (e.g., former security engineer, AppSec specialist, cloud security architect, or technical penetration tester) who has advanced into security leadership. Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert. Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks. AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks. Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks. FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR). Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains. Bonus: Industry certifications reflecting technical or managerial competence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP). Direct experience securing real-time event-streaming architectures. German language proficiency (conversational or fluent) is a strong advantage. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. title: AI Solutions Engineer
description: Waarom deze rol bestaat De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen. Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn. Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft. AI schrijft bij ons veel. Verantwoordelijkheid kun je niet uitbesteden. Alles wat jouw naam draagt, heb je zelf gelezen, gecontroleerd en begrepen voordat het de deur uitgaat. Taken Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei. Wij bouwen Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope. Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van. De klant bouwt, wij borgen Bij een groeiend deel van onze klanten bouwt hun eigen team met Claude Code, Codex en Cursor. Wij reviewen elke pull request, tekenen elke release en zetten de productieomgeving op, volgens onze standaarden en zonder dat ze erop hoeven wachten. Daar is je rol anders. Je zit bij hun product owners, delivery lead en developers aan tafel, je kijkt kritisch mee met wat ze maken, en jij borgt dat het veilig en productiewaardig live komt. Je bouwt minder zelf en je beoordeelt meer. Dat vraagt dat je kunt uitleggen waarom iets niet deugt zonder dat iemand zich aangevallen voelt, en dat je ze in gewone taal meeneemt in hoe het wel hoort. Je hebt je eigen klantportfolio en bent hun aanspreekpunt binnen SevenLab. Je begeleidt discovery sessies en workshops om tot richting en prioriteiten te komen, en je schat in wat je zelf doet, wat je samen oppakt en wanneer een specialist moet aanhaken. Vereisten Must have meerdere jaren ervaring met het bouwen van webapplicaties of softwareproducten; je hebt zelf software naar productie gebracht die nu live draait en door klanten wordt gebruikt, en je kunt het laten zien; je kunt in een week in je eentje iets werkends neerzetten op echte data, en je weet wat je bewust buiten scope houdt om dat te halen; je hebt eerder in een rol gezeten waarin techniek en klantcontact samenkwamen, en je kunt een klantgesprek leiden en de vraag achter de vraag vinden; je bent kritisch op codekwaliteit, structuur, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid, ook bij code die een AI-tool oplevert. Niets gaat langs jou zonder dat je het hebt getest en beoordeeld; je kunt iets veilig live zetten en live houden: deployment, monitoring, security, en weten wat je doet als het misgaat; je denkt in systemen. Kom je iets voor de derde keer tegen, dan los je het niet voor de derde keer op. Dan bouw je iets zodat het niet meer gebeurt; je zoekt het eerst zelf uit in de documentatie, de code en de logs. Blijft er een vraag over, dan stel je hem met een hypothese erbij zodat de ander in één keer kan antwoorden; je zet vaagheid om in richting, structuur en resultaat; je communiceert scherp: je legt technische keuzes uit aan mensen zonder technische achtergrond, en je geeft feedback op andermans werk zodat ze er wat mee kunnen; professioneel Nederlands en Engels, gesproken en geschreven. Nice to have ervaring met release-governance als specialisme: approvals, signing, rollback; ervaring in gereguleerde sectoren zoals zorg of de publieke sector; open source bijdragen op je naam. Voor wie dit is je wil eigenaar zijn van het hele traject, van eerste gesprek tot wat er live staat, en je vindt het prettig dat het jouw naam is die eraan hangt; snel en goed zijn bij jou geen tegenpolen. Je haalt dat door scope scherp te houden en te weten waar je niet op moet inkorten; je wil voorop lopen, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en wil beter worden dan je gisteren was; je denkt verder dan "kunnen we dit bouwen". Je vraagt je ook af wat het oplevert en wat de slimste route is; als er iets stukgaat, ben jij degene die het meldt voordat iemand het vraagt. Voor wie dit niet is de developer die het liefst de hele dag in zijn editor zit en klantcontact vermijdt; de consultant die adviseert wat een klant moet bouwen en daarna weg is. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk tot en met productie; iemand die veel prototypes maakt die daarna blijven liggen; iemand die de output van een chatbot doorstuurt zonder hem zelf te lezen. AI gebruiken doen we allemaal, de hele dag. Het ongelezen doorgeven van wat eruit komt is iets anders; iemand die een vraag bij een ander neerlegt voordat hij de documentatie heeft opengeslagen of zelf heeft getest. Waar je mee werkt Fullstack JavaScript en TypeScript, Vue en Nuxt, PostgreSQL en Drizzle, Claude Code en vergelijkbare agentic tooling, CI/CD, monitoring. We draaien op NVIDIA-infrastructuur en op Scaleway voor Europese data-residency. We zijn ISO 27001-gecertificeerd en onze klanten zitten in sectoren waar dat niet vrijblijvend is. Benefits veel ruimte voor moderne AI-tooling en nieuwe manieren van software bouwen, en invloed op hoe we oplossingen ontwerpen en opleveren; een team van sterke specialisten waarmee je kunt sparren en waar je op kunt leunen wanneer iets dieper of complexer wordt; bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.300 en €5.600 op basis van 40 uur; 28 vakantiedagen, 10% pensioenregeling en onze Super SevenLab dagen. een omgeving waarin snelheid, kwaliteit en innovatie samenkomen. Ons proces Na je sollicitatie plannen we eerst een korte remote kennismaking. Daarna volgt een gesprek op kantoor met een praktische case of assessment. In die case bepaal jij wat je zou uitvragen, wat je in en buiten scope zet om het af te krijgen, wat er niet deugt aan wat er ligt, en wat er moet gebeuren voordat dit veilig live kan. Je mag AI gebruiken zoveel je wil. We kijken ook naar de vragen die je ons stelt. Neem voorbeelden mee van iets dat je zelf live hebt gebracht en dat klanten gebruiken. Hoe je solliciteert Stuur ons je CV, samen met een antwoord op deze vraag. Een paar alinea's is genoeg: Beschrijf iets dat je hebt gebouwd met AI en live hebt gezet, en dat daarna een serieus probleem bleek te hebben. Hoe kwam je erachter, wat deed je eraan, en hoe zorgde je dat het niet nog een keer kon gebeuren? Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries. 🎯 Level & Domain Level: Staff Engineer is IC4 on our engineering ladder: Has worked as a Senior Developer in at least two product teams. Turns the tribe’s hardest, ill-framed problems into shipped business value. Lands in any product fast, de-risks the complex, and raises the bar across teams. The Fastline: Each domain has its own Fastline: a small team of Staff Engineers working across all the products of the domain, in a highly agile, commando mode. The Fastline is transverse to the domain’s products: it is not attached to one product, but deployed wherever a domain needs senior engineering firepower the most. The Fastline takes on three kinds of work: Complex features in existing products: deliver features too risky, cross-cutting or technically hard for a product team to absorb alongside its committed roadmap. Legacy decommissioning: retire legacy systems safely, migrate their capabilities and data, and switch them off for good. IS simplification: reduce the complexity of the tribe’s information system, remove duplication, and make the architecture easier to run and evolve. Fastlines are attached to the Domain Lead, who sets their priorities based on business value, in coordination with the domains’ Lead ITs. Missions are short and outcome-driven: you join a topic, deliver, hand over to the owning product team, and move on to the next one. 🎯 TASK Strategic & Hard Problems Take on the domain’s most difficult and strategic topics: legacy decommissioning, IS simplification, complex features in existing products. Contribute, with the Architects, to the decommissioning of legacy systems end to end: map dependencies and data flows, design the migration path, run it without business disruption, and switch the legacy off. Drive the simplification of the tribe’s information system: identify redundant components, unnecessary coupling and dead code, and remove them. Deliver complex, cross-cutting features inside existing products, working hand in hand with their product teams. Fast Onboarding & Delivery Land in any product or codebase of the domain and become productive in days, not months. Quickly understand the business context, the architecture, the constraints and the people involved in a topic. Deliver early and often: integrate end to end first, sequence work from most unknown to least worrisome, and show tangible progress quickly. Hand over cleanly to the owning product team: documentation, tests, runbooks and knowledge transfer, so that the team can run what you built. Problem Framing & Business Partnership Take ill-defined, poorly framed problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans. Navigate between tech and business: understand the business stakes, challenge the need with a “how yes” mindset, and propose the simplest solution that delivers the value. Partner with business teams, PMs/POs and Engineering Managers to shape the problem, identify rabbit holes, no-gos and hidden complexity, and agree on scope. Think business value first: explain the value of every technical investment, legacy removal and simplification included. Be the person the business can count on: reliable, transparent on risks, and committed to outcomes. Engineering Excellence & Technical Leadership Own the how end to end: architecture, libraries, data model, implementation, testing and deployment. Write production code: you are hands-on and contribute heavily to the implementation. Make sound technical trade-offs and document key decisions. Raise the bar in the teams you work with: code quality, testing, operability, and AI-first practices. Coach and mentor engineers along the way, and share knowledge across products. Contribute to the domain’s technical vision and target architecture with the Lead IT and the domain’s Architects. Run & Reliability Live by “you build it, you run it”: ship stable, battle-tested software and take ownership of its run until it is handed over. Make migrations and decommissioning safe: rollback plans, monitoring, data reconciliation, progressive switch-over. Step in on critical incidents and complex production problems across the domain when your expertise is needed. AI-First Ways of Working Treat specifications and tests as IP: in an AI era where code is cheap, Veepee’s value moves from code to clear specifications and tests. Use applied AI and prototyping to move faster: understand legacy codebases, generate migrations and tests, explore solutions. Apply a “no roadmap without AI” mindset and spread AI-first practices across the products you work on. 👉 What this role is not Not a manager: you have no direct reports. You lead through expertise, influence and delivery, not hierarchy. Not an ivory-tower architect: you do not draw diagrams and leave. You write code, ship to production and own the outcome. Not attached to a single product: you go wherever the domain needs you most, and you move on once the job is done. Not a spec coder: you do not need a detailed spec to start. A messy, poorly framed problem is your starting point. Not a purely technical expert disconnected from the business: you understand the business, take initiative and drive every topic with a value-first mindset. 👉 Requirements Experience as a Senior Developer (IC3), or equivalent, in at least two product teams, with a strong track record of shipping working, tested software in production on complex systems. Proven experience on hard, high-stakes topics: legacy migration and decommissioning, large refactorings, architecture simplification, or critical features in existing systems. Deep technical expertise: architecture, system design, distributed systems, data modelling, and engineering best practices. Hands-on and fast: able to dive into an unknown codebase and business context and deliver value quickly. Strong business acumen: ability to understand a business domain, its stakes and KPIs, and to build trusted relationships with business teams. Excellent problem-solving skills: comfortable with ambiguity, able to frame an ill-defined problem and find the simplest path to value. High autonomy and ownership: you do not need to be told what to do, and you take full accountability for outcomes. Hands-on with the “you build it, you run it” principle: operability, monitoring, on-call and SLAs. Pragmatic understanding of applied AI and AI-first engineering (prototyping / vibe coding, AI-assisted legacy understanding, specifications and tests as IP). Ability to influence without authority, and to coach and raise the level of the engineers around you. Excellent communication and collaboration with PMs/POs, Engineering Managers, business teams, engineers, Architects, SREs, the Lead IT and the Domain Lead. Open to internal Senior Developers (IC3) who meet these criteria, as well as external applications. Master’s degree in Engineering / IT or equivalent. Fluency in English, international environment. ✅ BENEFITS Variable bonus Profit-sharing and incentive schemes Remote work possible for up to 2 days per week Online language-learning platform Works Council (CSE) with a wide range of benefits CESU vouchers (service vouchers) and holiday vouchers Access to corporate dining facilities and smart fridges (Foodles, Kumo, Bolk) Access to an on-site gym ⚙️ RECRUITMENT PROCESS 30-minute HR Screen with a Talent Acquisition Partner Interview with the Hiring Manager Business & Technical Interview with local Team The Veepee Group processes your data collected as part of the management of your recruitment in order to manage your application file for the position for which you have applied. title: Mid-Senior Full-Stack AI Product Engineer
description: Mid-Senior Full-Stack AI Product Engineer About Oda Spatial Commerce builds Oda AI, a platform that turns real spaces into ground-truthed world models. Creating the spatial layer that AI and software plug into to understand and act on the built environment.The AI behind it runs in production: a conversational space planner that proposes layouts and waits for approval before applying them, vision pipelines that locate objects in 3D captures, GPU rendering services, and retrieval over scene knowledge. We recently raised €1.5M from AI & PropTech investors and have licensed technology from a well known German research institute. We’re looking for a full-stack engineer who can multiply what a small team ships. You’ll work with a team of five engineers, the CEO and the CPO on product decisions, and customers. What you’ll own Planner and assistant. Improve how the in-viewer planner interprets requests, proposes options and checks collisions before a change is approved. Decide which requests need a model and which need a deterministic query. Vision and GPU pipelines. Run and improve the services that render captures, segment objects and match catalogue items to scanned spaces. These run on Cloud and making them scale is an open problem. Evaluation. Build and maintain the evals that decide whether a model or prompt change is safe to ship, and extend CI coverage beyond today’s agent tool-call checks. Scaling and cost. Keep latency and per-document cost under control as usage grows, across LLM calls, GPU jobs, and the graph and vector stores behind them. Architecture calls. Choose tools, frameworks and code structure, and own the reasoning. Some of the open questions are model routing per scene and where the Graph DB read model should stop being rebuildable. Product sense. Turn a vague customer need into a shipped feature, and say when the answer is not an AI feature at all. AI-Assisted Operations: Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. Our stack Cloud: Google Cloud Platform. Production and staging are separate GCP projects, with services in a European region. Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Turborepo monorepo, PlayCanvas and three.js for 3D, next-intl across 15 locales. AI: Genkit with Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers, routing across model providers, embedding-based retrieval, VLM and Foundation Models. Backend: Firebase on GCP (Firestore, Storage, Auth, App Hosting, App Check), Firebase Functions, Neo4j as a rebuildable graph and vector read Docker. Compute: Python services on Cloud Run, Cloud Run Jobs triggered per document, gsplat and PyTorch/CUDA, Blender scripting for room authoring. Delivery: GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, Secret Manager, Playwright and Jest, load tests against staging and production, PostHog for product analytics. What you bring Required Years of Experience: Six or more years building production software, including at least two years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Core Technical Skills: Strong TypeScript and React, and comfort in Python for model-serving or data work. Infrastructure as Code: Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Github, GitHub Actions, or similar. Cloud: Hands on experience with Google Cloud, Firebase or a similar managed stack. Experience running GPU or other compute-heavy workloads in production, including queueing, retries, timeouts and cost control. You have architected or helped build out an early-stage product until hundreds of thousands of people used it daily. You can name the decisions that got it there and the ones you’d make differently. A habit of writing evals or measurable acceptance checks before trusting a model change. You have made hard calls on tools and code and can defend them: what to keep, what to delete, and when a simpler approach beats a clever one. Strongly preferred Experience with LLM agents that use tools, structured outputs or retrieval over domain data. Graph databases (Neo4j or similar) and vector indexes at scale. Experience with Firestore security rules and server-side authorization, where admin credentials bypass client rules. Real product ownership: you have talked to users, made tradeoffs in a spec, and shipped something you then had to maintain. Nice to have Experience with 3D data: sfM, Pointcloud, 3D Gaussian Splatting. Blender Python, PlayCanvas or three.js in a production app. How you’ll work We ship constantly and keep a short constitution that every change must respect. You’ll read it on day one and help improve it. It favours simple code, surgical changes and verifiable success criteria. You write the spec, the test and the rollout plan, not only the code. You own the on-call for your features and the metrics that show they work. You decide when a problem needs a model and when it needs a database query, and you can explain that decision to a customer. We work in a high-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on-site a minimum of 3 days per week. VOS MISSIONS En lien direct avec les clients, notre directrice stratégique et opérationnelle et nos équipes de création de contenu, vous prenez en main la gestion quotidienne des réseaux sociaux de votre portefeuille. Vous serez responsable d'environ 7 à 8 comptes clients, avec pour objectif de développer leur visibilité, leur engagement et la cohérence de leur image de marque. Vos missions s'articuleront autour de trois grands axes : 1. STRATÉGIE ÉDITORIALE & IDENTITÉ DE MARQUE Participer à la définition des identités visuelles des nouveaux clients sur les réseaux sociaux. Imaginer des prises de parole et des storytelling cohérents avec l'identité de chaque maison. 2. CRÉATION DE CONTENU & GESTION INSTAGRAM Créer des stories et carrousels visuellement soignés. Monter des stories vidéo et adapter les contenus aux différents formats Instagram. Rédiger des captions engageantes, avec une attention particulière portée au ton et à l'identité de chaque client. Programmer et diffuser les publications aux moments et dans les conditions les plus pertinents. Veiller à la bonne exploitation des contenus produits par nos équipes de création (photos, vidéos et Reels). 3. ANIMATION & PERFORMANCE Assurer la modération des comptes : réponses aux commentaires et aux messages privés. Veiller à la cohérence et à la qualité des publications. Vous serez accompagné·e à votre arrivée par notre directrice des opérations et une Social Media Manager senior. L'objectif : vous permettre de prendre progressivement vos marques et de gérer votre portefeuille en autonomie. LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Nous recherchons une personne ayant déjà une première expérience professionnelle en Social Media Management. Une expérience dans la restauration, la gastronomie, l'hôtellerie ou l'Hospitality sera particulièrement appréciée. Deux critères sont indispensables pour ce poste : 1. Vous avez déjà géré plusieurs comptes Social Media simultanément. Vous avez une expérience concrète de la gestion de plusieurs comptes clients en parallèle. Vous savez jongler entre différents univers, respecter des calendriers éditoriaux et adapter votre communication à chaque marque. Une première expérience en agence ou dans un environnement multi-clients est particulièrement pertinente. 2. Vous avez un véritable intérêt pour la gastronomie et les univers haut de gamme. Restaurants, chefs, belles maisons, hôtels, expériences gastronomiques… Ces univers vous attirent sincèrement. title: GTM & Value Creation Lead
description: About Hexa Hexa builds and scales software companies alongside entrepreneurs. Since its launch as eFounders, Hexa has helped create companies including Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. Hexa Scale is a small-cap software investment firm deploying a €100 million fund. We take majority stakes in established B2B software companies and work directly with their founders to unlock their next stage of growth. We bring capital, but first and formemost operators who get involved in the daily work to build the fundamentals required to ignite a real Sscaling story: go-to-market, product, hiring and the systems needed. Hexa Scale Many software companies have a strong product and loyal customers but have yet to build a repeatable growth engine. Their next phase calls for more than optimising today’s funnel: they need to rethink how they find, win, serve and grow customers as AI changes both customer workflows and commercial execution. They need people who can test what works with their teams and turn the learning into a way of operating. That is what we do at Hexa Scale. We invest in software companies with roughly €2–10 million in ARR and work alongside their founders after the investment. Our approach is hands-on, with go-to-market at the centre of the acceleration plan? Mission We’re looking for a Value Creation Manager with a strong GTM background to join the Hexa Scale team. You will assess growth opportunities and feasibility before an investment decision, then work across our portfolio with founders and their teams to remove growth bottlenecks. Your judgement will help the investment team test whether a company has strong, executable growth potential; your operating work will help turn that potential into results. This is a GTM-major role: your core craft is building a next-generation go-to-market engine, combining customer insight, commercial execution, data and AI-enabled workflows. You have built or improved commercial motions inside a fast-growing startup, and you are as comfortable with positioning and customer interviews as with sales execution, pricing & process optimization. The remit can become broader as the needs and maturity of each portfolio company change, particularly where product is the best route to more customer value and growth. You will not be an external advisor producing slides for a management team. You will work with that team, from within the company, establish a useful operating cadence and leave behind a system they can run without you. What you’ll do As a preliminary note and as you’ll understand based on the 4 pillars below, the role is in close synch with the investment team. You’ll be a sparing partner, brining both your expert judgement as well as your field working competences to the table. While the role will enable lots of autonomy, you’ll be working in close synch with one or more investment partners, who’re experienced entrepreneurs you’ll learn from and who’ll have the final call on major decisions. Participate in investment selection Assess growth potential: Work with the deal team before an investment decision to test whether the growth opportunity is substantial, accessible and actionable, rather than relying on an optimistic management plan. Support commercial diligence: support the investment team in interviews of customers and prospects; examine segmentation, win/loss, funnel conversion, sales cycles, retention and expansion, pricing, channels and the capacity of the current team to execute. Underwrite the growth levers: Prioritize potential improvements in GTM, pricing, upmarket sales or distribution. Quantify the starting point, expected impact, costs, timing, dependencies and downside. Separate demonstrated opportunities from assumptions that still need testing. Turn diligence into a plan: Present an evidence-based growth-engineering assessment to the investment team, including what could disprove the thesis and an initial post-close step-by-step execution roadmap. Final investment decisions remain with the partners. Build a next-generation go-to-market engine Find the constraint: Work with founders and commercial teams to understand where growth stalls, from targeting and lead generation to conversion, onboarding and expansion. Get close to customers: Run interviews, listen to sales calls, examine lost deals and translate what you learn into sharper segmentation, messaging and offers. Run experiments: Lead and co-run tests with teams across outbound, partnerships, demand generation, pricing, AI-assisted prospecting and sales processes. Set a baseline, define what success looks like, measure conversion and unit economics, and stop what doesn’t work, while bringing teams along so the new ways of working stick. Build AI-enabled GTM workflows: Design and test practical workflows for research, targeting, qualification, sales preparation, customer success or expansion using AI tools and agents where appropriate. Measure quality, adoption, cost and human oversight, not just activity or demos. Make the funnel usable: Improve CRM discipline, pipeline visibility, forecasting and the handoffs between marketing, sales and customer success. Automate repeatable work where it improves the customer experience and commercial outcomes. Execute alongside portfolio teams Connect product and growth: As portfolio needs and maturity vary, partner with product teams to increase customer value and create new growth paths. Explore features such as embedded finance or agentic execution where relevant; validate customer demand, adoption, willingness to pay, implementation costs and margins before treating them as growth levers. Work with founders: Help turn priorities into a weekly cadence, clear owners and decisions grounded in customer and commercial evidence. Build internal capability: Coach or assist in recruiting when needed the people who will own the work long term. Document the useful parts of a playbook without imposing the same answer on every company. Own critical projects: Take responsibility for a defined growth or operating problem, from diagnosis through implementation, rather than handing over a recommendation. Can include temporary embedding in the company on a full-time basis Strengthen the Hexa Scale operating model Make our work repeatable: Capture what works across portfolio companies and improve the tools and methods we use to diagnose and accelerate growth. Take on adjacent problems: GTM remains your major, but the most valuable work may extend into product, customer operations, hiring or cross-functional execution depending on the company and its stage of maturity. Know when to take ownership and when to bring in a specialist. Use technology pragmatically: Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows with portfolio teams when they improve GTM outcomes or customer value. Assess reliability, cost and operational fit; do not confuse a demo with an adopted process. What we’re looking for Experience Five years or more: Substantial time in a fast-growing startup or scale-up in a hands-on GTM role. Commercial execution: You have personally built, operated or significantly improved a B2B growth engine, ideally in a fast-growing startup. You can explain how you changed the GTM motion, what the numbers showed and what you would do differently. B2B software: You understand sales cycles, conversion, retention, expansion, pricing and the trade-offs involved in scaling a team. Experience in high growth vertical SaaS is a plus. Range: You can work across sales, marketing, customer success and operations without needing a large team or a perfectly defined brief. Working with leaders: Experience alongside founders or senior commercial leaders is a strong plus. French and English fluency are required for this role. Mindset Autonomous: You can turn an ambiguous problem into a plan, make progress and know when a decision needs to be escalated. Hands-on: You are willing to inspect the CRM, join customer calls, rewrite a sequence and run an experiment yourself. AI-fluent: You already build with AI tools and use them in your daily work, not just in occasional demos. You can show workflows or products you have built, explain what worked and failed, and help teams adopt AI where it changes how they go to market. Commercially sharp: You care about revenue outcomes, not activity for its own sake. Versatile without being superficial: GTM is your major, but you can work on product and wider operating problems when they are the real constraint. You connect new customer value to adoption, pricing, retention and growth. Low ego, high standards: You can challenge a founder’s assumption, listen when you are wrong and earn the trust of the team doing the work. What we offer Ownership: A role at the centre of Hexa Scale’s work with founders, with responsibility for real operating projects across B2B software companies. Team: Direct collaboration with Hexa Scale partners and access to Hexa’s product, talent, brand and operational expertise. Compensation: A competitive package, including carried interest Benefits: Hexa employee benefits may include a Swile meal card, RTT, a green mobility budget and health insurance. Recruitment process Proposed process, to confirm with the Talent team: Introductory call with Hexa’s Talent team. Interview with the Hexa Scale team on your GTM experience and operating approach. Practical case on a real pre-investment growth diligence and portfolio execution problem, followed by a working session. Conversations with the people you would work with most closely. Reference checks and offer. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights. At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. You will: support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities; own and maintain the data model analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights; investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers; build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis; use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use; investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting; help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working; contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes; translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights. An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights. Your development in data Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to: contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals; design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible; integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption); manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture; apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA; map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions; work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques; document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability. This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control. Collaboration & positioning You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective. Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe. The role is based at our head office in Almere. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights. You bring: willingness to learn around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller; solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics); experience with or a strong interest in Power BI; strong analytical skills; the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models; a curious and proactive approach to solving problems; the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working; an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve; a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data; fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable. experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What we offer This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used. You can expect: a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience. an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; a pension scheme; a commuting allowance; a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop; structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days. Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: HR-Stagiair(e)
description: Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development. Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels. Nauwkeurig werkt, durft te vragen en zelfstandig durft te handelen. Het leuk vindt om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar veel gebeurt. Wij bieden: Stageplek per september 2026 voor 32-40 uur per week. Begeleiding van ervaren HR-professionals. Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s. Interesse? title: Junior Data Consultant
description: Onze Missie LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data. Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren. Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI. Team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Jouw profiel Relevante werkervaring: Je hebt 0–2 jaar werkervaring en affiniteit met de financiële sector en/of de gezondheidszorg. Een HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. Data-affiniteit: Je hebt interesse in data. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden en interne stakeholders. Je bent resultaatgericht, werkt gestructureerd en hebt een pragmatische instelling. Bereidheid om te leren en aan te passen aan innovatieve technologieën, tools en processen. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van werkprocessen. Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden: Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg. Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, telefoon- en internetvergoeding) 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen Een informele werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken Een laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om thuis een comfortabele en ergonomische werkplek in te richten Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onze LOGEX Academy Toegang tot onze partner op het gebied van mentale gezondheid; OpenUp Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen €240 jaarlijkse health benefit Mogelijkheid om een elektrische fiets te leasen via het fietsplan. Voor meer informatie, of als je vragen hebt, kun je contact opnemen met Wesley Schreuder op Ons bedrijf zet zich in voor het creëren van een werkplek die gelijkheid, diversiteit en inclusie bevordert. title: Android Engineer
description: Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. About the role Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface. Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range. This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps. This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team. What You'll Build & Own On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end. Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe. Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions. Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it. AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship. What You Bring Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system. Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns. Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end. AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with.
