The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Internal Audit Senior Specialist
description: About Nu Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page Audit Senior Specialist About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/ About the role You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one. This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees. You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way. You'll be responsible for Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees. Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks. Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks. Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks. Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting. Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence. Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring. Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards. Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity. We are looking for a person who has Experience and background A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience. Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework. Meaningful experience in fintech or banking. Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees. Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure. Ways of working and skills High ownership and autonomy A genuinely hands-on posture A builder mindset A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential. Cultural openness and humility Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile. Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives. Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense. German is required — the local regulator operates in German and there is no intermediary for regulatory interaction, so working proficiency in German is needed. Fluent English is also required. Nice to have Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement) No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory). Location for this opportunity Zug, Switzerland Our Benefits Chance of earning equity at Nubank Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents Pension Plan Accident Insurance Daily Sickness Benefits Life Insurance & Death Benefits NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents NuLanguage – Language Course Program Extended Parental Leave International Travel Insurance for business trips Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home Parking space at the Zug office Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2-3 times/week : Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/ Explore how we build technology at Nubank: 🔗 building.nubank.com.br ↗ 🎥 🎧 Listen to our stories on Spotify ↗ Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. title: Business Development Representative - Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Seoul, South Korea</p> <p><strong>This is a hybrid role with 3 days a week required to be in the Seoul office.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. The Business Development Representative (BDR) will:</p> <ul> <li>Be the first point of contact for customers that need help finding solutions</li> <li>Develop your customer centric sales skills to deliver a stellar customer experience</li> <li>Learn Cloudflare’s products and services in detail</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Languages required: Korean (native speaker) and English (working fluency)</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for being the “face of Cloudflare” and account resource for our prospects and customers. You will support Account Executives's book of business as well as your own to open doors and identify opportunities.</p> <p>This role requires you to have a basic understanding of Cloudflare’s suite of products to be able to provide a range of recommendations and solutions to our customers. You will be leveraging tools such as Salesforce, Google Sheets, internal applications, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo among others to map key customers to the right product suite for them. This is a great role if you are interested in a career path towards becoming a BDR management, Mid-Market Account Executive, Expansion Account Manager or Customer Success Manager. </p> <p><strong>Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities</li> <li>Identify target accounts with strategic timing and strong use cases through qualitative and data driven approach</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)</li> <li>Help lead BDR team-wide campaigns or initiatives (we’re a collaborative group)</li> <li>Write emails and letters you’d love to open; make calls you’d love to receive; ask compelling questions</li> <li>Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC</li> <li>Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes</li> <li>Experience in Google Sheets, Outreach, Salesloft, SFDC reporting, and data analysis is a great plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills</li> <li>Customer-oriented mindset with empathy and curiosity</li> <li>Aptitude to learn technical concepts/terms</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously</li> <li>Fluent in Korean (verbal & written)</li> <li>Minimum 1 year of experience in BDR or in a similar capacity in technology industry is preferred, specifically in SaaS will be a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: People Operations Specialist, Japanese Speaker (12-months contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Tokyo, Japan or Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></p> <p>Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Champion key employee lifecycle process:</strong> Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.</li> <li><strong>Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries:</strong> Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Ensure data integrity and governance: </strong>Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.</li> <li><strong>Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence:</strong> Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.</li> <li><strong>Support strategic HR initiatives and projects:</strong> Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills/experience</strong> </p> <ul> <li>2+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills. </li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Staff Electrical Engineer

Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Sound like you? partner experience.</p> <p><strong>How You’ll Shape Our Story:</strong><br>Your day-to-day will include:</p> <ul> <li class="text-start "><strong>Managing and developing long-term "><strong>Monitoring operational station performance</strong> — proactively identifying issues, risks, and opportunities across the charging stations in your accounts’ portfolios.</li> <li class="text-start "><strong>Translating partner feedback into action</strong> — converting partner needs and business priorities into actionable recommendations for internal teams.</li> <li class="text-start "><strong>Contributing to process improvement</strong> — helping continuously improve Powerdot’s strategic account management processes and overall partner experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:</strong></p> <ul> <li class="text-start "><strong>1–2 years of experience</strong> in strategy or consulting, ideally combined with experience in account management, business development, or a client-facing role.</li> <li class="text-start "><strong>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills</strong> — you can structure complex topics and turn insights into actionable recommendations.</li> <li class="text-start "><strong>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills</strong> — you can interact confidently with senior clients and coordinate across multiple internal teams.</li> <li class="text-start "><strong>Strong business acumen</strong> — you understand what drives partner value and commercial success.</li> <li class="text-start "><strong>A customer-oriented mindset</strong> — you put the partner at the centre of your decisions and act on their behalf.</li> <li class="text-start "><strong>Ability to manage strategic media relations.</li> <li>Sector expertise across either Energy & Industrials, Healthcare or Technology with a strong understanding of the issues shaping these industries</li> <li>Experienced in designing and delivering media training and crisis simulation exercises, alongside wider reputation management initiatives</li> <li>Skilled in managing communications across a broad range of stakeholders – including media, government, employees, investors and consumers – during sensitive, high-pressure moments</li> <li>Commercially driven and entrepreneurial, with a track record of independently identifying and converting new business and managing client relationships end-to-end</li> <li>Trusted advisor to senior communications leaders and C-suite executives, with excellent interpersonal skills and credibility at the highest levels</li> <li>A strong, collaborative team leader, experienced in resourcing, commercial oversight and building high-performing, resilient teams, with previous experience within both agency and client-side environments.</li> <li>Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with the confidence to counsel clients and present in both languages</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-RE1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Security Engineer
description: <p><strong>⭐ About the role :</strong></p> <p>At DataDome, security is a core part of how we build and scale. Our security team already covers GRC, SecOps, and security leadership, and we are now looking for a senior individual contributor to strengthen the engineering-facing side of the function.</p> <p>As DataDome evolves from a single product into a broader platform, our security scope is expanding across product, infrastructure, internal systems, and AI-enabled workflows. At the same time, our regulatory and assurance requirements are becoming more demanding, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with a strong technical background, able to work closely with engineering teams and bring practical security expertise to product security, cloud security, application security, secure software supply chain, security tooling, and AI security topics.</p> <p>This role reports directly to the Head of Security. It is a pure individual contributor position with no management responsibilities. Impact comes from technical depth, hands-on execution, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>👉 <strong>You will be more specifically in charge of things like...</strong></p> <h3>Product, cloud, and application security</h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to architecture, design, and implementation reviews for new features, services, platform changes, and cloud initiatives.</li> <li>Support pragmatic threat modeling and secure-by-design practices across APIs, services, data flows, workloads, and platform components.</li> <li>Advise engineering teams on application security, cloud and infrastructure security, and secure software supply chain topics.</li> <li>Help teams make sound security trade-offs and support remediation on complex or high-priority topics.</li> </ul> <h3>AI security and enablement</h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to the security of AI-related product capabilities, including model, pipeline, data flow, and integration considerations.</li> <li>Assess technical security risks related to internal AI usage, including data exposure, acceptable use, and vendor-related concerns, in partnership with the GRC function where relevant.</li> <li>Identify practical opportunities to leverage AI in security workflows, including threat analysis, remediation support, security reviews, and compliance-related automation.</li> </ul> <h3>Technical risk and security enablement</h3> <ul> <li>Bring strong technical depth to security and risk discussions by helping identify realistic attack paths, assess practical impact and likelihood, and translate findings into pragmatic remediation priorities.</li> <li>Partner with the GRC function to ensure risk assessments are supported by strong technical input and connected to concrete engineering actions.</li> <li>Explain risks, trade-offs, and recommendations in a way that drives action across engineering and cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Make secure practices easier to adopt through clear guidance, repeatable patterns, automation, and pragmatic support.</li> </ul> <h3>Security tooling improvement</h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to improving and evolving our security tooling, in close collaboration with SecOps, with a focus on making security signals, posture insights, and remediation workflows more useful for Security and Engineering teams.</li> <li>Develop use cases, dashboards, workflows, and integrations that help teams better understand, prioritize, and remediate security issues.</li> </ul> <p>👤 <strong>It would be great if...</strong></p> <p>You bring a strong technical security foundation (+7 years) across application security, cloud and infrastructure security, and secure software supply chain.</p> <p>You have worked in a SaaS or internet-scale product environment where security had to move at engineering speed.</p> <p>You are comfortable working close to engineering teams: reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, supporting remediation, and turning security needs into practical improvements.</p> <p>You enjoy going deep into security tools and using them to improve visibility, prioritization, remediation, and engineering workflows.</p> <p>You bring hands-on security expertise to identify meaningful risks, evaluate practical impact, and guide pragmatic remediation priorities.</p> <p>You are comfortable stepping in on urgent or high-impact security topics when needed, including incidents, emerging threats, complex remediations, and fast-moving cross-functional issues.</p> <p><em>You thrive in a small team setup — where you own a broad scope, move fast without heavy process, and adapt when priorities shift.</em></p> <p>French and English proficiency (working language is English, remote-friendly with occasional presence in Paris).</p> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with SOC 2 Type II and third-party risk management in a SaaS environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance topics or security implications of AI tooling.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Flex Life:</strong> While we offer remote, hybrid, & in-office options each position specifies the level of flexibility. Our Parisian office is located next to the Opera Garnier. You will also receive a 500€ stipend to help you set up your ideal workspace if you work hybrid or remotely. <ul> <li>If you are full remote, the SNCF dicount card is paid for you to come to our office to visit us & your team!</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Generous Health Benefits:</strong> We have partnered with Kenko for your healthcare needs.</li> <li>A 100€ annual allowance is provided for a leisure activity of your choice in Sports or Culture.</li> <li>Annual allowance of €200 if you come to the office by bike to cover maintenance costs.</li> <li><strong>Professional Development</strong>: #Weaimhigh is part of our DNA, therefore we have invested in an internal Learning and Development platform and offer the opportunity to request additional training and support via your manager.</li> <li><strong>Events & Team building: #We care and we have fun!</strong> We organise ****Annual Company-Offsite, Events, Drinks, Winter Party, Lunch & Learns and much more are part of our Culture</li> <li><strong>Parent Care:</strong> Gift & care packages for parents.</li> <li><strong>PTO:</strong> Based on the country you are based from (e.g. 25 days in France).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What are the next steps?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You x Talent Acquisition Manager : first interview and cultural fit</li> <li>You x Engineering Manager Damien : technical and cultural fit + Take-home technical challenge</li> <li>You x Team: Presentation and review of your "technical proposal" with the team</li> <li>You x Member of the leadership team - Discussion about DataDome vision and "raison d'être"!</li> <li>Now you really met everyone! Welcome to DataDome :)</li> </ul> <p>DataDome stops cyberfraud and bots in real time, outpacing AI-driven fraud from simple to sophisticated across your sites, apps, and APIs. Named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Bot Management, the DataDome platform is built on a multi-layered AI engine that focuses on intent, not just identity. Because it’s not about knowing who’s real, it’s about what they intend to do. With thousands of AI models that adapt to every fraudulent click, signup, and login, DataDome blocks fraud in less than 2 milliseconds, without compromising performance. DataDome is fully automated and integrates seamlessly into any tech stack. Backed by a 24/7 SOC team of advanced threat researchers, DataDome stops over 350 billion attacks annually. Experience protection that outperforms with DataDome.</p> <p><em>DataDome is an equal opportunity employer, and proud to be committed to diversity and inclusion. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age.</em></p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Dans un environnement à forte croissance, vous intervenez auprès de grands comptes pour transformer leurs enjeux business grâce à une collecte, un traitement et une visualisation de données performants.</p> <p><strong>Ce qu’on attend de vous :</strong> En tant que profil Senior, vous garantissez l'excellence technique et la qualité de la valeur livrée sur vos projets analytiques. <p><strong>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter la livraison de projets Analytics de bout en bout : du cadrage des cas d'usage avec les équipes métier jusqu'au déploiement de dashboards, Science (Dataiku, Copilot Studio)</li> </ul> <li><strong>Socle Technique :</strong> Solide maîtrise de SQL et Python, bases en Git et principes d'ingénierie logicielle (versioning, tests), ainsi qu'une expérience sur les environnements Cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS).</li> <li><strong>Posture & Communication :</strong> Capacité avérée à faire le pont entre équipes techniques et métier, accompagnement des profils juniors et communication claire.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>HR Call :</strong> Échange initial sur votre parcours, vos motivations et l'adéquation culturelle.</li> <li><strong>Technical Interview :</strong> Évaluation approfondie de votre socle technique (SQL, Python, Cloud) et de vos expertises Analytics.</li> <li><strong>Business Interview :</strong> Mise en situation sur la résolution de cas d'usage business et la restitution analytique.</li> <li><strong>Fit Interview :</strong> Échange final de projection opérationnelle et de fit culturel.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Rémunération :</strong> Package : 53 000 € à 63 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 5 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.</p> <p><strong>Présentation entreprise</strong> Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients. Envie d'en savoir plus? Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person for Encaleret, International
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Director, Head of Quality <span style="font-size: inherit;">& Responsible Person</span> for Encaleret, International, leads the quality organization of BridgeBio Pharma Europe B.V. and reports to Senior Vice President Quality. As the Responsible Person, the role carries personal accountability under EU GDP for the entity's distribution activities: release for distribution, recalls, and products that are authentic, correctly stored and transported, and traceable. The role is independent of Commercial Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board. She/he leads and develops the entity's quality team, maintains the entity's quality management system, developed with the affiliate quality leads from existing BridgeBio frameworks, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and subsequent MIA readiness, if needed.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity </li> <li>Take final disposition decision on returned, rejected, recalled or potentially falsified products (an RP decision under GDP), in consultation with BridgeBio's Global Quality Management</li> <li>Support and coordinate returns, rejections, suspected falsified products and recall operations</li> <li>Approve return to saleable stock</li> <li>Ensure that customers are entitled to receive the products prior to shipment</li> <li>Ensure the WDA registration remains current with the commercial supply chain setup</li> <li>Ensure the accuracy of quality records and that GDP requirements are implemented and maintained in the quality management system, as required for the WDA license</li> <li>Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness </li> <li>Ensure data integrity and own the entity's internal audit (self-inspection) program</li> <li>Own the GDP quality agreement matrix: contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces </li> <li>Review and write standard operating procedures in BridgeBio’s document management system in accordance with the GDP requirements</li> <li>Ensure there is a training program for BridgeBio staff working under GDP and ensure that the relevant staff members are trained on GDP</li> <li>Participate in GDP vendor qualification program</li> <li>Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications</li> <li>Perform distribution release for finished goods received from the contract manufacturing organization, which can include review of temperature, shipping and receiving documentation </li> <li>Be responsible for and be directly involved in product complaints from the EU and ROW markets</li> <li>Provide GDP and QA related support and intelligence</li> <li>Be available and reachable 24/7 </li> </ul> <p><strong>Other QA/Quality Person related responsibilities</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Build, lead and develop the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP, if needed</li> <li>Implement and maintain the entity's GDP-compliant quality management system by adopting existing BridgeBio quality frameworks, adapted to the entity's license requirements</li> <li>Work closely with the affiliate quality leads to resolve quality issues and keep the intercompany interfaces effective</li> <li>Prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import, API GMP verification, and batch-certification processes), if needed </li> <li>Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents as needed </li> <li>Participate in regulatory inspections  </li> <li>Participate in internal and external project team meetings </li> <li>Write and review governing procedure (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.), where necessary  </li> <li>Other duties as assigned </li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work </u></strong></h3> <p>This is a Netherlands-based role that will require 30% travel.</p> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in pharmaceutical quality, including significant GDP / distribution quality experience; prior appointment as (or eligibility to be) a Responsible Person strongly preferred </li> <li>Experience leading regulatory inspections with EU competent authorities (IGJ preferred) </li> <li>Prior experience of managing third party vendors (CMOs, CTLs, 3PLs, etc.)</li> <li>Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the distribution of medical products </li> <li>Strong understanding of supply chain concepts, supplier management, inventory management </li> <li>Extensive knowledge of US/EU GMPs /GDPs and associated guidance </li> <li>Working in a highly regulated environment </li> <li>Proven leadership of quality teams; experience building quality functions or systems </li> <li>BS/MS degree preferably in operations, science, pharmacy</li> <li>Documented GDP training and the education and experience to be accepted as Responsible Person by the Dutch authorities (Farmatec/IGJ)</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Skills</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Understanding the EU and particularly IGJ regulations in relation to the wholesale distribution of medicines </li> <li>Fluent in English language; written/spoken in Dutch language, preferred </li> <li>Strong planning and time management skills with ability to prioritize workload </li> <li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail </li> <li>Basic understanding of data concepts and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems e.g., SAP </li> <li>Ready to embrace company core values and diverse corporate culture  </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>We have high expectations for our team members</li> <li>We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return</li> <li>Market leading compensationHybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  <span data-contrast="auto">We have high title: Systems Engineer - Database Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong> Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco, Canada, Remote</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>We manage an internal, multi-region PostgreSQL platform that enables engineers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate services. Our mission is to provide a highly available, stable, and self-service platform with clear operational visibility. As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with database engineers, developers, and infrastructure teams to evolve our database architecture and automation. You will be instrumental in scaling our PostgreSQL infrastructure and enhancing database reliability. If you are passionate about PostgreSQL, automation, reliability, and database tooling, let's connect!</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, deploy, and manage PostgreSQL database clusters in production environments. </li> <li>Develop and maintain database tooling for automation, monitoring and performance tuning.</li> <li>Implement high availability, backup and disaster recovery solutions. </li> <li>Work closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to integrate database tools. </li> <li>Implement proactive solutions using observability tools to monitor database health. </li> <li>Optimize database performance, indexing strategies, and query tuning. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with building, scaling, and managing large-scale multi-tenant PostgreSQL database clusters, encompassing high availability failover, and disaster recovery strategies.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or Salt) .</li> <li>Experience in scripting languages (Python, Bash) for automation. </li> <li>Experience building and maintaining database tooling for automation and monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Experience optimizing database performance and query tuning.</li> <li>Experience with alerting and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience developing software in Go, Ruby or C/C++</li> <li>Contributions to PostgreSQL or relevant open-source projects.</li> <li>Expertise in database schema migrations and automation using tools like Flyway, Liquibase or goose. </li> <li>Experience with connection pooling solutions such as PgBouncer, HAProxy.</li> <li>Experience with non-relational data stores such as Distributed & time-series databases (ex. Cassandra, Timescale) and key-value stores (eg., Redis) </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $196,000</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000 </span></li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Product Manager ISR & Strike
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Product Manager (ISR & Strike) at Harmattan AI, you will be at the heart of company strategy, driving the end-to-end definition, development, and delivery of our autonomous persistent ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) and strike systems. You will own the evolution of our existing offer into a next-generation drone carrier platform integrated with proprietary Harmattan AI payloads. Working closely with R&D, you will translate operational needs into technical specifications, manage product configurations and versions, and ensure seamless execution from initial architecture to field deployment. Responsibilities Product Definition & Roadmap: Consolidate the existing persistent ISR offer and define the product specification and multi-version roadmap for our autonomous drone carrier and Harmattan AI payload integrations based on market analysis, customer feedback, and technological feasibility. End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Own the product lifecycle from initial specification to full delivery across different system configurations, developing and maintaining timelines to ensure all milestones are met. Technical & R&D Coordination: Work hand-in-hand with R&D teams to oversee system engineering, architecture, and functional development, actively resolving technical challenges across R&D and industrialization phases. Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central interface between R&D, product, program, sales, and customers to align technical capabilities with operational mission requirements and ensure tender and project success. Resource & Configuration Management: Manage engineering resource allocation and product configurations to deliver reliable, high-performance autonomous systems on schedule. Candidate Requirements Proven, hands-on experience within the modern DefTech ecosystem, specifically in defense products, drones/UAVs, or autonomous systems, is strictly required. End-to-End Product Development: Demonstrated track record of conducting complex technical products from initial specification through R&D to final delivery and industrialization. Technical & Systems Engineering Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering (Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, Robotics, or Computer Science) or a related technical field, paired with deep knowledge of system engineering, unmanned aerial systems, and autonomous payloads. Customer & Mission-Oriented: Ability to translate complex ISR and strike mission requirements into concrete, scalable product features and configurations. Extreme Ownership: High level of accountability and autonomy, with the drive to take full responsibility for product definition, roadmap execution, and delivery outcomes. Collaborative Leadership & Active Listening: Strong communication and listening skills to build trust with R&D engineers, bridge technical and business stakeholders, and guide cross-functional teams without direct hierarchical authority. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper all the way to the factory floor and live field deployment. Our Launcher team builds the ruggedised, autonomous deployment infrastructure that takes our larger platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad (alongside a Team Lead, another Mechanical Engineer, a Hardware Engineer, and a Software Engineer), you will act as an end-to-end technical owner. Your work spans defining system specifications, sizing heavy structures and high-acceleration systems, managing budgets and suppliers, and getting hands-on in the workshop and field to stress-test hardware to failure. Responsibilities End-to-End Clean-Sheet Design: Architect, design, and prototype ruggedized, unmanned launch systems from scratch, taking hardware from initial concept through field test rigs to deployable systems. Kinematics Power Sizing: Size and integrate high-acceleration hydraulic, pneumatic, or spring-loaded actuation systems, high-speed release mechanisms, and custom dampening systems capable of handling extreme dynamic loads. Autonomous Launch Operations: Design reliable mechanical systems capable of operating independently in harsh, remotely supervised environments—handling self-deployment, automated launch sequences, and system resets. Structural Engineering & Validation: Perform hand calculations and FEA to size heavy-duty structural weldments and moving assemblies, accounting for weld fatigue, shock, and sudden violent loads. Testing & Prototyping: Build custom test benches and field rigs to validate designs, running physical stress tests to failure and iterating rapidly on hardware. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Flight Dynamics to define launch requirements, and work alongside Hardware and Embedded Software engineers to synchronize mechanical actuation with automated launch code. Supplier & Project Ownership: Manage project budgets, timelines, and technical documentation (2D/3D CAD, BOMs, test reports) while partnering with suppliers on heavy-precision machining and series production. Candidate Requirements Heavy-Duty Mechanical & Structural Design: Proven track record designing large-scale, heavily loaded machinery, structural weldments, and rugged mechanisms from scratch (ideally in aerospace, defense, heavy equipment, or robotics). Kinematics Expertise: Deep hands-on experience sizing and designing moving assemblies, high-speed release mechanisms, and pneumatic or hydraulic circuits (cylinders, accumulators, valves) under high-acceleration forces. CAD & Structural Analysis: High proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and structural validation using both hand calculations and FEA for dynamic and fatigue load cases. Manufacturing & Sourcing: Strong command of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) across heavy-precision machining, welding, and industrial fabrication, with experience sourcing custom components and managing external suppliers. True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership—equally comfortable defining technical specs, managing budgets, turning wrenches in the workshop, and running live field tests. Communication & Mission Alignment: Clear written and verbal communication to document complex engineering decisions, paired with full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, pace, and growth. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Phoenix, AZ</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking an experienced and strategic Enterprise Account Executive to own a dedicated territory of named Fortune 500 and Global 2000 accounts across our Michigan territory. commissions.</li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Kortom – wij maken digitale media leuker, slimmer en effectiever.</p> <p><strong>Senior Project Manager<br></strong>Bij ons draait alles om creatieve impact. En om dat vlekkeloos te laten verlopen, zoeken we een <strong>Senior Project Manager </strong>die energie krijgt van regelen, structureren én inspireren. Iemand die het creatieve proces strak organiseert, maar ook snapt dat de mooiste ideeën juist ontstaan als er ruimte is om te spelen.<br><br>Als Senior Project Manager Creative ben jij de spil tussen klant, jouw eigen creatie team en mediaspecialisten.
