wat telt is jouw vermogen om projecten tot een goed einde te brengen.</li> <li>Voorkeur voor ervaring met middelenbegrotingen, resource-planning en KPI-gestuurde workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden wij jou?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Salaris:</strong> €<strong>3000 – 4250 bruto per maand</strong> (op basis van <strong>38,75 uur per</strong> week) afhankelijk van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit.</li> <li><strong>Flexibiliteit:</strong> Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).</li> <li><strong>Vrijheid: </strong>Veel eigen verantwoordelijk om je eigen rol en werkdag in te vullen.</li> <li><strong>Werkomgeving: </strong>werken in een goed georganiseerde creatieve omgeving met een enthousiast team van creatieven, projectmanagers en mediaspecialisten.</li> <li><strong>Klanten:</strong> Werken voor A merken van Nederland en internationaal op projecten waar je écht trots op kunt zijn en die zichtbaar impact maken.</li> <li><strong>Groeikansen</strong>: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie.</li> <li><strong>Toegang tot M Academy:</strong> Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.</li> <li><strong>Reiskostenvergoeding:</strong> Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.</li> <li><strong>8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar</strong> (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).</li> <li><strong>Hybrid Working allowance:</strong> <strong>€30 netto</strong> per maand bij fulltime.</li> <li><strong>Bring Your Own Device (BYOD):</strong> Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van <strong>€57,50 netto</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Lunchfaciliteiten:</strong> Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.</li> <li><strong>Zorgverzekering:</strong> Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p>Geen dag is hier hetzelfde! Het ene moment duik je in een briefing met een klant, het volgende moment ben je met een creative bezig om een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen, waardoor je continu leert en groeit. En jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat alles klopt.</p> <p>Enthousiast? Laat van je horen en vertel ons waarom jij de Project Manager Creative bent die wij zoeken.<strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin,TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City; Washington, D.C.</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative. </p> <p>As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.</p> <p>Due to this position having access to controlled technology and systems, US export control laws require that applicants for this position must be US persons (including US citizens, US nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees and asylees). Applicants may be required to pass and maintain a government-mandated background investigation as a condition of employment.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager</li> <li>Lead the integrated IL4 roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and execution cadence</li> <li>Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration</li> <li>Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting</li> <li>Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale</li> <li>Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards</li> <li>Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills and Knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement</li> <li>Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment</li> <li>BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience</li> <li>Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability</li> <li>Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery</li> <li>Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives</li> <li>Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output</li> <li>Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity</li> <li>Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally</li> <li>Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies </li> <li>Embraces technology including automation and AI augmentation</li> <li>Experience working with multiple time zones and cross-functional teams</li> </ul> <div> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Washington DC and New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $158,000 - $218,000</li> <li>For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $166,000 - $228,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. &nbs

title: Senior AI Solution Specialist
description: Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions? As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself. You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security. This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed. Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office) Start Date: January/February 2027 Availability : Fulltime Your impact Lead complex AI discovery Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype. Build AI solutions yourself Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it. Shape enterprise AI initiatives Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful. Design for production Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value. Create reusable AI patterns Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities. Coach and challenge others Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

With colocation providers, hardware suppliers, and delivery partners worldwide, we turn infrastructure requirements into deployments that come online faster, cost less, and work the first time. We help fix customer problems and design the network to be ready for the unknown.</p> <h2>What you'll do </h2> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Data-Driven Analysis & Planning: </strong>Analyze network traffic, performance data, and market trends to model capacity needs, justify expansion projects, and prioritize partnership opportunities. Your analysis will directly influence where and how we expand our network. </li> <li><strong>Interconnection & Traffic Engineering: </strong>Work with partners and internal teams to establish and expand private network interconnects, Internet exchange connections, and transit capacity. Investigate routing inefficiencies, improve local traffic delivery, and coordinate BGP policy changes that improve performance, resilience, and network efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Project Execution: </strong>Coordinate the end-to-end deployment lifecycle for new Points of Presence (PoPs). Expansion projects and planning. </li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Serve as a key liaison between our external partners and internal teams, including Network Engineering, Capacity Planning, Data Center Strategy, and Infrastructure Operations, to ensure seamless project execution and alignment.</li> <li><strong>Troubleshooting & Operational Reliability:</strong> Investigate connectivity, latency, packet loss, routing, hardware, and site availability issues. Understand how customers and Cloudflare products use the network, coordinate remediation with the appropriate teams, and verify connectivity and serving health after changes.</li> <li><strong>Process & Tooling Improvement:</strong> Contribute to the systems, tools, and processes that power our team. You will help build a scalable machine for tracking our partnership pipeline, managing projects, and reporting on our impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Solve Problems: Understand how customers use our products and solve issues that might arise. </strong><strong>Technical Curiosity: Be always curious, following new hardware developments and how they would fit in our network. </strong></p> <h2>Desirable skills, knowledge and experience </h2> <ul> <li><strong>Networking Fundamentals</strong>: Practical experience with BGP, IPv4/IPv6, Ethernet, LACP, and optical connectivity. title: Data Analyst - Logistics
description: Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data. What you get A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then. Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview. Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. About us All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. What the job looks like Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems. Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team. Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source. Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal. Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history. What you bring Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told. Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too. Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job. Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time. Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge . You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards. AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do. Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus. Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus. Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks. We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
description: Freelance Assignment 4 January to 30 April 2027 5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays) Reporting to COO The Challenge Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation. Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through. We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch. What You'll Do Keep things running Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks. Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips. Go deep on payments Get up to speed: Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most. Fix it weekly: Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers. Create order: By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute. What You'll Bring Must have 5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side. Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes. Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion. Active, daily use of AI and automation tools. You don't need to build automations, but you can read, run and triage them (we use n8n and Claude skills). A track record of turning a messy area into an operating model: owners, KPIs, rhythm and a plan others can execute. You pick things up fast and learn fast: you are productive in a new area within days, not weeks. Nice to have Payments in emerging markets such as Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana or Kenya: bank transfers, mobile money, local providers. Experience with OTP or verification performance and cost. title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
description: Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source. Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement. You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work. This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. The problems you'll own A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress What you'll do Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work Report agent quality with a stated method and sample Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes What you bring A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it PM experience on a product that other people build on Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work Clear, short writing What sets you apart Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers What We Offer Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact. Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth. Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary. 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance. Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office. Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised. NS business card for easy commuting to the office. A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running. Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills. Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices. Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together. Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing. Recruitment steps Recruiter screen Hiring Manager interview Assessment interview Final conversations with the people you would work alongside At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you. What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀 Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation
description: Our Growth Marketers bring buyers to datasnipper.com through integrated campaigns. You'll turn that traffic into demo requests and pipeline. You'll run A/B tests, personalize the site, work on conversion rate optimization (CRO), and manage the projects that add new functionality to our websites. You'll also bring AI into the website program, building on the AI that already runs our go-to-market. You'll work from one ranked backlog and report each week on what moved conversion. You'll form hypotheses from data, get them built with our designer and developer, and roll out the winners. Your closest partners are the Growth Marketers, our Senior Web Experience Designer and Senior Web Developer, and GTM Engineering, which collects intent data from our website. About DataSnipper We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark. Where the website stands today Most of our inbound pipeline starts on datasnipper.com . Until now, our Senior Growth Marketer handled CRO on the side, and many people on the Marketing team publish pages, update content individually. In short, very fragmented collaboration. In an AI-dense market, that work counts for more. Anyone can generate volume now. What's hard, and what earns attention, is staying close to what our customers care about and bringing campaign ideas sharp enough to cut through. That's the work that sets this team apart, and what you'll be part of. Our tracking needs a cleanup before we can trust test results. Localized landing pages come next: Japan, DACH and France need web experiences in their own language. GTM Engineering already scores visitor intent by page, and we barely use that data on the site. Personalization by segment and market has barely started. AI already runs parts of our go-to-market. Agents nurture leads, a classifier scores the intent behind every web visit, and we enrich accounts automatically. The website hasn't caught up. Buyers also find us in new ways. More of them research software through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever reach our site. The web team has a dedicated designer and developer. This role decides what we test next and reports what worked. What you'll be doing Run the experimentation program Build the testing roadmap for datasnipper.com and the localized sites, from hypothesis to rollout. Set the website's testing rules: minimum sample size, test duration, and when to call or stop a test. Keep a learning log that Growth, Sales and Product Marketing check before they propose a test. Report results in pipeline terms: demo requests, demo-to-SQL rate and pipeline per session. Improve conversion where buyers decide Optimize the demo request flow and the pricing, product and campaign pages. Map the funnel from first visit to SQL in GA4 and HubSpot, find where buyers drop off, and fix it. Work with the Growth Marketers to match each campaign landing page to its ad, audience and market. Personalize the site Tailor content, proof points and CTAs by vertical, market and buying stage. Use intent and enrichment data from GTM Engineering to decide who sees what. Test each localized site as it launches, to the same standard as the English site. Build AI into the web program Use the intent and enrichment data we already collect to build pages that adapt to each visitor. Use AI to generate and localize test variants, so we test more ideas each month. Automate test QA, result analysis and weekly reporting, with a person signing off on the results. Prototype new AI experiences for buyers, such as an assistant that answers product and pricing questions. Manage web projects Scope new website functionality, write the brief, and run delivery with our designer and developer. Turn requests from Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Growth into a ranked backlog, and use data to decide what waits. Run QA and launch, then measure each project's result. Keep the site findable and measurable Protect organic search and AI visibility in every test and launch: canonicals, page speed, schema markup and crawl access. Track traffic and demo requests referred by AI assistants, and test pages for buyers who arrive that way. Maintain website tracking with Marketing Operations in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and HubSpot. Build the weekly web performance view the team works from. What we’re looking for 5+ years in CRO, web optimization or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. You've run an A/B testing program and can walk us through tests that won and tests that lost. Data fluency. You know when to trust a test result, and when sample size, novelty or segment noise undermine it. You pull your own numbers from GA4 and HubSpot. Structure. You run a backlog, write briefs a developer can build from, and keep several projects moving. You tell stakeholders each week what ships. Collaboration. You get work done through a designer, a developer and stakeholders who all want space on the website. You involve them before you set a hypothesis, and use data to settle priority disputes. AI builder. You’ve shipped something with AI that changed how a team works: an agent, an automated workflow, or a tool other people use. Bring the example and what broke first. Commercial focus. You judge tests on the pipeline they create. Tools you'll work with (willingness to ramp & learn matters more than a complete checklist): Creative: Figma, Canva Website: Framer, Contentstack Analytics: HubSpot, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Fibbler, Snowflake CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot Experimentation and personalization: Optimizely Behavior analytics: heatmaps and session recordings Project management and handoff: Linear, Figma AI: Claude Enterprise (Projects, Skills and MCP integrations), ChatGPT, and build tools such as Lovable or n8n Bonus: hands-on technical SEO and a view on how AI search changes the way buyers find B2B software. SQL, or enough HTML, CSS and JavaScript to set up a test yourself. title: Digital CS Program Manager
description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference. This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations. What you'll do Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work. Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps. Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t. title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
description: AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie Wat ga je doen? Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren. Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers. Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's. Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid. Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven. Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt. We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken. Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften. Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt. De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen. Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken. Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen. Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen. Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren. We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen. We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke verbeteringen je hebt gerealiseerd, wat je onderweg hebt geleerd en hoe jij AI binnen een organisatie als Mijndomein zou aanpakken. description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in het maandafsluitingsproces en verder optimalisering en automatisering hiervan. Je onderzoekt welke memoriaalboekingen er worden gemaakt, waarom ze ontstaan en hoeveel tijd ze kosten. Daarmee help je Finance om de doorlooptijd van de maandafsluiting te verkorten en het proces minder foutgevoelig te maken. title: Senior Response Engineer (Application & network security)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD):</strong> Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.</li> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Managed email threat detection and response service.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> ML model development and detection optimization.</li> </ul> <p>Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive <strong>24×7×365 protection</strong> across email, application, and network threat surfaces.</p> <h3><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Senior Response Engineer</strong> within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC), you will serve as a subject-matter expert and technical escalation point for threat mitigation across Cloudflare’s strategic enterprise customer base. In this role, you will lead the response to sophisticated, multi-vector cyberattacks spanning OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7, operating beyond standard playbooks to diagnose anomalies, engineer custom mitigations, and stabilize mission-critical infrastructure under fire.</p> <p>Beyond active incident command, you will act as a force multiplier: architecting customer-specific defense strategies, authoring and refining automated detection logic, mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, and collaborating directly with Cloudflare Product and Engineering teams. We are looking for an experienced, high-ownership technical leader who excels during high-stakes incidents and is passionate about mentoring others while advancing threat mitigation at scale.</p> <p>CMDC operates 24×7×365. <strong>This role participates in a regional shift rotation and on-call escalation rota including periodic weekend and public-holiday coverage as part of a follow-the-sun model across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead and incident commander during high-impact, multi-vector security events, designing and deploying bespoke mitigation strategies when standard runbooks do not suffice.</li> <li>Perform deep-dive forensic analysis into complex Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 traffic anomalies, identifying zero-day attack patterns, sophisticated bot networks, and novel evasion techniques.</li> <li>Apply advanced mitigation strategies and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security suite, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Advanced Rate Limiting.</li> <li>Lead technical communications and incident bridge calls with enterprise C-level executives, principal network engineers, and security teams during critical events, clearly articulating root causes, impact assessments, and remediation paths.</li> <li>Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts across internal telemetry systems to rapidly triage incoming events, assess blast radius, and validate threat severity.</li> <li>Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training.</li> <li>Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A minimum of 6–8 years of hands-on experience in a high-volume Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Detection and Response (MDR), network engineering, or incident response environment dealing directly with live threat mitigation.</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of networking principles and internet infrastructure, including TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, BGP routing mechanics, and edge network design.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Layer 7 protocols and web architectures (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS handshakes/ciphers, reverse proxy models, and API security).</li> <li>Experience analyzing network traffic data for anomaly detection and designing, tuning, and executing advanced mitigation strategies against L3/L4 and L7 attacks, including bespoke countermeasures when standard playbooks are insufficient.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in packet capture and network traffic analysis using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or tshark to isolate anomalies and dissect malformed or novel payloads.</li> <li>Practical experience analyzing and mitigating security incidents using AI and machine learning tools, paired with the hands-on capability to build and integrate custom tooling that improves operational workflows, accelerates log telemetry analysis, and defends against AI-driven botnets and adversarial edge attacks.</li> <li>Proficiency in using the command line (Bash shell) alongside general system administration literacy across Linux, Mac, or Windows environments.</li> <li>Proven experience commanding incident bridges, making decisive risk-tradeoff decisions, and maintaining composure while managing enterprise stakeholders during high-pressure crises.</li> </ul> title: Staff Software Engineer - Revenue Intelligence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲</p> <p>At <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">Cloudbeds</a>, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.</p></div><p>𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:</p> <p>Remote (Europe)</p> <p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗨𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲:</p> <p>At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024 – but we're just getting started.</p> <p> </p> <p>𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁:</p> <p>As a 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗳𝗳 𝗦𝗼𝗳𝘁𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.</p> <p> </p> <p>𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗥𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:</p> <p>The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.</p> <p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:</p> <ul> <li>Set and evolve the technical strategy for RMS, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans</li> <li>Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows</li> <li>Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems</li> <li>Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability</li> <li>Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction</li> <li>Own the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work</li> <li>Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀:</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems</li> <li>Deep hands-on expertise with backend and data engineering technologies. Our stack includes .NET/C#, Python, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Kafka/Debezium, Airflow, gRPC, AWS (EKS, S3, SQS, Batch), Terraform, Helm/Argo CD, and Datadog, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, CDC and streaming, data archiving, and batch compute</li> <li>Deep PostgreSQL experience at scale, including performance tuning, partitioning, and large online migrations</li> <li>A track record of rebuilding production data syncs and pipelines incrementally, keeping them idempotent, reconciled, and running throughout</li> <li>Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations</li> <li>A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution</li> <li>A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards</li> <li>Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business</li> <li>Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization</li> </ul> <p>#LI-IK1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.</p> <p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁 - 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗝𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗨𝘀</p> <p>Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Example projects These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently: Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers. Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation. You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud. Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard. Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time. title: Data Engineer Logistics
description: Als Data Engineer word je onderdeel van het Data & Analytics-team in Rotterdam. Het grootste deel van je tijd werk je voor Business Unit Liquid Food , waar je functioneel en technisch mede-eigenaar bent van het datawarehouse en zorgt dat betrouwbare data beschikbaar is voor analyse en besluitvorming. Je combineert data engineering (back-end) met BI, en vertaalt businessvragen naar schaalbare oplossingen: van betrouwbare datastromen en semantische modellen tot dashboards, ad-hocanalyses en tender- en pricingtools. Samen met je collega's moderniseer je het datalandschap, met volop ruimte om te experimenteren met predictive & generative AI, AI-agents, machine learning en procesautomatisering . Je standplaats is Rotterdam; om dicht bij de business te blijven werk je ongeveer eens per anderhalve week vanuit het kantoor van Liquid Food in Barneveld. Wat ga je doen? Het datadomein van Liquid Food beheer je: databasebeheer, architectuur, datamodellen, documentatie, datakwaliteit, continuïteit en doorontwikkeling; Betrouwbare datapipelines ontwikkel en onderhoud je van bronsystemen naar het datawarehouse en de rapportageomgeving, voornamelijk met SQL ; Beschikbaarheid, volledigheid, juistheid en tijdigheid van data bewaak je, en structurele oorzaken van dataproblemen los je op; Semantische modellen, dashboards en rapportages bouw je, en informatiebehoeften vertaal je naar heldere KPI's en self-service; Aan businessgedreven projecten zoals tender-, pricing- en kostprijstools draag je bij, van concept tot beheer — zo sla je de brug tussen organisatie, processen en techniek; Monitoring, logging, autorisaties en versiebeheer richt je in, met aansluiting op de centrale architectuur-, privacy-, security- en datagovernancekaders; Kansen voor automatisering en voorspellende inzichten signaleer je, en continue verbetering stimuleer je via data- en procesanalyse. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar, en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie; Ervaring hebt met SQL (3+ jaar), SSIS/SSDT, SSRS, SSAS en Power BI (semantische modellen en rapportage), plus dimensioneel modelleren en Data Vault-modellering ; Pré: Scrum, Microsoft Fabric, Python, Spark en Azure Data Factory; Conceptueel denkt én praktisch handelt: je overziet architectuur en datastromen en vertaalt complexe vragen naar robuuste, werkende oplossingen ; Businessgericht, kritisch en verbindend bent, de taal van business én IT spreekt, en proactief eigenaarschap neemt; Goed communiceert in Nederlands en Engels , in woord en geschrift. Je bereidt bent om eens in de anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld te werken (must)! Wat bieden wij? Een passend salaris tussen € 3.651,- tot € 5.014,- bruto per maand, een laptop van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld , een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling; Ruimte om te ondernemen : een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen; Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam, thuis en ongeveer eens per anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld (richtlijn bij fulltime: 3 dagen kantoor, 2 dagen thuis), inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werktijden; Volop ruimte om te blijven ontwikkelen via de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen, e-learnings en webinars; Oog voor elkaar : een fijne werksfeer met ruimte voor plezier, een inhouse gym en een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget. Enthousiast? Herken jij jezelf in deze rol en wil je het datalandschap van Liquid Food mee vormgeven? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Nog vragen? Neem contact op met Angel Micheal Alemawor , interim corporate recruiter, via +31 6 11804991 of . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: About Invisix Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data. We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. Our culture is professional and fast-paced, with short communication lines and a strong sense of shared purpose. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger. The Role We're looking for a System Architect to decide what our metrology equipment is and why it's built that way: concept choices, system decomposition, budget allocations and the technology roadmap amongst others. Reporting to our CTO, you look two to five years ahead and beyond, and shape our product line across several generations, so that what we build today still makes sense for our customers tomorrow. You work with our customers' technology roadmaps, marketing, the heads of R&D, our function architects and customer support, and you lead through persuasion rather than formal authority. Our system engineer builds on your concept and makes the current program work to spec. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe. Key Responsibilities Own the system architecture of our metrology product line, looking two to five years ahead and beyond, across several product generations Make and justify the key concept choices, weighing physics, performance, cost and risk Decompose the system into modules and interfaces, and allocate the key budgets, such as throughput, cost of goods, availability and performance Translate our customers' technology roadmaps and future needs into product requirements, together with marketing and customers Define our platform and reuse strategy, and decide which technologies we invest in Align the heads of R&D and our function architects behind the architecture, and take on adjacent responsibilities as the company grows, such as representing Invisix in technical discussions with customers and partners Is this you? description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Seoul</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human.
