title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead
description: Be yourself at Protolabs Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. Why Protolabs? We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. Join our team as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead! This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain. The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority. What You Will Do: Technical leadership & core development Drive core development of transformative capabilities. Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives. Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management. Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases. Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner. Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups. Market observation & innovation Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company. Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability. Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers. Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements. Cross-organisation delivery & architecture Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions. Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review. Platform & environment Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment. Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability. Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery. Mentoring & influencing Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews. Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them. Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization. What You Bring: Technical 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data. Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers). Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes. Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt). Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs. Cloud-native, building scalable, secure, and compliant production systems. MLOps background: CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring/observability, IaC, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Prefect, Weights & Biases, or equivalents). Familiarity with backend systems principles, including API serving, containerization, distributed compute, security considerations. Leadership & Collaboration Demonstrated ability to lead technically without formal authority: mentoring engineers, design/PR/documentation reviews, and aligning stakeholders across teams. Experience owning architecture end-to-end: drafting, sharing, and driving sign-off of architectural designs across multiple teams. Experience working in Agile environments — contributing to Scrum ceremonies, breaking work into increments, and collaborating closely with product and engineering management in iterative delivery. Ability to lead through ambiguity and early-stage environments; proactive, systematic problem solving. Ability to translate emerging technology into business value — framing opportunities, scoping with product and engineering partners, and identifying integration requirements. Excellent communication skills across global departments: able to align engineers, product/engineering management, and leadership, and to present technical opportunities to both engineering and business audiences. Mindset Builder mentality: pragmatic, resourceful, iterative. Curiosity and willingness to experiment while ensuring quality and security. Critical thinking in uncertain or rapidly evolving contexts Bonus Points If You Have : Experience with AWS managed services. Experience with manufacturing/industrial ML applications. Experience with geometric/spatial data: point clouds, meshes, voxel grids, or CAD - derived representations. Experience with vector databases, scalable retrieval architectures, guard railing LLMs, and prompt engineering. Experience collaborating in international teams across time zones. What's In It For You: Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter. Annual company bonus. We celebrate success together! Employees are not only rewarded for their achievements but also for contributing to the overall success of the business. Wellness and well-being with access to OpenUp psychologists, practice mindfulness with Headspace and tons more. Doggo-friendly office. We are big pet lovers and fully encourage hanging out with your (and your colleagues’) furry friends in the office Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration. We offer learning and development days to be used for training or on volunteering, money to spend on learning courses, events, trainings, Access to our in-house LEARN platform with diverse courses, training, and workshops, In-house 3D Printing and much more! Follow us on Instagram to see what Life at Protolabs is all about! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites. It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers. Tasks Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team Requirements Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B) Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously. Benefits Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo Employee stock options: you own part of what you build New office in Zürich Kreis 5 Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster Work directly with the founders Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Hoofd Servicemonteur Warmtepompen
description: Hoofd Servicemonteur Als Hoofd Servicemonteur ben jij het technische boegbeeld van onze serviceafdeling. Waar een reguliere servicemonteur de standaard onderhoudsbeurten en reparaties uitvoert, kom jij in beeld bij de complexe uitdagingen. Je coacht je collega-monteurs in het veld en bent de schakel tussen de praktijk en ons engineering-team. Wat ga je doen? Feedbackloop: Je koppelt bevindingen uit het veld direct terug aan de productontwikkelaars in Den Haag om de volgende generatie warmtepompen nóg beter te maken. Wie zoeken wij? title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. Who we’re looking for Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps. Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead. You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth. Strategy and leadership Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets. Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs. Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product. Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped. Technical SEO and architecture Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content. Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages. Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility. Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection. GEO Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages. Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment. Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves. Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms. Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks. Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready. Content and topical authority Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent. Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing. Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output. Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice. Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire. Measurement and reporting Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders. What success looks like Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets. A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors. The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility. Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. In terms of your experience and skills: Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment. Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed. A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking. A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale. A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps. Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings. A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership. A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment. Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams. Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools. Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have. Our offer A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home. A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time. A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do. Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform. A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500. A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role. A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance. An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience. The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year. An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day. Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience. Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page . We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice. If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you. To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential. title: Stage Online Marketing | Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
description: Wat ga je doen? Als Online Marketing Stagiair(e) bij Flagship Amsterdam krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan de online zichtbaarheid van deze unieke rondvaartorganisatie en al haar labels, zoals Flagship Bike Tours, Aemstelland en Voyage. Je houdt je bezig met het verbeteren van onze websites, het ondersteunen van online campagnes en het analyseren van resultaten. Je denkt mee over hoe we potentiële gasten bereiken en ervoor zorgen dat zij uiteindelijk bij ons boeken. Tijdens deze stage doe je brede praktijkervaring op binnen online marketing. Wat ga je leren? Uitvoeren van zoekwoordenonderzoek en toepassen van SEO; Optimaliseren van webpagina's en verbeteren van de gebruikerservaring; Ondersteunen bij het opzetten en uitvoeren van online campagnes; Werken met website- en campagnedata om resultaten inzichtelijk te maken; Analyseren van het gedrag van websitebezoekers en de boekingsflow; Samenwerken met externe marketingpartners en leren werken met marketingbriefings. Praktisch Startdatum: februari 2027; Duur: minimaal 5 maanden; Type stage: meewerkstage; Stagevergoeding: €500 per maand; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam. Wat we aanbieden Goede begeleiding van ervaren collega's, met ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling; Een leerzame stage waarin je kennismaakt met verschillende aspecten van de organisatie en veel praktijkervaring opdoet; Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten; Een gezellige en informele werksfeer met gezamenlijke lunch op ons kantoor in hartje Amsterdam; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding. Functievereisten Je volgt een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in een relevant vakgebied, zoals marketing, communicatie of commerciële economie; Je beheerst zowel Nederlands als Engels goed; Je hebt affiniteit met online marketing en bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe websites en online campagnes werken; Je werkt nauwkeurig, bent analytisch ingesteld en vindt het leuk om met cijfers bezig te zijn; Je neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen; Ervaring met SEO, online advertenties of websitebeheer is mooi meegenomen. Over Flagship Amsterdam Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. title: Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> San Francisco, CA or New York, NY (In-office / Hybrid)</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare is seeking an exceptional, highly organized, and discreet <strong>Executive & Personal Assistant</strong> to join our Founders’ Office support team. Based in either <strong>San Francisco</strong> or <strong>New York City</strong>, this role works in close alignment with two Senior Executive Business Partners who manage direct daily support for Cloudflare’s Co-Founders.</p> <p>This is a versatile, high-touch role combining executive administrative support, event coordination, personal projects, and lifestyle logistics. You will provide critical execution capacity behind the scenes—anticipating needs effortlessly, moving between business and personal requests seamlessly, and ensuring every detail is handled with precision, follow-through, and strict confidentiality.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Executive & Founder Support:</strong> Manage executive calendar coordination, meeting logistics, priority tracking, expense reports, and backup support alongside the Senior Executive Business Partners.</li> <li><strong>Travel & Itinerary Planning:</strong> Coordinate domestic and international executive and personal travel, including private aviation charters, luxury lodging, ground transportation, dining arrangements, and detailed door-to-door itineraries.</li> <li><strong>Events & Entertaining:</strong> Plan and execute private dinners, VIP hospitality, and personal events, managing venue sourcing, guest lists, menus, invitations, and on-site vendor logistics.</li> <li><strong>Personal & Lifestyle Support:</strong> Coordinate day-to-day personal logistics, appointments, dining reservations, executive gifting, wellness schedules, and ad-hoc errands.</li> <li><strong>Special Projects:</strong> Assist with special research, bespoke purchasing, prospective property coordination, and vendor oversight for home/office maintenance and seasonal projects.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of experience supporting C-suite executives, Founders, or UHNW individuals in a combined executive and personal assistant capacity.</li> <li><strong>Core Skills:</strong> Exceptional organization, eagle-eyed attention to detail, and proactive follow-through</li> <li><strong>Travel & Hospitality Expertise:</strong> Deep experience booking, managing, and troubleshooting travel, including private aviation charters and luxury accommodations. You offer a high-touch concierge service.</li> <li><strong>Professional Demeanor:</strong> Personable, polished, and collaborative, adept at partnering seamlessly with internal teams and external vendors, holding firm boundaries, and maintaining complete confidentiality</li> <li><strong>Technical Savvy:</strong> Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace (G-Suite) alongside practical adoption of AI and modern productivity workflows.</li> </ul> <h2><strong style="font-size: 14px;">Compensation</strong></h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.</span></p></div><h2>Role</h2> <p>As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate. </p> <h2>How your work moves the mission forward</h2> <ul> <li>Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models</li> <li>Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)</li> <li>Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties</li> <li>Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)</li> <li>Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories</li> <li>Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)</li> <li>Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware</li> <li>Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data </li> </ul> <h2>Skills you will need to be successful</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .</li> <li><strong>3D Vision:</strong> Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation .</li> <li><strong>Modern Deep Learning:</strong> Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)</li> <li><strong>Programming & Systems</strong>: Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)</li> </ul> <h2>Skills that will differentiate your candidacy</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus</li> <li>Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.</p> <p>If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: ----- Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Project Manager
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The opportunity You work on our most strategic accounts and turn signed deals into live, revenue-generating deployments. On our largest global rollouts, successfully embedding BLP in the customer's system landscape (e.g., ERP) decides whether the go-live date holds. As a Technical Project Manager, you own the technical solution. You shape it with the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, write the specification our engineers build from, and drive internal alignment and on-time delivery. What you'll do Shape the technical solution with the customer’s business and IT departments on large and complex accounts, and push until answers are specific enough to build on. Turn requirements into a clear, implementable specification for our engineers. Manage external and internal technical stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery and aligned priorities. Flag major development needs and blockers early, and bring a clear recommendation to the customer's steering committee. Support Project Managers on technical feasibility, effort and sequencing, through the first go-live. What you bring 3+ years in solution design, technical consulting, enterprise integration or technical product work. title: Event & Content Managerin/Manager
description: Stell dir vor, du bist mittendrin: Du begleitest innovative Projekte für die Schweizer Armee, hältst spannende Geschichten in Bildern und Videos fest und bringst Menschen an inspirierenden Events zusammen. Als Event & Content Managerin/Manager bei den Swiss Innovation Forces machst du Innovation sichtbar und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen mit den passenden Inhalten erreichen. Gemeinsam leisten wir einen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zukunftsfähigkeit der Schweiz. Wie du zur Sicherheit der Schweiz beiträgst Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Organisation von Events (ca. 60%) und der Erstellung von Content (ca. 40%). Je nach Saison kann sich diese Aufteilung etwas verschieben. Dabei erwarten dich vielseitige Aufgaben: Du planst und organisierst inspirierende Events für die Schweizer Armee, von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung vor Ort. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Inhalte und Eventformate weiter, probierst Neues aus und misst ihren Erfolg. Du machst unsere Innovationsprojekte sichtbar und erstellst spannende Beiträge für LinkedIn, YouTube und unsere interne Kommunikation. Du entwickelst Ideen für neue Inhalte und setzt diese selbstständig um, von Texten über Fotos bis zu kurzen Videos. Du bist regelmässig in der Schweiz unterwegs, um unsere Projekte und die Menschen dahinter zu begleiten und ihre Geschichten festzuhalten. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Content für Social Media, insbesondere mit Texten, Fotografie und Videos. Einen sicheren Umgang mit gängigen Content- und AI-Tools; Erfahrung mit Grafikprogrammen wie Adobe ist ein Plus. Erfahrung und Freude im/am Organisieren von Events und daran, Menschen zusammenzubringen. Interesse an sicherheitspolitischen Themen und Neugier, dich in neue und komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten. Eine selbstständige, kreative und pragmatische Arbeitsweise. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und packst auch bei der Umsetzung mit an. Selbstreflexion und die Bereitschaft, dich weiterzuentwickeln. Worauf du dich verlassen kannst Ein Team, das dich unterstützt und dir psychologische Sicherheit bietet. Ein unternehmerisches Umfeld, wo du dich und deine Ideen einbringen kannst. Ein attraktives Salär und ein 2. Klasse-GA. Ein inspirierender Arbeitsplatz mit gutem Kaffee, zentral in Zürich und Bern. Bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Schweizer Armee zu gestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Egal, ob du Militärdienst geleistet hast oder nicht. Auch wenn du noch nicht alles zu 100 Prozent mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir bauen auf ein vielfältiges Team, in dem alle ihre Stärken ausspielen können. Auf ein Bewerbungsschreiben verzichten wir bewusst. Viel lieber möchten wir dich mit ein paar kurzen Fragen und einem Beispiel deiner bisherigen Arbeit kennenlernen. Reiche deine Bewerbung einfach über den Button auf dieser Seite ein oder melde dich bei Fragen direkt bei uns. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX |  New York, NY | Lisbon, Portugal | London, UK</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>As the Engineering Manager for our Developer Observability Platform you will manage a high-velocity customer-obsessed team. Your mission will be to empower customers by making their telemetry discoverable and actionable in one place. </p> <p>The team is international and distributed, they move fast and are deeply attuned to customer feedback. They bring a deep range of observability experience from major companies and fast-moving startups. This is a deeply cross-functional role that will need to understand the nuances of monitoring some of our most complex and high volume primitives such as Workers, Workers for Platforms, Agents, and Durable Objects. We have a high bar and expect you to raise it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cultivate a team culture that values fast iteration, high agency, and ownership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with a range of platform and product teams to instrument and surface meaningful data in actionable ways.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>A minimum of 8 years of relevant industry experience, including at least 4 years managing software engineering teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record leading teams that have shipped and operated complex, large-scale systems and data-driven applications. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a technically savvy <strong>Engineering Manager</strong> to lead the <strong>Sandpipers Team</strong> within the Marketplace Payments domain. This team owns the tooling for preventing fraudulent payments and fraudulent chargebacks. You will report to the Director of Engineering and work hand in hand with Product and Data peers.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>People Leadership:</strong> Lead, coach, and grow a talented team of engineers. Build and maintain a team culture based on trust, commitment, psychological safety, and clear accountability. Conduct ongoing feedback, performance, and compensation reviews.</li> <li><strong>Product Discovery & Planning:</strong> Partner closely with Product Managers and the team during early-stage discovery to map out the technical strategy for future product initiatives and come up with the delivery plan.</li> <li><strong>Delivery:</strong> Lead the team’s delivery against the product roadmap while maintaining team's health.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Leadership:</strong> Highly skilled at building engineering teams, hiring new talent, setting clear scope, and managing priorities to keep the team focused and motivated.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Foundations:</strong> Background in backend engineering (ideally handling external API structures, webhook payloads, and cross-service async communication). You are comfortable guiding technical decision-making. </li> <li><strong>Excellent Communicator & Vendor Coordinator:</strong> Outstanding stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and confidently across internal teams (Product, Compliance, Legal) and external global technology providers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work </strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. title: Legal Counsel
description: Position Overview Axelera AI is a fast-growing AI semiconductor company headquartered in Eindhoven, building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration hardware and software, from the Metis AI platform for edge inference to next-generation AI processing units. We are scaling quickly: new customers, new partners, new markets, and a growing volume of complex commercial deals across the global semiconductor supply chain. We are looking for an experienced commercial lawyer to be the engine of our commercial legal function. You will close deals, build the playbooks and processes that let the business move fast without taking on unmanaged risk, and lead how legal operates day to day, with AI in the loop so a lean team delivers more with less. This is a hands-on role with real scope to shape the function as it grows. Key responsibilities: Commercial contracting Draft, review and negotiate a high volume of commercial agreements: customer, distribution, reseller and OEM/ODM agreements; sales terms and EULAs; supply and manufacturing agreements (foundry, OSAT, component suppliers); technology and IP licences; software and SaaS agreements; evaluation, early access and development agreements; R&D collaboration and consortium agreements; services and vendor agreements; and MOUs, LOIs and partnership terms. Act as the trusted, pragmatic adviser to Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations and Finance, giving clear, commercial risk calls at pace. Advise on key semiconductor and AI issues: IP ownership and licensing, warranties and liability caps, product liability, export controls and sanctions, data protection and the EU AI Act. Support the CFO and Head of Legal on strategic matters, including corporate transactions and board-level work, as needed. Playbooks and scale Build AI-ready contract playbooks, fallback positions and approval matrices so AI tools and the business can handle routine deals with minimal Legal involvement. Create and own a library of standard templates for our core agreement types (e.g. NDA, customer terms, evaluation, distributor, supplier) aligned to our risk appetite. Train commercial teams on contract basics, negotiation positions and when to escalate to Legal. Legal operations Lead legal operations: intake and triage, prioritisation, SLAs and reporting on legal workload and turnaround. Own the legal tech and AI stack: select, implement and continuously improve AI review and drafting tools, CLM, e-signature and the contract repository, automating repeatable work end to end. Own contract lifecycle management, including obligation tracking, renewals and keeping contract records complete and up to date. Set up clear policies and processes that scale with the company. Collaboration Work alongside, supervise and mentor a Junior Legal Counsel, allocating work and reviewing output. Manage external counsel efficiently, including scope and budget, and determine which matters are best handled in-house. Report to the Head of Legal (in the interim, the CFO) and help shape the future structure of the legal team. Qualifications: Essential Qualified lawyer with 7+ years' PQE in commercial and corporate law, from a leading firm and/or in-house. Substantial in-house experience in tech, semiconductors, hardware or deep tech, ideally at a scale-up. A strong track record negotiating complex, high-value international contracts, including IP-heavy and supply chain deals. Hands-on use of AI tools in daily legal work, plus experience building playbooks and processes that let a small team scale. Commercial judgement that finds the route to yes, and the ability to explain risk simply to senior stakeholders. Comfort with ambiguity, high volume and shifting priorities. Fluent business English, our working and contract language. Desirable Semiconductor, AI or embedded systems experience (foundry, licensing, OEM deals). Knowledge of export controls (EU dual-use, US EAR), sanctions and the EU AI Act. Experience implementing CLM or AI contract tools, prompting, or building no-code automations. Experience mentoring junior lawyers, or exposure to venture-backed companies and governance. Dutch or another European language. How We Work: AI-First Legal We're building a lean legal function, not scaling by headcount. AI handles first-pass review, redlining, drafting and research, while lawyers focus on judgement and negotiation. Routine work is self-serve through templates and AI-assisted workflows. We measure turnaround and outcomes, and we use AI responsibly, with human review and clear guardrails on confidentiality and accuracy. Location Hybrid, with 2 days per week in our Amsterdam or Eindhoven office. What we offer This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares. An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI. Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. If you have been approached by someone on our behalf and want to confirm it’s legitimate, please contact us directly at Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Named Account Executive, New Business
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <hr> <p>Munich, Frankfurt or Berlin</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <hr> <p>We are seeking an exceptional new-logo builder to join our <strong>Named Sales Team</strong> as a <strong>Senior Named Account Executive</strong>. Your primary mission is new logo acquisition within an assigned portfolio of high-potential Named accounts: identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new business with leading enterprises across Germany. You will create opportunities where no existing relationship or active buying process exists, open doors at executive level, and establish Cloudflare as a long-term platform partner. Developing and expanding a limited number of existing Named accounts will be secondary to winning new business. The ideal candidate combines a relentless prospecting mindset with sophisticated enterprise sales execution, executive presence, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.</p> <p>As a Senior Named Account Executive, you will own your territory and assigned Named-account portfolio end-to-end. You will prioritise accounts based on their potential, build multi-year account plans, generate high-quality pipeline through direct outreach and the wider partner ecosystem, and orchestrate virtual deal teams across Customer Engineering, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, challenge customers’ thinking with a strong point of view, and consistently exceed new logo and new business targets. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across prospect research, account prioritisation, executive outreach, account planning, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them as a genuine force multiplier in how you hunt and sell.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Responsibilities</span></h2> <hr> <p><strong>New Logo Acquisition within Named Accounts:</strong> Own the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new business across your assigned Named-account portfolio as the primary focus of the role. Build pipeline proactively through personalised executive outreach, disciplined prospecting, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, industry networks, and referrals. Create demand rather than relying on inbound opportunities, and consistently bring significant new logos onto the Cloudflare platform.</p> <p><strong>Named Account Planning:</strong> Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for priority net-new targets and selected existing Named accounts. Identify whitespace, business initiatives, power structures, buying processes, competitive dynamics, and potential entry points. Continuously assess account potential and concentrate time and resources on the accounts and opportunities with the greatest potential for platform-wide adoption.</p> <p><strong>Executive Relationship Management:</strong> Build trusted relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level, often starting without an existing Cloudflare presence. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target Named accounts and act as a trusted advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs.</p> <p><strong>Complex Sales Cycle Leadership:</strong> Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Establish clear mutual action plans, maintain control of deal momentum, qualification, and next steps, and advance opportunities with precision and appropriate urgency.</p> <p><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, positioning comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point solutions.</p> <p><strong>Virtual Deal Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, Legal, Partners, and other specialists to win complex, high-value opportunities. Align resources around a differentiated strategy, proactively remove blockers, and deliver a consistently excellent prospect experience throughout the sales cycle.</p> <p><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution:</strong> Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve the quality and velocity of your sales execution. Apply them to account research and prioritisation, hypothesis development, stakeholder mapping, personalised executive outreach, meeting preparation, competitive analysis, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously experiment with new ways to make your Named-account management and customer engagement sharper and more effective.</p> <p><strong>Digital Transformation & AI Positioning:</strong> Serve as a credible partner to enterprises navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, compliance, security, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers of customers’ long-term transformation agendas.</p> <p><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Build and maintain sufficient high-quality pipeline across your Named-account portfolio to consistently achieve ambitious new business targets. Deliver accurate, evidence-based account and opportunity forecasts to sales leadership, with clear visibility into qualification, deal status, risks, stakeholder alignment, and required actions. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex enterprise sales cycles.</p> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s business objectives. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements while protecting long-term customer value and Cloudflare’s position as a strategic platform partner.</p> <p><strong>Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution:</strong> Share field intelligence, competitive insight, and winning practices openly across the German and wider international teams. Contribute to Cloudflare’s understanding of the German Named-account market, partner with colleagues to improve execution, and elevate the performance of those around you through coaching, collaboration, and example.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. title: Recruiter, R&D (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. In this individual contributor role, you'll partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Security, and UX and own searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines and use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, while growing into a trusted talent advisor.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage full-cycle searches for roles such as Backend and Frontend Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Security Engineers, Data Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers, delivering against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li> <li>Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, technical requirements, team context, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed.</li> <li>Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li> <li>Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.</li> <li>Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.</li> <li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.</li> <li>Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.</li> <li>Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.</li> <li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.</li> <li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li>Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Our team members share learnings and create reusable resources to improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Research & Development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Marketing Specialist (Benelux & Nordics)

Are you passionate about games and driven to provide exceptional products and services to customers worldwide? This is the company you are looking for! At Jumbo Group, we are not just an international company; we are an international playground. Our world is filled with games, puzzles, and toys that spread joy and inspire creativity across the globe. We enjoy a robust presence throughout Europe and in all corners of the world. About the role Are you ready to make our brands shine – both online and offline? As Marketing Specialist, you’ll take full ownership of a selection of Jumbo’s brands across the Benelux and Nordics. From strategy to execution, from campaign concept to retail catalogue — you’ll manage your brands full journey. You translate global brand strategies into local plans that drive awareness, engagement and sales at retail. You’ll also make sure your brands perform at their best on all online platforms. In this dynamic role, you’ll work closely with the Marketing Manager, the local Sales teams, Product Development, the global Brand team, and the local eCommerce manager. Together, you’ll make sure Jumbo’s brands are top of mind for retailers and consumers– no two days are the same. What you’ll be working on: Brand & Campaign Management · Take ownership of your brand portfolio in Benelux & Nordics. · Translate global brand strategies into local brand plans and activation strategies. · Manage the local assortment: know your products inside out, select the right new launches together with commercial team, and ensure the best fit for your markets. · Be a sparring partner for local and global teams, bringing in fresh ideas and creativity and ensure alignment across markets. · Monitor brand performance, track results and adjust plans accordingly. Share insights with the sales teams and global team. · Create and manage impactful campaigns, events & retail activations (ATL and BTL) in close collaboration with sales and e-commerce. · Work closely with creative, media, influencer, social media and activation agencies. · Create presentations and sell-in decks for sales, retailers and partners. · Communicate plans, updates and best practices clearly across internal teams and external partners. E-Commerce & Digital Marketing · Ensure strong online visibility and conversion for your brands through optimised product content. · Execute retail media campaigns and product activations on Bol.com, Amazon and other key online partners, together with the local e-com manager. · Align your brand presence across Jumbo’s local social channels in collaboration with our SoMe agency and fellow Marketing Specialists. · Share and apply digital insights and best practices across markets. What you bring to the team · Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communication, Business Administration, Digital Commerce, or a related field. · Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in Marketing, Brand Management, Trade Marketing or Digital Marketing. · Hands-on with e-commerce platforms (Bol.com, Amazon or similar) and retail media campaigns. · Affinity with social media management and content creation. · Analytical and organisational skills; confident with Excel, PowerPoint and analytics tools. · Experience in the toy, entertainment, or FMCG sector is a plus, but not mandatory. What makes you a great fit · You’re a strong multitasker who loves variety – product launches, campaigns, activations, all in one week? Bring it on! · A creative storyteller with fresh ideas and an eye for detail. · A confident communicator in Dutch & English; French or a Nordic language is a plus. · A collaborative, hands-on team player who enjoys making things happen. · Passion for toys & games – you know how to turn play into impact. title: Customer Support Manager (m/f/x) – Hourly Position, Zurich
description: Your mission As a Customer Support Manager, you will be the first point of contact for our users and ensure they feel well looked after.
