title: People Operations Onboarding Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>London, UK</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Work arrangement:</strong> Hybrid </p> <p><strong>Engagement:</strong> 9 month contract</p> <p><strong>Hours:</strong> Full-time</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> Global Onboarding Program Manager, Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is building a consistent, welcoming onboarding experience for new hires around the world. We're hiring two Onboarding Specialists one in the Austin, TX and one in London, England. You'll run the day-to-day work of getting new hires ready, welcomed, and set up for success.</p> <p>You'll be the main contact for new hires, hiring managers, and recruiters from offer acceptance through the first weeks. You'll partner with IT, recruiting, learning and development, and Workplace teams, and you'll report to the Global Onboarding Program Manager.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Manage start dates.</strong> Track upcoming starts, handle start date changes, and work with recruiters and hiring managers to keep timelines on track.</li> <li><strong>Own the preboarding process.</strong> Complete and follow up on every step between offer acceptance and Day 1, so each new hire arrives ready.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate orientation.</strong> Lead regional new hire orientation sessions, in person and virtually.</li> <li><strong>Manage orientation facilitators.</strong> Schedule, prepare, and support the colleagues who present at orientation. Handle changes and keep sessions running smoothly.</li> <li><strong>Provide onboarding support.</strong> Answer new hire and manager questions, resolve common issues through our ticketing system, and escalate when needed.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with new hires.</strong> Send timely, clear, and friendly messages that tell new hires what to expect before and during their first days.</li> <li><strong>Maintain and create onboarding content.</strong> Keep orientation materials, guides, and resources accurate and up to date.</li> <li><strong>Support new hires in Workday.</strong> Manage new hire data in Workday. Help new hires complete their tasks and training, and fix issues as they come up.</li> <li><strong>Support right to work and work authorization.</strong> Verify new hires' employment eligibility, including the US I-9 and UK Right to Work processes, and our internal work authorization programs. Follow up on outstanding documents, and keep records accurate and confidential.</li> <li><strong>Improve how we work.</strong> Spot recurring problems, build simple tools and templates, and improve documentation to make onboarding smoother and more scalable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>2+ years in HR operations, onboarding, recruiting coordination, learning and development coordination, or a similar role</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, with a professional, warm, and clear tone</li> <li>Confident presenter and facilitator, with experience leading live sessions for groups, in person and virtually</li> <li>Experience coordinating or managing volunteers, speakers, or facilitators and keeping a schedule on track</li> <li>Experience working across teams, such as IT, recruiting, L&D, and Workplace</li> <li>The ability to anticipate needs and fix problems before they become escalations</li> <li>Attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy</li> <li>Ability to manage many cases and events at once</li> <li>A process improvement mindset, with experience developing tools and improving documentation and knowledge-base articles</li> <li>Discretion and good judgment with confidential employee information</li> <li>Self-direction, with the ability to prioritize and manage your own work</li> <li>Ability to work independently and know when to escalate</li> <li>Hands-on experience with an HRIS (Workday preferred), a ticketing tool (Zendesk preferred), and virtual meeting platforms [e.g., Zoom, Google Meet]</li> <li>Experience with Google Workspace and with GChat or similar tools</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Nice to have</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with automation or AI tools to streamline workflows</li> <li>Experience with global or multi-country onboarding</li> <li>Experience creating training or onboarding content</li> <li>Basic IT troubleshooting knowledge (SSO/MFA, device setup, access requests)</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Schedule</strong></span></p> <p>The Austin role works core hours in the Central time zone and partners with a Specialist in London. Some flexibility is needed to cover orientation sessions and handoffs across regions. London only: This role may occasionally support coverage for APJC, which may require some early or late hours.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Benefits</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>For US: Full time contractors are eligible for Medical insurance only after 90 days of employment</li> <li>For EMEA: Full time contractors are eligible for full benefits on their first day of hire</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>Amsterdam, Netherlands and London, United Kingdom<br><br></p> <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: 8 - 12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer </li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This role features

title: Mainframe Data Engineer - 3 to 6 Months Contract
description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with a strong background in designing, deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-scale data engineering platforms within secure, on-premises and air-gapped environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience working with Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters , including installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and workload management in environments with restricted or no internet connectivity. This role will support our Global Data Centre (GDC) environment, requiring a candidate who understands the operational and technical challenges of delivering robust, scalable, and secure data platforms within isolated infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with infrastructure, platform, DevOps, and data engineering teams to build and maintain reliable data processing capabilities. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters in on-premises and air-gapped environments. Manage the full lifecycle of Hadoop/Spark platforms, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Develop, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and distributed data processing. Optimise Spark workloads and Hadoop cluster performance, including resource allocation, job scheduling, and capacity management. Work with PostgreSQL and other enterprise data systems to support data integration, storage, and processing requirements. Support the deployment and management of containerised applications using Kubernetes and Helm. Implement and manage service-to-service communication and traffic management using Istio Service Mesh. Ensure software dependencies, container images, packages, and platform components can be deployed and maintained without external internet connectivity. Implement secure configuration and operational practices aligned with enterprise security requirements. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cluster, application, and data pipeline issues. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams to ensure platform stability and availability. Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform architecture documentation. Support integration with legacy enterprise data systems, including VSAM. Requirements Required Technical Skills & Experience 1. Apache Hadoop & Apache Spark Strong hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Apache Hadoop clusters. Proven experience deploying and managing Apache Spark clusters and workloads. Experience with distributed data processing, batch processing, and large-scale data pipelines. Strong understanding of cluster architecture, resource management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience operating big data platforms in on-premises and air-gapped environments. 2. Air-Gapped & On-Premises Infrastructure Practical experience working in isolated, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments. Understanding of offline software installation, dependency management, package repositories, and container image management. Experience managing platform deployments without direct access to public internet repositories. Knowledge of secure infrastructure operations and enterprise deployment standards. 3. Containerisation & Platform Engineering Experience with Kubernetes-based platform deployments. Hands-on experience with Helm charts for application and platform deployments. Working knowledge of Istio Service Mesh, including traffic management, service discovery, and secure service-to-service communication. Understanding of container orchestration and microservices architecture. 4. Data Systems & Engineering Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database integration and performance considerations. Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines. Understanding of distributed data storage and processing architectures. Knowledge of VSAM and integration with legacy enterprise data environments. Preferred / Desirable Skills Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or government data centre environments. Familiarity with Linux system administration. Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management. Knowledge of data security, access controls, encryption, and secure data handling. Experience with monitoring, logging, and platform observability. Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices in restricted-network environments. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical engineer rather than purely an architectural or theoretical resource. They should be comfortable taking ownership of the deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational management of Hadoop and Spark platforms. Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical experience working within environments where internet connectivity is restricted or unavailable, with an understanding of the additional complexities involved in deploying and maintaining enterprise data platforms in such environments. title: Software Engineer II: Autonomous Supply Chains
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains</h1> <h2>About Flexport</h2> <p>Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.</p> <p>Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.</p> <p>Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.</p> <p>Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at <a href="https://amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com">amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com</a>.</p> <h2>The team: Autonomous Supply Chains</h2> <p>Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.</p> <p>Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer II on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. title: Commercial Account Executive, META
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. Role Description Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s META growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular travel to the region, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our META Commercial team. We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week. What You’ll Do Grow Horizon3.ai’s META Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions. Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the META market. Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter. Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities. Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes. Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention. Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood. Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience. What You’ll Bring At least 3-5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas. Previous experience selling technical solutions into the META region. Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential. Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management. The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person. Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC). Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach , LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack. The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. Fluency in English and Arabic; additional language skills such as French are welcomed. Travel Required We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager. Perks of Horizon3.ai Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. The Opportunity The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building. What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does. You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it. In this role you will Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods. Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff. Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update. Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse. Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week. Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one. What This Role Is Not You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so. Who You Are You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up. You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. Fluent in product work: you know how discovery, design and shipping actually run, and you can talk to designers and engineers without a translator. title: Product Manager, Self-serve Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare's self-serve business is the growth engine that powers millions of customers, ranging from solo developers to growing SMBs and larger companies. </p> <p>The Product Manager for Self-Serve Growth is a technical role that helps optimize and scale the experience for these customers. You will focus on the customer journey from awareness through retention, ensuring our users experience the value of Cloudflare as quickly as possible. This is a highly collaborative, visible, and analytical role that will build, ship, and move quickly without perfect information.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <p><strong>Problems to work through</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Time to value:</strong> How do we get self-serve users from sign-up to their first successful outcome as fast as possible, reducing friction in their initial setup?</li> <li><strong>Conversion & Upgrade Paths:</strong> How do we help free-tier users naturally discover the value of our paid plans and seamlessly upgrade when the time is right?</li> <li><strong>Onboarding Optimization:</strong> Where are users dropping off in the registration and activation flow, and how can we redesign those steps to improve conversion rates?</li> <li><strong>Growth Experimentation:</strong> How do we design, launch, and measure A/B tests on pricing pages, billing flows, and in-app messaging to drive business metrics?</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <p><strong>Get Stuff Done: </strong>You are relentless at execution and driving things forward,  even in ambiguous situations. You balance what’s urgent with what’s important and love to ship.<br><strong>Growth Mindset & Curiosity:</strong> You are eager to learn, highly adaptable, and passionate about understanding how products grow. You proactively ask questions and absorb complex concepts quickly.<br><strong>Coding and AX/UX credibility</strong>: You build with a team of coding agents to ship everything from new features to bug fixes.<strong> </strong>You have an engineering background or understand the modern stack and customer/agent experiences well enough to hold your own with engineers.<br><strong>Analytical Foundation:</strong> You have a strong analytical baseline. You are comfortable diving into data to understand user behavior, and you can combine quantitative data with qualitative feedback to form hypotheses.<br><strong>Experimentation and Velocity:</strong> You are excited by the idea of A/B testing. You understand that not every hypothesis will be proven right, but you are eager to ship, measure, learn, and iterate – even if this means getting into very technical implementation.<br><strong>Customer Empathy:</strong> You can step into the shoes of a self-serve user and advocate for simple, intuitive experiences over complex technical hurdles.<br><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration:</strong> You communicate clearly and are excited to partner closely with engineering, design, and product marketing to bring features to the finish line.</p> <h3>Bonus Points:</h3> <ul> <li>At Cloudflare it’s pretty helpful to understand how the Internet really works at layers 2 through 7. If you don’t have this, be prepared to speak with mastery about another realm of similar complexity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $179,000 - $230,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. title: Senior Delivery Consultant
description: Who we are Software Improvement Group (SIG) helpt organisaties grip te houden op de software waar hun business op draait. Ons platform Sigrid® bestaat uit twee delen. Onze klanten zijn grote (internationale) ondernemingen, financiële instellingen en overheidsorganisaties. Zij vertrouwen op SIG om softwarekwaliteit structureel onderdeel te maken van de manier waarop ze hun IT-landschap besturen. Jij leidt die implementaties van begin tot eind: van kick-off en technische onboarding tot training, rapportage en de borging van softwarekwaliteit in de werkwijze van de klant. Of Sigrid nu als SaaS-oplossing wordt afgenomen of on-premise in de eigen infrastructuur van de klant draait, jij zorgt dat het project slaagt. Dat maakt het werk uitdagend en cutting edge. Je werkt met technologie die vooroploopt, op het snijvlak van softwarekwaliteit en AI, bij organisaties die nu de stap zetten naar softwareontwikkeling met AI coding agents. Wat je bij hen implementeert, bepaalt mede hoe zij die stap veilig en beheerst kunnen maken. Je werkt voor grote corporate organisaties en overheidsinstellingen, vaak met honderden ontwikkelteams en duizenden applicaties. Je vertaalt de inzichten uit Sigrid naar rapportages en adviezen die passen bij je publiek. Dezelfde data vertelt voor ieder van hen een ander verhaal, en jij weet die vertaalslag te maken. Intern noemen we deze rol Senior Guidance Consultant. Je maakt deel uit van ons Guidance-team: een klein, hands-on team van consultants dat nauw samenwerkt met onze Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, technische consultants en het productteam. Na de implementatie draag je de klant over aan de Customer Success Manager, die de langetermijnrelatie voortzet. Wat ga je doen Je leidt complete implementatietrajecten waarin Sigrid wordt ingebed in grote organisaties, zowel SaaS als on-premise: van projectplan en kick-off tot technische onboarding, training en overdracht. Je bent de projectleider: je bewaakt planning, scope en budget, managet risico’s en afhankelijkheden, en sluit aan op de governance van de klant, zoals stuurgroepen, security- en compliance-eisen en beheerprocessen. Bij on-premise implementaties werk je samen met de infrastructuur- en securityteams van de klant en met onze technische consultants, zodat installatie, configuratie en integratie soepel verlopen. Je begeleidt ontwikkelaars, architecten, managers en bestuurders bij het adopteren van Sigrid en het verankeren ervan in hun processen. Je levert heldere rapportages en presentaties aan zowel management als technische doelgroepen, afgestemd op de doelen van de organisatie. Je adviseert klanten over sturen op softwarekwaliteit, het beheersen van technische schuld en de verantwoorde inzet van AI in softwareontwikkeling. title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does. Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action. This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally. title: Marketing Manager, ANZ
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for an enthusiastic B2B Enterprise marketing manager, who is dynamic, creative, and analytical. The individual has a track record of delivering creative and smashing programs that generate new prospects and grow the marketing revenue pipeline. This person will be dedicated to growing our businesses in ANZ across enterprise and public sector accounts. </p> <p>You will support the creation, launch, and execution of campaigns that span a variety of channels - email, social, and webinars as well as supporting end-to-end execution of our in-person and virtual events, either direct or with our partners. You have a natural inclination to measure the effectiveness of marketing activities, strong project management skills, and the ability to think strategically and orchestrate many moving parts. You must have strong working knowledge and expertise in demand generation marketing funnel and lead flows. The right candidate will have the ability to work cross-functionally with all teams in-region, across APAC and in headquarters in San Francisco. This is a regional role based in Sydney or Melbourne, Australia. Market experience and expertise is required for this role.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Report into the Head of Marketing APAC, based in Singapore</li> <li>As the ANZ Enterprise marketing manager, you will plan, promote, and execute field marketing initiatives across the region that capture mindshare, drive prospects into customers and support Cloudflare customers on their journey to build and secure on Cloudflare.</li> <li>You will be accountable for online, trade shows, conferences, executive dinners, workshops, developing communities, and the full range of regional marketing tactics and execution for Australia across enterprise & public sector.</li> <li>Manage campaigns from strategic planning and execution to evaluation, ensuring smooth project management throughout. Oversee timelines, track ROI, and implement data-driven optimisations to continuously improve performance and communicate campaign results to key stakeholders.</li> <li>Work in cross-functional teams and collaborate closely with global & regional demand centre teams, the partner team, BDR, product marketing, sales, marketing operations, sales ops and others in the development, execution and measurement of high-impact integrated marketing campaigns (global or regional) that are optimised and relevant across the marketing mix - online, offline, ABM, communities and more.</li> <li>Align marketing initiatives to directly support sales objectives, focusing on full lead lifecycle and funnel management, from lead generation to opportunity progression and customer loyalty and expansion.</li> <li>Assess campaign performance using SFDC and Tableau reporting, evaluate ROI, and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>5 to 8 years proven experience in B2B marketing (enterprise software, cybersecurity, SaaS, regional marketing and/or info security experience a plus)</li> <li>BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, or other quantitative field</li> <li>On the digital side, you will be supporting our digital teams to help with execution and optimisation of online marketing campaigns across multiple channels (e.g. email, webinars, social media, etc.). </li> <li>Excellent channel experience working with partner marketing, distribution, resellers and systems integrators. </li> <li>In addition, you must have experience in planning, budgeting and managing trade shows, events, and conferences from start to finish</li> <li>Have proven track record of launching successful online and offline marketing campaigns and driving qualified leads in the funnel</li> <li>Strong project management/organisational skills and the ability to successfully manage multiple initiatives at once</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills, collaborative, and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments in different time zones</li> <li>Results oriented with experience using qualitative and quantitative metrics with a focus on revenue, conversion, sales and other marketing goals</li> <li>Analytically inclined, exceptional organisational skills, with rigorous attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment with tight deadlines</li> <li>Having a strong sense of curiosity and passion for learning</li> <li>Exhibit strong stakeholders’ management and communication skills</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Marketo, and Tableau, will be an advantage.</li> <li>Previous experience in a high growth company in the SaaS, security, or network space, combined with knowledge of how the Internet works is a plus</li> <li>An established player in the business and marketing community with a strong business network which included media, marketing agencies, events organisers, social media platforms amongst others.  </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Analytics Engineer
description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team. You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together. Our current tech includes: Data warehouse: BigQuery Ingestion: Stitch Transformation: dbt Cloud Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight What you’ll do Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion. Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page. Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making. Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business. AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer. Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table. Working with AI AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. The Team You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max (Data Insights) as part of our small Data team of three on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. Who you are You have owned analytics engineering work end to end. You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core). You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec. You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language. You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce. You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled. You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering. How we hire There are four stages: 30-minute call with our recruiter. 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager. 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task. 30-minute conversation with a senior leader. What we have for you Competitive compensation 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you’ll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. About Talk360 Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number. Here’s what our users say: “I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★ “Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★ “It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★ Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: The Challenge Much of what Talk360 users see and touch is built with web technology - onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and calling in the browser - on top of a Ruby on Rails platform. Every change you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people in more than 190 countries, often on older devices, limited data plans and unreliable networks. For them, a checkout that won’t load isn’t a UX inconvenience. It’s a call home that doesn’t happen. Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and we’re building an AI-first engineering team. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with frontend as their home base: someone who builds excellent web experiences and is just as willing to go into our Rails backend to make them work end-to-end. What You'll Do Lead on frontend Build and improve our web experiences in React: onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and account features Help evolve our web dialer and the web side of our embedded calling product, used by partners to bring Talk360 calling into their own platforms Shape frontend architecture and technical direction, working closely with the Tech Lead and the rest of the team Bring our design system to the web with consistent, accessible components across all our apps Own frontend quality: performance on low-end devices and slow networks, releases, monitoring and error tracking Work across the stack Take features end-to-end: build the Rails API and data model your frontend needs, instead of waiting for it Contribute to our Ruby on Rails platform, the backend behind our mobile apps, web apps and partner integrations Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD and tooling so we can ship often and with confidence Raise the level of the team through technical designs, code reviews and sharing what you know Learn from customers, build AI-first Ship features and experiments on the journeys that matter most to our users, from first open to buying credit Use data, error reports and user feedback to find and fix what hurts users most Work with Product and Design before implementation to shape solutions, not just execute them Use AI tooling throughout your workflow to raise quality and speed, and help shape how we work as an AI-first engineering team The Team You'll be working alongside Isah (Frontend), Oleg (Full Stack), Alex (Backend), Yahaya (VoIP and Data Platform), Igor (iOS and Mobile Lead), David (Android), and Tom (Tech Lead). The wider tech team you'll collaborate with includes Michal & Ali (QA). On the product side, you'll work closely with Quintin and Kseniia (Product) and Cameron (Design). Talk360 is a lean company, around 30 people globally, which means you'll interact regularly across functions: ops, support, data, and marketing. That cross-functional visibility is one of the things that makes the work here interesting and your impact visible. You naturally take ownership without waiting for permission. You enjoy solving hard technical problems while thinking about the bigger picture. You care deeply about software craftsmanship and user experience. You can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices. You enjoy partnering with product teams and learning directly from customer feedback. You share what you know and help others improve and become stronger. You're pragmatic. You know when perfection matters and when shipping matters more. You're excited about building software that genuinely changes people's lives. You're based in or around Amsterdam and able to come to our office two to three times a week.
