title: Senior Customer Service Leader
description: Jij bouwt aan sterke klantrelaties, creëert commerciële kansen en maakt het verschil met dienstverlening die resultaat oplevert. Krijg jij energie van strategisch klantmanagement, commerciële groei en het realiseren van duurzame klantwaarde? Als Customer Service Leader bij Centric ben jij de drijvende kracht achter succesvolle klantrelaties. Je verbindt klantambities met onze IT-expertise, stuurt op resultaat en weet commerciële kansen om te zetten in concrete groei. Je bent sparringpartner voor onze klanten, geeft richting aan multidisciplinaire teams en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het succes van onze dienstverlening. Een veelzijdige sleutelrol waarin ondernemerschap, klantgerichtheid en resultaat samenkomen. Werken bij Centric De kans is groot dat je Centric al kent, zonder dat je het weet. Bijvoorbeeld wanneer je betaalt in een winkel, kraanwater gebruikt of een paspoort aanvraagt. Dagelijks vertrouwen duizenden organisaties en miljoenen mensen op onze ruim 200 technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 professionals. Binnen Centric Services werk je samen met meer dan 900 collega's in Nederland, Litouwen en Roemenië. Als IT-partner van organisaties in onder meer de publieke, financiële, logistieke en industriële sector zorgen we ervoor dat hun dienstverlening blijft draaien. Van het gemeenteloket tot de bevoorrading van supermarkten. Bij Centric krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, impact te maken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Jouw rol als Customer Service Leader Jij bent hét gezicht van Centric bij jouw klanten en de verbindende schakel tussen klantstrategie en succesvolle dienstverlening. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de contracten, P&L, klanttevredenheid en commerciële groei. Je begrijpt wat klanten beweegt, denkt vooruit en vertaalt hun ambities naar concrete plannen en resultaten. Samen met accountmanagers, architecten, projectmanagers en beheerteams bouw je aan sterke klantrelaties, optimale dienstverlening en nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je houdt de regie, stuurt op resultaat en zorgt dat we onze klanten blijvend toegevoegde waarde bieden. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwikkelt samen met de accountmanager strategische accountplannen en stuurt op omzet, marge, groei en klantwaarde. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor contractmanagement, P&L, governance, rapportages en facturatie. Je bouwt aan duurzame klantrelaties en bent het centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten en interne stakeholders. Je signaleert commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete voorstellen, offertes en contractuitbreidingen. Je verbindt en stuurt multidisciplinaire teams en zorgt voor een optimale samenwerking. Je neemt initiatief voor verbeteringen en klantgerichte innovaties die de dienstverlening versterken. Je bewaakt de klanttevredenheid en stuurt actief op kwaliteit, resultaat en continuïteit. Dit breng je mee Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner die commerciële kansen herkent, relaties weet te versterken en mensen in beweging krijgt. Je combineert strategisch inzicht met een resultaatgerichte aanpak en voelt je thuis in een complexe IT-omgeving. Daarnaast heb je: Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en minimaal 5 tot 8 jaar relevante werkervaring. Ruime ervaring met strategisch klant- en contractmanagement, P&L-sturing en commerciële groei binnen IT-dienstverlening. Ervaring met key-accountmanagement, accountplannen, forecasting en complexe stakeholdernetwerken. Het vermogen om klantbehoeften, organisatiedoelen en operationele mogelijkheden met elkaar te verbinden. Een ondernemende, analytische en resultaatgerichte instelling. Sterke communicatieve, beïnvloedings- en onderhandelingsvaardigheden. Verbindend leiderschap en organisatiesensitiviteit. Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Wat bieden wij jou? Een sleutelpositie waarin je direct invloed hebt op klantrelaties, commerciële resultaten en de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om te ondernemen, samen te werken met deskundige collega's en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Daar staat tegenover: Een marktconform salaris, mobiliteitsbudget, laptop en telefoon. 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en een pensioenbijdrage van 7,5% van jouw pensioengrondslag. Uitgebreide mogelijkheden voor opleiding, training en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken. Aantrekkelijke personeelskortingen op onder meer verzekeringen, reizen en sportabonnementen. Je werkt hybride: bij onze klanten, vanuit huis en vanuit onze kantoren in Gouda en Son. Klaar om het verschil te maken? Ben jij de strategische klantmanager die commerciële kansen weet te verzilveren, klantrelaties naar een hoger niveau tilt en samen met collega's duurzame resultaten realiseert? title: Strategisch Account Director DPG Media (32/ 36 uur)
description: Amsterdam- DPG Media Advertising is in transitie. We zijn een marktleider en challenger in één. Wij zijn volop in beweging en schuiven op van traditionele mediapartner naar volwaardig strategisch business partner. Voor de absolute top adverteerders van Nederland zoeken wij een Strategisch Account Director die hierin voorop loopt. Wat ga je doen Van mediabudget naar bedrijfsgroei… Als Strategisch Account Director acteer je op het allerhoogste niveau binnen onze Key Account organisatie. Je beheert een selecte groep van onze meest strategische, complexe klanten. Samenwerkingen gaan hier veel verder dan de inkoop van media; je praat op directieniveau over businessdoelen, strategische partnerschips, data-integraties en langetermijnvisies. Jij bent het boegbeeld van onze nieuwe koers en neemt zowel je klanten als onze interne organisatie mee in deze transitie. Je schakelt continu op twee snelheden: het bouwen aan verankerde, strategische samenwerkingen voor de komende jaren én het binnentikken van de kortetermijndoelstellingen. Dagelijkse werkzaamheden zijn o.a.: Besturen van complexiteit: Je overziet moeiteloos het krachtenveld van grote organisaties en fungeert als de spin in het web voor een complexe matrix aan in- en externe stakeholders (directies, mediabureaus, creatieve bureaus, en interne DPG-specialisten). title: Stagiair Accountmanagement & Customer Success (MKB)
description: Ben jij commercieel, houd je van aanpakken en wil je jouw eigen klantenbestand runnen? Dan zoeken wij jou! Bij Lease a Bike hebben we één grote missie: heel werkend Nederland op de fiets krijgen. Wil jij hieraan bouwen en werkend Nederland groener, gezonder en fitter maken? Sales haalt de bedrijven binnen, daarna begint het werk voor jou. Als Stagiair Accountmanagement & Customer Success beheer jij onze zakelijke klanten in het MKB-segment (bedrijven van 20 tot 49 werknemers). Je krijgt energie van direct klantcontact en hebt de commerciële drive om proactief de relatie met de bedrijven niet alleen goed te houden, maar ook te verbeteren. Klaar om vanaf dag één jouw eigen MKB-portfolio te managen binnen een razendsnelle scale-up? Join the ride! Wat ga je doen? Je komt te werken in het Customer Success-team, dit team bestaat uit 6 energieke collega’s en is verantwoordelijk voor het accountmanagement van de aangesloten bedrijven. Wij zijn onderdeel van Lease a Bike Nederland met in totaal bijna 60 medewerkers. Sinds 2020 zijn we van start-up uitgegroeid tot een internationale scale-up met meer dan 450 medewerkers in zes landen en in Nederland zijn we zelfs marktleider! Binnen ons team ga jij zelfstandig aan de slag met accountmanagement voor jouw eigen MKB-segment. Dit is wat je te wachten staat: Jouw eigen MKB-klantenbestand runnen: Jij bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor bedrijven met 20 tot 49 medewerkers. Hierbij zorg je voor Een vlekkeloze onboarding van de bedrijven die aangesloten moeten worden, Het verder activeren van de al aangesloten bedrijven; Medewerkers enthousiasmeren: Je bedenkt en lanceert creatieve promotieacties bij én met jouw klanten, zoals een kick-off event bij een bedrijf, zodat zoveel mogelijk werknemers de auto laten staan en op de leasefiets stappen; Doorontwikkelen en optimaliseren: Je bouwt mee aan ons Learning Center, landingspagina’s en verbetert de huidige workflow om de customer journey nóg slimmer in te richten; Kansen spotten: Je hebt een commerciële mindset en klimt direct in de telefoon om geen kans onbenut te laten. Meebouwen aan de scale-up: Je werkt nauw samen met Sales en Marketing, wat zorgt voor een constante stroom aan inspiratie én een kijkje in de keuken van een snelgroeiende organisatie. Wat verwachten wij? Binnen Lease a Bike staat snel schakelen centraal: een bedrijf dat vandaag tekent, kan volgende week al op de fiets zitten. Jij krijgt energie van snelheid, werkt gestructureerd en durft beslissingen te nemen. Gaat het een keer niet helemaal zoals gepland? Dan trek je op tijd aan de bel en denken we samen in oplossingen. Je volgt een studie, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, communicatie of een andere studie waar jouw commerciële en klantgerichte talent tot zijn recht komt; Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar voor een periode van tenminste 5 maanden (startdatum in overleg); Commerciële drive & assertief: Je vindt het leuk om via de telefoon mensen te overtuigen en weet klanten op een enthousiaste manier in beweging te krijgen; Creatief brein: Een pakkende mail schrijven, een actie bedenken of een proces verbeteren? Jij ziet overal kansen; Teamplayer: Bij ons staat samenwerken centraal, want samen zorgen we ervoor dat zoveel mogelijk mensen op de fiets stappen. Daarnaast maken we er samen het leukste van op kantoor. Met jou samenwerken is een feestje, omdat de gezelligheid en het teamgevoel ervan afspat. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt voor jouw eigen klanten, bieden we je natuurlijk nog veel meer: Volledige verantwoordelijkheid: Geen koffiehaal-stage, maar jouw eigen MKB-segment én de ruimte om mee te denken over onze Customer Success-strategie; Een jong, ambitieus team waarin veel ruimte is voor gezelligheid en persoonlijke groei; Een mooie stagevergoeding van €500 per maand (o.b.v. fulltime) en 6 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. een half jaar); Elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor met je collega’s; De mogelijkheid om mee te doen aan Pon Fit (hét gezondheidsprogramma van Pon) en je te ontwikkelen via onze Winter- en Summerlabs ; Ambitie om na je stage te blijven? Geen probleem! Je stapt in op een geweldig moment om mee te groeien met de organisatie. Solliciteren zonder gedoe! Wij geloven niet in lange, stoffige motivatiebrieven. Overtuig ons liever op jouw manier! Klik op de sollicitatieknop en stuur je CV mee met een korte pitch (max. 5 zinnen) waarin je vertelt hoe jij een bedrijf van 35 medewerkers enthousiast maakt om op de fiets te stappen. Liever een kort spraakbericht of video sturen? App hem direct naar Siebe! Heb je eerst nog een vraag? Bel of app Siebe Reinders (Customer Success Manager) op +316 33 01 30 14 of mail naar . Sollicitatieproces: We houden het lekker snel. Jouw sollicitatie bestaat uit één kennismakingsgesprek met Siebe of Joep (beide Customer Success Manager). Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Federal Account Executive, DHS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Washington DC, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>We are looking for a seasoned sales professional to help cover the Federal market for US. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations</li> <li>Maintain a robust sales pipeline</li> <li>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of experience selling technical solutions or products to the Public Sector (Federal Government) ; DHS sales experience required (but open to other Fed agency sales experiences as well)</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles`</li> <li>Basic understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Experience selling to the Federal customer base</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Washington DC, based hires: The expected salary range for this role is $269,000 - $370,000,  depending on experience and qualifications. Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Mechanical Analysis Engineer
description: Your mission You will be responsible for mechanical calculations for all systems or part of the system in Thorizon’s reactor design. As a key member of the calculation expertise center, you will provide mechanical calculation expertise to the teams responsible for reactor design studies and ensure the delivery of mechanical calculation work within the project’s performance, cost, and time constraints. You will develop mechanical calculation expertise to meet the needs of the Thorizon project and its future developments, ensuring the quality and validity of the studies and work performed across projects, from PILOT to FOAK/NOAK. You will hold a functional leadership role over the team of structural analysis engineers and will be integrated into a broader, multidisciplinary group of mechanical design engineers and materials experts, reporting to the Head of Mechanics and Materials. In this role you will: Define, execute, and deliver mechanical calculation work, including calculation specifications, strategies, assumptions, and calculation notes, within the project’s performance, cost, and time constraints. Lead a group of mechanical calculation engineers across projects, from PILOT to FOAK/NOAK, providing in-depth calculation engineering input and ensuring that design choices are technically sound and consistent with requirements and applicable Codes & Standards. Ensure the correct use of calculation tools, develop specific tools, and maintain high-quality, reliable studies. Prioritize work according to project needs and recommend any necessary actions within your area of expertise. Participate in external networks, including international initiatives, to stay at the forefront of industry developments. Put your knowledge to use, develop your ideas, explore different aspects of mechanical engineering, and play a crucial role in the company’s growth About you: You hold a master’s degree and bring more than 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering calculations. You have at least five years of experience in FEM simulation and analysis, covering linear structural analysis, structural seismic response, thermal stress and fatigue, with advanced or expert proficiency in ABAQUS and/or ANSYS. You bring at least three years of experience applying ASME III and/or RCC-M. You lead by listening and supporting your team, with at least five years of experience managing a team of fewer than 10 people. You combine a strong understanding of calculation-based design engineering with a practical approach to supporting the design team. You have good knowledge of CAD practices and experience using them. You are proficient in office applications. You enjoy working with people who bring different experiences and backgrounds. You adapt your working style to the situation and the people involved, while maintaining technical rigour. You enjoy tackling challenging problems and developing your knowledge. You look at problems from different angles, reducing unnecessary complexity to find practical solutions. Your approach is pragmatic and constructive. You work independently and rigorously within your area of expertise. You exercise sound engineering judgement, considering both your discipline and the wider project. You prioritise your work according to the key issues at stake. You listen before responding, communicate concisely and respectfully, and remain calm under pressure. You write clearly and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written; French or Dutch is also preferred. You produce work that serves as a reference for your colleagues. What you can expect from us: The opportunity to help realize the most promising reactor technology and advance Europe's energy future. Being part of an exceptional team that combines engineering rigor, scientific excellence, and entrepreneurial drive. Working in multidisciplinary teams on ambitious missions, with responsibility and meaningful impact from day one. A fast-moving deep-tech environment where initiative is valued and people are trusted to make decisions. Complex, multidisciplinary challenges that will stretch you and accelerate your growth. Competitive compensation and participation in our employee profit-sharing plan. An international workplace with offices in the heart of Amsterdam and Lyon. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior ML Engineer
description: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival. We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies. The Role You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will: Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven What We're Looking For Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience Language: English. German is a plus for shop-floor conversations. On-site: Ability to work in person at Zurich, Switzerland, with regular time on the shop floor at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany. What we're not looking for Researchers without a user: every model you build here has a factory user, or it is dropped Someone who needs clean data, a platform and a team before they can ship Someone who wants to manage first and build later: the lead role is earned by proven MVPs Generic ERP, MES or QMS feature work, or machine interaction: other teams own these What we offer Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the free world. What your systems learn in Factory ONE, every next factory applies. The Environment: A real factory as your lab, with direct access to the people who run it, and ownership of the core of SAEKI's value proposition from day one. The Team: A small, generalist Manufacturing Intelligence team that ships, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence. Compensation: Competitive salary + equity. Location: Zurich HQ Apply Resume: Focus on systems you shipped that real users relied on, and what happened to them after launch. Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? title: Senior Network Hardware Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until November 01, 2026.</strong></p> <p><strong>Job Title </strong></p> <p>Network Hardware Engineer </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a pivotal technical contributor within the Network Hardware Engineering (NetHW) team, you will drive the selection and qualification process for network devices used in Cloudflare's Global Network. The NetHW team manages the New Product Introduction (NPI) process for all network devices. Our responsibilities also include the evaluation and qualification of new production network operating system images and versions. Furthermore, we provide essential support by reproducing bugs to assist Operations with TAC cases and testing new features and major configuration updates.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>You will be involved in every stage of the New Product Introduction (NPI) process, including requirements gathering, device selection, Device Validation Testing (DVT), Production Validation Testing (PVT), and Operational Acceptance. Furthermore, you will be responsible for creating and automating test plans that align with both operational needs and hardware limitations, as well as driving efforts to improve testing efficiency.</p> <p>Network Hardware Systems Engineering Responsibilities:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Product Lifecycle Management:</strong> Lead the introduction of new network hardware systems, including detailed engineering validation in lab environments</li> <li><strong>Qualification & Validation:</strong> Gather requirements, contribute to network architecture, and execute hardware design and product validation</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner with Network Engineering & Operations, Datacenter Engineering & Operations, and other operational teams to make network hardware decisions</li> <li><strong>Automation & Performance Testing:</strong> Develop tools and automation to effectively evaluate network hardware performance</li> <li><strong>Operational Support:</strong> Assist operational engineers by troubleshooting, reproducing, and resolving network hardware issues</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Document and share results and updates via blog/wiki posts, ticketing systems, and internal presentations</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience</li> <li>Proven ability to conduct thorough evaluation and experimentation, including testing, measurement, and/or simulation of hardware performance</li> <li>Extensive experience with networking hardware architecture, validation, performance benchmarking, debugging, and deployment</li> <li>Deep knowledge of network engineering and protocols used in data center switching and routing as well as Internet routing</li> <li>Track record of driving engineering projects from idea to experiment to implementation</li> <li>Demonstrated success in working with OEM/ODMs and technology vendors</li> <li>Professional-level proficiency in Python or similar programming and/or scripting languages</li> <li>Familiarity with various coding agents and other AI tools and technologies</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>NIce-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Adept at automating traffic generation equipment (Spirent/Ixia) and test cases</li> <li>In-depth hardware knowledge of platforms (ASICs, TCAMs, Packet-Pipelines, etc)</li> <li>Experience with Optical Line Systems and troubleshooting transceiver issues</li> <li>Familiarity with different network operating systems such as Junos, IOS-XR, EOS, SONiC,  and ArcOS</li> <li>Experience with white-box network switches and open source projects</li> <li>Proficient in using observability and monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana, with the ability to analyze and observe trends over time.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with configuring and validating RoCEv2 (RDMA over Converged Ethernet) fabrics, specifically implementing Priority Flow Control (PFC) and Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) on network devices.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Design Engineer, Notion.com
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT US: Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Web team builds Notion.com http://Notion.com to inspire current and future customers. We tell the story of what’s possible with Notion, give people ideas for what they might make themselves, and route them to the place of greatest impact: learning more, getting in touch with sales, or making their first workspace. We’re looking for a frontend engineer with a designer’s eye and a toolmaker’s instincts. Someone who can take an idea from a rough sketch to a working prototype to a beautifully finished experience. You care about the shape of a letterform, the rhythm of a page, and what happens in the few milliseconds after someone clicks. You also care about how it’s built—and whether a simpler way exists. The tools are changing what’s worth attempting. An idea you might once have set aside can become a working experiment; a tool you wished existed can become part of your practice. Working with agents should give you more room to follow those instincts—to try another direction, throw away an approach that isn’t working, or spend longer on the detail that makes the whole thing click. We’re interested in what you make with that room. The Web team at Notion is changing around that possibility. We are a small team that’s focused on making unusually good things, with fewer handoffs, simpler systems, and more time spent on work that deserves human attention. You’ll help us get there: making new experiences on notion.com http://notion.com and building tools that take care of the repetitive work. There’s plenty here to question, plenty to make, and room to surprise us. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll be shipping to Notion.com http://Notion.com faster than we do today, working directly with Creative, Marketing, Growth, or Product Marketing, and leaving jigs and agent loops behind you: components, scripts, and workflows that review code, triage alerts, and watch flows like login and pricing. - By the end of your first year, you’ll be a daily driver of the site, from end to end, with your fingerprints all over the reusable pieces behind it, the monitoring that catches problems early, and the habit of retiring pages, code, and dependencies that stop earning their place. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Taste. You have a deep feel for typography, grids, proportion, and restraint. You can make something feel alive without adding more to it. You can explain why a detail matters—and recognize when it doesn’t. - Exceptional technical ability. Semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, React, and the browser’s layout, rendering, and animation systems are materials you know well. You build accessible, responsive, fast experiences, and your work feels as considered in the browser as it does in a mockup. - 8–12 years of experience in frontend development or design engineering, and a bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction (HCI), or related field. - Ability to treat code as a creative medium. Your process includes quick experiments, discarded approaches, and prototypes other people can actually use. You can move quickly while an idea is uncertain, then slow down for the details that make it worth shipping. - You make tools that leave more room for craft. You notice when a task starts repeating and build the jig: a component, script, or agent workflow that makes the next pass easier and more precise. You know what to standardize and what to leave open, so the tool supports your eye without making every result look the same - Agents are already part of how you build. You’ve gone beyond autocomplete. You can show us workflows you’ve put together, what they do on their own, how you check their work, and what you’ve learned when they go wrong. We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000- $250,000 per year. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>About the department</p> <p>Cloudflare's Engineering team builds and runs the software that handles a large share of the Internet's requests. We also build the internal tools and platforms that software depends on. Teams own large areas with real impact and work autonomously within them, whether their customers are external or other Cloudflare engineers.</p> <p>About the team</p> <p>Developer Productivity builds the internal tools and platforms Cloudflare engineers use to take code from commit to production. We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. We also own the tooling behind Cloudflare's Engineering Codex, the standards every engineering team is expected to meet.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>This is a front-line engineering manager role leading a team of 6+ engineers in Bengaluru. The team's initial focus will be on two areas:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>AI tools for engineers.</strong> Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them.</strong> Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review.</p> </li> </ul> <p>You'll own the product direction for both areas. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions.</p> <p>What you'll do</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the product roadmap. title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, Spain
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. - Fluency in Spanish. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. partnerships and regulators</li> <li>Ensuring zero tolerance of any compliance issue or breach of regulatory requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> consultancy, investment firm, strategy team, and/or a high-growth international fintech or technology company</li> <li>You’ve worked on launching or scaling credit products and operations within European markets</li> <li>You have strong knowledge of credit products, local banking infrastructure, and financial operations in EU</li> <li>You’re highly analytical and data-driven, with experience environment</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. De stem van je klant zijn binnen DataSnipper: Je begrijpt de auditmethodologie, compliance-eisen en bedrijfsdoelen van je klanten goed en geeft feedback intern door, zodat DataSnipper antwoord geeft op echte behoeften uit de praktijk. Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights), zodat je meedeelt in het succes en de groei van het bedrijf. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. title: Chief Financial Officer
description: Most CFOs inherit a finance function. This one gets to build it. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where we stand Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. Tasks What you will own Everything financial: Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time. Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage. The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded. A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise. You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision. There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly. The first year Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design. You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream. You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers. By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months. Requirements Who we are looking for You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it. You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business. You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter. Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally! Please apply exclusively via join — other forms of application will not be considered. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: wo-stage Economie & Data-analyse: onderzoek naar omzetverwachting
description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Duik jij graag in data om patronen en verbanden te ontdekken? Krijg je energie van statistisch onderzoek en wil je ontdekken wat bedrijfsverwachtingen ons vertellen over de economie? Dit is jouw uitdaging Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden: Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen. Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken. Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen? Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan? Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren? Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Het team Bedrijvenconjunctuur & Coördinatie bestaat uit ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Variërend van zeer ervaren medewerkers tot jonge mensen die nog aan het begin van hun loopbaan staan. We werken met elkaar op een collegiale en professionele manier aan statistieken over het bedrijfsleven die voor beleidmakers en journalisten er echt toe doen! Tijdens je stage heb je ook regelmatig contact en werk je samen met collega’s van de andere teams binnen de sector Bedrijvenstatistieken in Den Haag. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een wetenschappelijke opleiding met als studierichting economie, bedrijfseconomie, statistiek of dataverwerking. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: Statistiek; Python en/of R; Bedrijfseconomische begrippen zoals omzet, bedrijfsgrootte, rechtvorm en indexcijfers. Je bent een enthousiaste en proactieve student die flexibel inspeelt op verschillende situaties. Je bent sociaal, weet tactvol te handelen en werkt graag samen met anderen om tot een goed resultaat te komen. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw onderzoek vaardigheden vergroot; ervaring opdoet met statistische en economische concepten; leert om begrijpelijk te programmeren in R/Python; jouw communicatieve vaardigheden verder ontwikkelt zodat je de uitkomsten van jouw onderzoek optimaal presenteert en de boodschap helder overkomt. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Master Data Engineer
description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. Master Data Engineer As our Master Data Engineer, you own the accuracy and integrity of the master data behind every Aletta we build: items, bills of materials (BOMs), revisions and routings in our ERP system. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. You also own the change control process between Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain, from the first change request to the verified change in the build. This is a newly created role in our Operations team. First months at Vitestro In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. You register changes, organize the impact assessment with Operations, Supply Chain and Quality, chair the change review board, and define effectivity and the disposition of existing stock. Second, you build the manufacturing BOMs for our products from the engineering BOMs. You structure sub-assemblies to match the assembly sequence, add consumables, packaging, labels, kitting and the make/buy split, and set up spare-part and service BOMs together with Service. Along the way, you define how system and module upgrades are managed through the BOM. You become the single point of contact for master data and change implementation. You make sure every build uses the correct released configuration, so that each Device History Record traces back to the Device Master Record. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, engineering changes run through one controlled process, and every change is implemented, verified in the first build and closed in the change record. Product and spare-part BOMs are free of errors, and master data is audit-ready under ISO 13485. Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain know where a change stands and when it reaches the build. Regular comparisons between E-BOM, M-BOM and as-built show no open discrepancies. You thrive at the intersection of engineering and operations. You are precise and process-minded, you keep the discipline when others are in a hurry, and you are comfortable holding a change that isn't ready yet. What You’ll Bring: A bachelor's or master's background in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Industrial Engineering, or a similar technical field 3+ years in master data, BOM, configuration or engineering change management in a manufacturing environment, preferably MedTech or high-tech Experience with an ERP system, such as Odoo, SAP or Exact Solid understanding of E-BOM and M-BOM structures, item lifecycle and revision control Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and keep process discipline Comfortable working with detail: analytical, accurate and process-minded Excellent communication skills Fluent in English Nice to have: Experience in a regulated environment (ISO 13485, DMR/DHR, design transfer) Familiarity with a PLM system Experience reading technical drawings, and basic 3D CAD knowledge Experience with advanced Excel or data tooling for data validation Dutch language skills How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward. We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means: We take initiative rather than wait for direction. We focus on execution and delivering results. We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed. We challenge ideas, not people. We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar. We celebrate team success over individual heroics. We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals. If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you. What we offer Competitive salary including pension plan 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position Hybrid work model Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away. Training budget Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. Are you excited? We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
