title: Public Relations Executive, APJC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a PR Specialist, APAC + Japan to assist the head of PR, Asia Pacific, in scaling our PR program internally and externally. In this role you’ll get to work with a wide range of Cloudflare executives across technical, legal/policy, marketing, and regional teams. The ideal candidate should have at least 3-5 years of regional tech PR experience, supporting and executing PR programs in Southeast Asia/Asia Pacific. You’ll be a key member of our award-winning in-house communications team, and will work with a wide range of executives and teams to support execution, develop messaging, and report results from concept to completion. You'll also help extend our story beyond earned media across APAC + Japan, using social listening to spot conversations and trends in the region, and posting approved content to amplify Cloudflare news and coverage on social channels.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist the Sr. PR Director, APAC + Japan in managing PR operations including editorial calendar, content, execution, reporting, and agency coordination</li> <li>Write press releases, blog posts, and other materials to support regional and local communications initiatives</li> <li>Help manage day-to-day execution for APAC PR programs </li> <li>Maintain strong media relationships across all types of media outlets, develop story ideas, and manage stories</li> <li>Organize media briefings, interviews, and PR-focused events</li> <li>Support and help manage key executive spokespeople</li> <li>Monitor social and online conversations about Cloudflare, competitors, and key industry topics across APAC + Japan, flagging trends, newsjacking opportunities, and emerging issues to the Sr. PR Director, APAC + Japan</li> <li>Track sentiment and share of voice in APAC + Japan around announcements, campaigns, and Internet events, and turn the findings into regular reports and insights for the comms team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BA/BS in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or Marketing preferred</li> <li>3-5 years’ experience in regional (APAC) tech PR, either in-house B2B or agency </li> <li>Ability to operate independently and as a team in “the trenches”—we’re a dynamic team and everyone pitches in to get the job done</li> <li>Excellent communication and writing skills </li> <li>Creative, hardworking, and flexible, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment</li> <li>Strong project management and attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to multitask, manage deadlines, and communicate priorities</li> <li>Ability to understand and operate in a highly technical environment</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Meltwater or similar social listening and media monitoring tools</li> <li>Familiarity with publishing and scheduling content on social platforms such as LinkedIn and X</li> <li>Ability to turn data into clear, practical insights and reports</li> <li>Curiosity about AI and how it's changing the Internet, plus comfort using AI tools in day-to-day work</li> <li>Japanese or another APAC language is a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.</p> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.</p> <h2>Who We're Looking For</h2> <p>We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.</p> <ul> <li>Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning</li> <li>No active backlogs</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++</li> <li>Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects</li> <li>Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking</li> <li>A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly</li> </ul> <p>Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.</p> <h2>Our Culture</h2> <p>More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.</p> <p>At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.</p> <p>Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.</p> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Sentinel System Engineer - Post Launch Support
description: We are looking for a Sentinel System Engineer on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) for their location in Noordwijk, the Netherlands. Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: Coordinate the internal & external support to PLS (ESA Space Segment Development Team, TEC experts, Mission Analysis & System Support, Industry); Coordinate with the ESA Space Segment Development Team (where relevant) to exchange technical status on the flying- and non-flying satellite(s), identifying coordination issues of relevance and following them to conclusion; Support PLS at the regular (weekly) Operations Boards; Support the Operations Team(s) by providing or facilitating responses to technical support requests from either the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) or Payload Data Ground Segment (PDGS); Maintain & distribute the PLS On-Call lists to the FOS (& other parties where relevant) in a timely manner; Support the Mission Manager and his/her team by providing technical advice related to issues of Satellite(s) performance; Support the Space Segment Development Team(s) by providing timely & pertinent feedback on any issue detected in-flight with potential impact on satellite(s) still under development; Provide specific technical expertise to support Performance Monitoring, Analysis & Optimisation tasks and Anomaly Investigations, with overall aim to improve mission quality and/or lifetime; Preparation of Technical Documentation, such as Reports, Technical Notes and other requested documentation; Review and synthesis of Technical Reports and documents produced by Industry, and extraction of relevant technical information for use in generation of PLS Performance metrics and reports; Organise and support the 6-monthly Satellite In-Orbit Performance (SIOP) Technical Meetings in cooperation with the Industrial Prime contractor, including associated follow-up activities (eg. administration, actions follow up etc); Respond to Anomaly Warnings received from the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) in an appropriate & timely manner, providing support and facilitating the necessary follow-on actions; Support and lead complex investigations that arise as a result of satellite performance and anomalies, ensuring adequate coordination with involved partners (Mission Management, Operations Team(s), Industry, Space Segment Development Team(s), Management); Prepare, coordinate & follow-up on engineering requests for the Industrial contractors in support of Anomaly Investigations and other technical analyses; Support satellite configuration control including the Configuration Control Board (CCB); Support Satellite Decommissioning & Disposal activities as required; Monitor, track and report the status of activities performed by the Industrial contractors in support of the PLS function (technical, commercial and schedule status); Review commercial payment requests & the associated justifications submitted by Industry (regular milestones or as result of ad-hoc Cost Reimbursement activities); Bring innovation to satellite performance analysis by investigating emerging technologies that enhance the ability for early detection of performance trends and deviations; Maintain the relevant PLS technical records, databases & documentation in accordance with established procedures; Maintain a regular reporting in coordination with the Technical Officer. Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements . If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. Requirements University degree in a relevant Engineering discipline; Minimum 10 years of experience and a significant background in one or more of the following domains: Satellite Operations, Spacecraft Development (including Project Engineering, Equipment/Subsystem Procurement, Assembly Integration & Test); Minimum 3 years’ experience working as a System Engineer or with a System Coordination function in any of the above domains; Good understanding of the Satellite Phase E2 Routine Operations Organisation and the typical activities performed; Good understanding of the factors affecting the short- and long-term performance of Satellites and their main subsystems or payloads; Experience managing and leading technical meetings and discussions with multiple stakeholders; Proven experience & ability at working in an environment with multiple external interfaces; Good at working in a team and a proactive attitude to solving problems Autonomy in writing technical notes, specifications and reports in English; Good interpersonal skills and team spirit; Demonstrable multidisciplinary or system-level experience in the satellite engineering domain; Previous working experience in a multinational environment is desirable; Very good knowledge of MS Office tools; Fluency in English, both written and spoken; Candidates must be eligible to work in the EU. Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Teamleider Projecten Elektrotechniek
description: Wij hebben een leuke vacature voor een teamleider projecten openstaan. Voor deze baan geef je leiding aan meerdere projectteams. Als je werkt bij SDR heb je leuke collega’s en afwisselende projecten. Wat wij je bieden Een winstdelingsregeling en een goede pensioenregeling 38 vrije dagen per jaar op basis van fulltime Laptop en telefoon van de zaak en een bedrijfsauto die je ook privé mag rijden Diverse doorgroei- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden Een leuke en afwisselende baan in een energiek team met leuke collega’s Wat ga je doen? Als teamleider projecten zorg je ervoor dat onder jouw leiderschap de projecten binnen de gestelde tijdsplanning, budgetten en kwaliteitseisen en met een optimaal resultaat en tevreden klant worden gerealiseerd. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het leidinggeven aan meerdere projectteams en begeleiden en coachen van de medewerkers in deze teams Het jaarlijks opstellen van het afdelingsplan en/of meerjarenplan en realiseren van de afgesproken doelstellingen Het onderdeel uitmaken van het MT+ team en bijdragen aan het beleidsplan Het bewaken en rapporteren over de kwaliteit, capaciteit en voortgang van de projecten en de bijbehorende budgetten Het zorgen dat de directeur projecten inzicht houdt in de financiële en operationele stand van zaken en mogelijke risicofactoren Je bent als teamleider projecten eindverantwoordelijk voor het team. Met jouw leiderschapsstijl weet je mensen te motiveren het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wat neem je mee? Naast jouw enthousiasme en motivatie, breng je voor de vacature teamleider projecten het volgende mee: MBO niveau 4 elektrotechniek of HBO werk- en denkniveau Minstens 5 jaar ervaring als projectleider in de elektrotechniek binnen de utiliteit Ruime ervaring in projectbewaking en calculatie van renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten Aantoonbare leidinggevende ervaring en ervaring in relatiebeheer Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift Je kunt een verklaring omtrent gedrag en betrouwbaarheid afgeven Over SDR Bij ons krijg je energie van je werk. Werk aan slimme, duurzame installaties op bijzondere projecten in en rond Amsterdam. Bij SDR ken je je collega’s écht. Geen nummers, maar namen. VDK Installatiegroep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland! Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (110 bedrijven, 5.000 medewerkers), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en top secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken bij het lokale bedrijf. #LI-CK1 Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stagiair
description: Let op: stageplekken voor de functie van stagiair in de uitvoering zijn populair. Vanaf het nieuwe schooljaar verwachten wij meer duidelijkheid te hebben over de beschikbare stageplekken voor schooljaar 2026/2027. Leerlingen die in de tussentijd toch solliciteren, worden op de wachtlijst geplaatst. We willen hierbij wel aangeven dat we op dit moment geen stageplek kunnen garanderen. Ben jij op zoek naar een stage in elektrotechniek waar je écht meedraait en iets leert? Bij ons Amsterdamse familiebedrijf werk je mee aan projecten in de bouw en installatietechniek en ontdek je waar jouw interesses en talenten liggen. Geen onbelangrijke klusjes, maar werkzaamheden die passen bij jouw opleiding en niveau. Je krijgt een vaste begeleider die jou stap voor stap helpt en je laat zien hoe het vak in de praktijk werkt. Zo leer je snel en werk je meteen mee aan mooie projecten in en rondom Amsterdam, zoals utiliteitsgebouwen en hotels. Wat wij je bieden Een stage waarin je écht meedoet en leert Werkzaamheden die aansluiten bij je opleiding en leerdoelen Goede begeleiding van een ervaren mentor Een veilige en prettige werkomgeving in een Amsterdams familiebedrijf Een stagevergoeding Kans op een BBL-plek of vaste baan na je stage Een leuke en afwisselende ervaring in een energiek team met fijne collega’s (medewerkerstevredenheid: 8,1) Wat ga je doen? We stemmen je stage af op jouw opleiding, niveau en leerdoelen. Je werkt mee aan echte projecten en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen binnen de elektrotechniek. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Meewerken aan echte elektrotechnische projecten in en rondom Amsterdam Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden die aansluiten bij je opleiding en stage-opdrachten Kennis uit school toepassen in de praktijk Samenwerken met ervaren collega’s en leren van hun ervaring Begeleiding krijgen van een vaste stagebegeleider die jou helpt om te groeien Naarmate je verder komt, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandig werk Wat neem je mee? Je volgt een opleiding in elektrotechniek (MBO 1, 2, 3 of 4) Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om het vak te leren Je bent betrouwbaar en komt afspraken na Je werkt graag samen en staat open voor nieuwe ervaringen Je communiceert duidelijk met collega’s en spreekt goed Nederlands Welkom in ons team We zijn een gek bedrijf in een gekke wereld. Daar moet je wel tegen kunnen… Dat vraagt om ambitie, creativiteit, inzet en openheid. We stellen hoge eisen aan kwaliteit en teamwork. Daar zijn we professionals voor. Specialisten. Natuurlijk maken we fouten. Maar we schuiven niets onder het tapijt. We lossen ze op. En we gaan niet naar huis voordat we met z’n allen de klus geklaard hebben. Wat je daarvoor terugkrijgt? Een goed salaris en volop kansen om het vak te leren, je kennis te vergroten of je loopbaan een boost te geven. De sfeer op kantoor en bij de uitvoering is meer dan goed, je staat er nooit alleen voor. En je krijgt de kans om te werken aan spannende projecten op bijzondere locaties. Bij SDR is het nooit saai! #LI-CK1 Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Junior Accountmanager Software
description: Wil jij jouw commerciële carrière een vliegende start geven en energie halen uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten? Bij ITIS Products in Barendrecht krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot succesvol softwareaccountmanager. Je richt je voornamelijk op new business , leert alles over onze innovatieve softwareoplossingen en bouwt stap voor stap aan jouw eigen klantenportefeuille. Ervaring met softwareverkoop is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw commerciële drive en enthousiasme zijn voor ons veel belangrijker. Wat ga je doen? Als Junior Accountmanager Software ligt jouw focus op het creëren van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten, legt de eerste contacten en laat organisaties kennismaken met de softwareoplossingen van ITIS Products. Je krijgt hierbij de begeleiding van ervaren collega's, zodat je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandig accountmanager. Je adviseert organisaties over SOFOS 360 , onze software voor het registreren en beheren van gevaarlijke stoffen. Daarnaast werk je met Chemwatch , een internationaal toonaangevende softwareoplossing waarvoor ITIS Products exclusief partner is binnen de Benelux. title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines , across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency. To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment. What you will do Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions Contribute to simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements. Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students. System Integration Integrate learned components into a larger software stack Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components What we’re looking for We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply. Core qualifications 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position. Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo) Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries Proficiency in C++ Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. Great-to-Have Skills & Experience Experience with hydraulic machinery Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning Research experience in reinforcement learning Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units) Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms Experience with data curation for ML applications Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools. This Role is a Great Fit If You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry. You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements. You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments. You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage. You value a collaborative team culture rooted in thoughtful design, creative thinking, mutual respect, and pragmatism. Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic and versatile team, and to be part of a young startup that will revolutionize heavy construction. Gravis Robotics offers a fair market salary and a working location in the vibrant city of Zurich. As a forward-facing startup, we understand that work-life balance and flexibility are important considerations for many professionals: If you are a highly qualified candidate with the requisite skills and experience, we encourage you to apply and discuss your preferred working arrangement during the interview process. Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We are an international team that is working to solve problems with a global impact: to facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles. title: Chief Operating Officer COO
description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we’re looking for We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers. Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs. What you will do: Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028 Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel Who you are: A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale – ideally in a leadership position at a 500+ FTE organisation Highly structured and analytically strong; data-fluent and comfortable making complex decisions in ambiguous situations A proven track record of driving efficiency through continuous improvement, ideally in an online travel marketplace or accommodation distribution organisation A pragmatic, flexible problem solver who fits operations to business needs rather than following frameworks or 'what we've done before' Someone who simplifies for others, builds strong relationships and can hold critical lines Experienced working in founder-led organisations and stepping into new, previously unowned areas Travel industry experience is a big plus (especially flights / packages); B2C experience preferred, B2B welcome Experience collaborating with enterprise partners is a real plus Why join us now? We’re one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features. In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand. The mobile applications ( iOS and Android ) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews. We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else. We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees. What we offer: Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency. A great compensation package, perks, and benefits – including significant stock appreciation rights. Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely. You’ll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden. We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad. A budget for your home office Access to free mental health support via OpenUp We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Trading Infrastructure | Python/Linux
description: BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam. Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock. In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads. About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust. What will you do? You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back. You will: Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one. Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on. Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk. Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves. Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments. Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does. Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark. Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start. What we're looking for You'll need: 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role. At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders. A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter. A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike. Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level. Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture. Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar). Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services. Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana. Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure. Bonus points for: Experience with options or crypto markets. Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs). Low-latency or market-making environments. Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it. Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling. Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency. Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases. Pay, location, and relocation Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results. Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund. Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa. Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling. What else is in it for you Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day How we work We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. title: Engineering Manager
description: <p>We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.</p> <p>With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.</p> <p>As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.</p> <p>We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.</p> <p><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></p> <p>At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your role</strong></p> <p>In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery</strong>: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. </li> <li><strong>Direction</strong>: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.</li> <li><strong>Talent</strong>: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.</li> <li><strong>Culture</strong>: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.</li> <li><strong>Craft</strong>: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.</li> <li><strong>AI-first engineering</strong>: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.</li> <li>Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.</li> <li>Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.</li> <li>Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!</li> <li>Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).</li> <li>Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!</li> <li>1,000 EUR personal development budget.</li> <li>Complete coverage for commuting.</li> <li>Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.</li> <li>Gym membership discount with Wellhub.</li> <li>Dutch/English classes budget.</li> <li>Variable pension scheme.</li> <li>Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).</li> <li>Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. </li> <li>Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Balance conversion goals with responsible communication of risk and cost to the customer. Who You Are 4+ years of experience in product design, with ownership of complex, multi-step user flows. Hands-on experience designing native mobile app products (iOS/Android), you should be comfortable with mobile-specific interaction patterns and constraints (touch, limited screen space, performance, offline states) Experience designing platforms with multiple states, permissions, edge cases, and dependencies. Comfortable using research, data, and business context to defend design decisions in cross-functional squads. Fluent professional English Nice to Have Fintech, SaaS, or other regulated/complex-industry experience (not required — a plus). Prior experience with lending, payments, or KYC/compliance flows. title: Systems Engineer - Network Data Plane Software
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, </strong></p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves.</p> <p>Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum).</p> <p>We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>We're looking for engineers who want to build the software that forwards, filters, and load-balances packets for a meaningful fraction of the internet. If you've worked on routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, or SDN data planes, and you'd like to do that in software, at Cloudflare's scale, this is the role.</p> <p>We're moving towards a unified data plane platform that all of our L3/L4 products share. Instead of each product having its own data path, with its own configuration, performance work, and failure modes, we build a feature once and every product gets it.</p> <p>Some of the things you'd work on:</p> <ul> <li>The shared platform: packet I/O, a graph of processing stages, per-core steering, per-customer isolation, and upgrades that don't drop traffic</li> <li>A userspace forwarding plane that gives each customer their own routing and forwarding, with traffic arriving and leaving over tunnels (GRE, IPsec) and direct connections</li> <li>A stateful packet firewall written in Rust: rule evaluation, rate limiting, intrusion detection, packet capture, and dual-stack IPv4/IPv6</li> <li>An XDP-based L4 load balancer that touches nearly every connection into Cloudflare and forwards packets between servers and between data centers</li> <li>A fast path that uses XDP and eBPF to forward very large single flows at multiple Gbps</li> <li>Host networking: classifying each packet once and using that result everywhere on the server, instead of separate configs that can disagree</li> <li>Chasing down packet drops, latency, and throughput problems across a fleet of servers in hundreds of cities</li> </ul> <p>We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from XDP and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines and the control planes that configure them.</p> <p>You'll build, deploy, and operate these systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. You'll partner with some of the best engineers and product managers, on our team and across Cloudflare, to solve big problems that have a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and users.</p> <p>We're looking for curious, empathetic engineers who are excited to join us in changing the way networking is done!</p> <h2>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</h2> <ul> <li>Systems programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++</li> <li>A solid understanding of L3 and L4 networking: IP, TCP, UDP, routing and forwarding, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT, connection tracking, and anycast</li> <li>Experience building data plane software: routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN gateways, or SDN/NFV systems</li> <li>Linux networking: eBPF/XDP, tc, netfilter/nftables, network namespaces, sockets, etc.</li> <li>High-performance packet processing in user space or the kernel (e.g., AF_XDP, DPDK, VPP)</li> <li>Debugging, profiling, and optimizing systems where throughput and latency matter</li> <li>Building and operating large-scale, reliable, distributed systems</li> <li>Operating what you build: on-call, incident response, and root cause analysis</li> <li>Reading unfamiliar code and safely evolving systems that have been in production for years</li> <li>Owning work end to end, from design through deployment, and working across teams to land shared solutions</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication; we design in written specs and review each other's work</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus points</h2> <ul> <li>Router, switch, or network OS development (e.g., at a network equipment vendor or cloud provider)</li> <li>Network firewalls, IDS/IPS (e.g., Suricata, Snort), or rate limiting</li> <li>L4 load balancing (e.g., Maglev-style consistent hashing, Katran, IPVS)</li> <li>Running large networks: ISPs, data center networks, or backbone operations</li> <li>Contributions to open-source networking projects (e.g., the Linux kernel, DPDK, VPP, FRR)</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,1,0">For Champaign IL based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $210,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,2,0">For Washington, DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $230,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,3,0">For Seattle, WA based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $230,000.</p> </li> </ul> <ul data-path-to-node="4"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - 83,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="5"><strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="6"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="7"><strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="0">Benefits</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="8"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,0,0">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,0">Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,1,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,0,0">Medical/Rx Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,1,0">Dental Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,2,0">Vision Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,3,0">Flexible Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,4,0">Commuter Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,5,0">Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,6,0">On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,7,0">Global Travel Medical Insurance</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,0">Financial Benefits</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,2,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,0,0">Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,1,0">Life & Accident Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,2,0">401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,3,0">Employee Stock Participation Plan</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,0">Time Off</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,3,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,1,0,0">Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,1,1,0">Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</

Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Denver CO, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, </strong></p> <p><em>Location (all hybrid): Austin, TX; Champaign, IL; Seattle, WA; Atlanta, GA; Washington, DC; London, UK; Lisbon, PT</em></p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.</li> <li value="8">Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Adoption has grown 4–6x in the last year. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
