Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:</strong></p> <ul> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a visionary, hands-on storyteller to reinvent how Cloudflare brings customer impact to life. This person will combine the narrative instincts of an exceptional writer and editor, the technical fluency of a product marketer, the relationship skills of a customer advocate, and the creative eye of a producer. You'll interview customers and their executives, find out what was at stake for them, and explain what they built on Cloudflare in language a CFO and a developer can both follow.</p> <p>We welcome ideas no one has tried yet. You'll own the creative standard for video and content. You will raise the creative and production bar across video, case studies, campaigns, executive content, and onstage moments, helping make Cloudflare more relatable without sacrificing technical credibility. You will also build repeatable, AI-enabled workflows that enable us to discover, produce, and amplify distinctive customer stories at scale.</p> <p><strong>Role responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Interview customers and find the story: </strong>Work directly with customers and their executives to learn what problem they had and what changed after they solved it. </li> <li><strong>Explain the technology in simple terms: </strong>Turn topics like Zero Trust or Workers AI into stories that business and technical readers can both follow, and keep the technical details right.</li> <li><strong>Lead a few big moments each year:</strong> Own a few major storytelling projects a year, such as a film, a campaign, or a customer segment in a Cloudflare Connect keynote.</li> <li><strong>Come up with ideas that get noticed: </strong>Pitch creative concepts that make people stop scrolling, such as a surprising angle or a format no one else has tried.</li> <li><strong>Try new formats:</strong> Pilot formats beyond the case study, such as documentary-style series, live builds, short social video, interactive data stories, customer takeovers, and podcasts.</li> <li><strong>Set the quality standard: </strong>Decide what good looks like for customer stories in every format, and hold agencies, freelancers, and internal teams to it.</li> <li><strong>Supply executives with stories:</strong> Give Cloudflare leaders the customer stories and proof points they use in keynotes, briefings, social posts, and customer meetings.</li> <li><strong>Work across teams to get stories approved: </strong>Source stories with Sales and Product, and work with Marketing, Communications, and Legal to get approvals.</li> <li><strong>Use AI to scale: </strong>Build repeatable AI workflows for spotting story candidates, preparing interviews, drafting, and cutting one story into versions for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Track results: </strong>Decide how we measure story impact (sales usage, pipeline influence, reach, advocate engagement) and use the numbers to choose what to make next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical fluency</strong>: You can read a product doc or architecture diagram and explain in plain language what a customer built and why it matters.</li> <li><strong>Reporter and editor instincts</strong>: You ask the follow-up question and find the detail other people missed. You can read a draft and say what's missing, and you write copy that works for a CISO and for a developer.</li> <li><strong>Creative judgment and taste</strong>: You can tell quickly whether a story will get attention or build credibility. You know good film, editorial, design, and social work when you see it, and you borrow ideas from outside tech, including media, sports, and entertainment.</li> <li><strong>Production experience</strong>: You've had some experience directing or producing customer video, documentary, podcast, or live content, and you can manage crews and agencies.</li> <li><strong>Executive presence and influence</strong>: You're comfortable interviewing a customer's C-suite and briefing a Cloudflare executive before a keynote. You can get Sales, Product, Marketing, Comms, IT, and Legal moving in the same direction, and you push back when a story isn't ready.</li> <li><strong>AI in your daily work: </strong>You already use AI tools for writing, research, interview prep, or production, and you can show us how.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10-15 years of experience </strong>in one or more of the following: Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Journalism, or Video Production. B2B technology experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.</li> <li><strong>Option to include customer stories</strong>, video, campaigns, or stage content you created or led, with a short note on what made each one work. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Hybrid - </strong><strong>London, United Kingdom or Amsterdam, Netherlands</strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, and Customer Success - all working together to help our customers adopt Cloudflare and build great Internet-enabled experiences. exceptional sales growth by meeting and exceeding assigned quarterly and annual quotas</li> <li>Manage, coach, and develop your team of Account Executives</li> <li>Provide day-to-day deal support and functional guidance to AEs</li> <li>Source, interview, and recruit top sales talents in coordination with recruiting and sales leaders</li> <li>Own and drive accurate and up-to-date AE KPI, reporting related connections and relationships</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce and other sales reporting and BI tools</li> <li>Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment</li> <li>Capacity to strive in a diverse and multicultural workplace</li> <li>Aptitude to learn new technical concepts and terms</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required in a related field (Computer engineering, computer science or similar studies). We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.</p> <p><strong>Telemetry Export</strong> delivers Cloudflare's data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). Customers want OTLP for the rest of Cloudflare's data, metrics pushed to their own tools, and a way to send us telemetry from workloads that run elsewhere.</p> <p><strong>Your mission is to make reliability and security something customers rarely have to worry about, with the data they need in Cloudflare or in the tools they already use.</strong></p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Talk with customers every day and deeply understand their needs. You use it to prototype ideas and dig through data, and you have a view on how agents will produce telemetry and act on it.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You've relied on observability yourself, on call during an outage or in a security investigation, and you know where today's tools fall short.</li> <li>You've run or built on telemetry pipelines such as the OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector, Fluent Bit, or Kafka, or you've ingested someone else's data at scale at a vendor.</li> <li>You notice friction, like a confusing error message or a query that takes too many steps, and you fix it.</li> <li>You've priced a usage-based product, and you know what happens when existing customers start paying for something that used to be included.</li> <li>You're comfortable with enterprise customers, whether you're talking about compliance with a security team or OTLP with a platform engineer.</li> <li>You write clearly enough to get teams across Cloudflare to agree on a plan, and you can translate between what customers need and what engineering builds.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Colorado</strong> based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div title: Release Engineer, Salesforce
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification.</li> <li>Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability.</li> <li>Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation.</li> <li>Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora, </strong>and other <strong>Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.</li> <li>Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.</li> <li>Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.</li> <li>Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.</li> <li>Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.</li> <li>Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.</li> <li>Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices.</li> <li>Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness.</li> <li>Collaborate with security, compliance, architecture, and enterprise application stakeholders to meet control requirements without creating unnecessary delivery friction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline.</li> <li>Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines in production environments.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation and integrations.</li> <li>Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work.</li> <li>Experience with source control, branching and merging strategies, artifact management, automated testing, deployment orchestration, and rollback practices.</li> <li>Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication patterns, and integration troubleshooting.</li> <li>Experience managing releases across multiple environments with strong attention to configuration, dependencies, access controls, and auditability.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, integration defects, and environment inconsistencies.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, business, security, compliance, and operations teams.</li> <li>Enterprise application releases become more predictable, repeatable, and transparent.</li> <li>Manual deployment effort and avoidable release errors decrease through automation and standardization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>ETA teams adopt reusable GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD patterns for Salesforce, Zuora, and other enterprise platforms.Release quality improves through automated validation, testing, policy checks, and post-deployment verification. Deployment, change, and compliance evidence is available through reliable pipeline records and operational reporting. Application teams can move faster while maintaining appropriate controls for business-critical systems. AI-assisted DevOps adoption measurably improves engineering throughput, troubleshooting speed, automation coverage, and documentation quality without reducing delivery controls.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. marts, including data modeling, partitioning, and schema evolution.</li> <li>Strong Python for data engineering, including testing and maintainable, well-structured code.</li> <li>Strong SQL, the ability to turn ambiguous requirements from researchers and analysts into well-defined data products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with security, threat stores, training datasets).</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, R2, R2 Data Catalog).</li> <li>Trino/Presto or other distributed query engines.</li> <li>Experience using title: Engineering Manager - Developer Tools (Starcraft)
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are hiring a <strong>software engineering manager</strong> with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds <a href="https://snapcraft.io" target="_blank">snaps</a>, <a href="https://juju.is/docs/sdk/charmed-operators">charms</a> and more recently, rocks (<a href="https://opencontainers.org/about/overview/">OCI images</a>).</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://github.com/snapcore/snapcraft" target="_blank">Snapcraft</a> allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognized names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Likewise, <a href="https://github.com/canonical/charmcraft" target="_blank">Charmcraft</a> enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on<a href="https://charmhub.io/"> Charmhub</a>, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This Engineering Management role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for developer experience to build a career with Canonical and drive the success of the business. If you have an affinity for open source development, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</span></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role, we are considering candidates in AMER time zones.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Leading your team to elevate the Linux developer experience.</li> <li>Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews.</li> <li>Being responsible for planning, estimation and execution.</li> <li>Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Building and leading a distributed regional team of engineers.</li> <li>Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands-on career development.</li> <li>Designing, embracing, and evangelizing great engineering and organizational practices.</li> <li>Being an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization.</li> <li>Engaging with the wider open source community for feedback and collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li>Knowledge of modern high-level languages (Python, Go) as well as containerization technologies and primitives (Snaps, Docker, etc.).</li> <li>Experience in the design and architecture of command-line and server-side applications</li> <li>Software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.</li> <li>Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.</li> <li>A passion for technology and a drive to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.</li> <li>A track record of open source leadership and collaboration.</li> <li>Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.</li> <li>A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. These are companies where the developers <em>are</em> the decision makers, and where the CTO is often personally responsible for shipping new products and getting the company's AI initiatives off the ground. This role is for a technologist who genuinely enjoys being in the room with builders. You'll be equally comfortable jumping into a Slack channel with a founding engineer, whiteboarding an architecture with a lead developer, and stepping into a strategic conversation with a CTO about their platform and AI roadmap. You speak the language of engineers fluently and can hold a credible, detailed technical conversation — but this is <strong>not</strong> a software developer role, and you won't be writing production code every day. Your superpower is technical discovery, translation, and evangelism: understanding what a builder is trying to accomplish, mapping it to the full breadth of the Cloudflare Developer Platform, and inspiring teams to build on Cloudflare rather than just consume a single service.</p> <p style="line-height: 2;"><br>The Digital Native segment leans heavily on Solutions Engineering to lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical. You'll be expected to go deep on the Cloudflare Developer Platform — Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, Pages, and the broader developer ecosystem — far beyond basic storage, and to make the case for Cloudflare as <em>the</em> place to build. This role covers both the acquisition of new Digital Native accounts and the expansion of existing ones. The ideal candidate is a "builder" personality with a strong mix of pre-sales/technical customer-facing experience who thrives in an agile, fast-moving environment.<br>What you'll do as a Senior Solutions Engineer</p> <p style="line-height: 2;"><br>The Pre-Sales Solution Engineering organization owns the technical sales of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. Solution Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds including but not limited to Sales Consultants, Technical Consultants, Technical Support and Program Managers. You are a customer-facing technologist within the Cloudflare Solutions Engineering team, focused on the developer-first, digital-native segment. You have experience in a pre-sales or other technical customer-facing role, and you're at your best when engaging directly with engineering teams and technical founders. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin Texas or New York</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong><br>We are currently seeking a highly skilled and adaptable Floating Administrative Assistant to join our team. This individual will provide comprehensive backup administrative support to executives across various organizations as needed. continuity, and provide invaluable assistance across diverse functions.<br><strong><br>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Seamless Coverage:</strong> Provide comprehensive backup coverage.</li> <li><strong>Confidentiality:</strong> Handle highly sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion and professionalism at all times.</li> </ul> <p>Requirements</p> By proactively identifying security gaps, single points of failure, and performance bottlenecks, you will prevent incidents before they impact production. </p> <p>Working closely with Account Teams, Product, Engineering, and partnering with Customer Support, you will align technical solutions with customer roadmaps and business objectives. Services, you will focus on optimizing customer Cloudflare configurations, ensuring the reliability and security of their network infrastructure.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> Technical Risk & Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, and emerging security threats, while prioritizing remediation paths with customer stakeholders. </li> <li>Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, and deep-dive analysis of top ticket drivers, as well reviewing future-state resilience, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption. </li> <li>Act as a point of escalation during business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones.</li> <li>Partner with the account proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities (Zero-Days, emerging DDoS vectors), ensuring defensive configurations are deployed ahead of potential exploits. </li> <li>Ensure timely resolution of support tickets, working with backend teams as needed.</li> <li>Establish continuous drift-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations don't deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds. </li> <li>Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements.</li> <li>Ability to work one weekend per month.</li> <li>Utilize AI-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and providing strategic infrastructure optimization recommendations.</li> <li>Streamline the creation of technical documentation—including HLDs, LLDs, and post-incident reports—by leveraging AI workflows to ingest and summarize technical data, ensuring consistent, high-quality deliverables.</li> <li>Deploy AI-assisted incident management tools to enhance communication precision, including real-time impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and handle multiple priorities.</li> </ul> <p>This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare’s Enterprise customer experience, helping businesses optimize their network performance and security while shaping the future of our products.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.</p> <p>You’ll also help govern and enforce Cloudflare’s Engineering Codex by turning engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and actionable feedback.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p>- Build developer productivity tools, MCP servers, and AI agents.</p> <p>- Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code.</p> <p>- Monitor Codex adoption, improve controls, and support remediation and exception workflows.</p> <p>- Improve GitOps, developer experience, platform security, and reliability.</p> <p>- Partner with product teams on architecture and platform adoption.</p> <p>- Respond to and prevent incidents affecting internal platforms.</p> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <p>- Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Bash.</p> <p>- Strong debugging and source-control skills.</p> <p>- Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, or developer platforms.</p> <p>- Ability to break down complex problems and evaluate trade-offs.</p> <p>- Clear communication and a strong focus on developer experience.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>- Experience with AI agents, MCP, evals, or LLM-based tooling.</p> <p>- Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> <p>- Background in platform engineering or developer productivity.</p> <p>- Experience operating distributed or Kubernetes-based systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York, NY, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on-target incentive pay) for this role is $360,000 - $400,000 per year. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll turn raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic decisions across GitLab's global Support Engineering organization. You'll design dashboards, reports, and data models that help leaders monitor performance, optimize costs, and improve customer outcomes. You'll also promote data innovation by experimenting thoughtfully and working through complex problems.<br><br><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own annual operating plan and capacity that identify product areas and customers using the most support resources.</li> <li>Lead dashboarding for AI adoption and return on investment, measuring the business impact of AI-driven initiatives across Support Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with go-to-market teams on predictive analytics and churn-prevention models that identify at-risk customers.</li> <li>Define and refine unified customer-schema requirements to create consistent data across systems and a single source of truth.</li> <li>Deliver Monthly Business Review telemetry, executive-ready reporting packages, recurring operational reports, and ad hoc analysis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence analyst, analytics engineer, or in a similar data role, ideally in a software as a service or technology company.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Technical Support, Business Operations, Product Engineering, or similar organizations.</li> <li>Fluency in SQL, including complex multi-table joins, grouping and aggregation, common table expressions, and conditional filters.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Zendesk Explore, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence tools.</li> <li>Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical frameworks.</li> <li>Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Plan and prioritize work independently in a remote, cross-functional environment across time zones.</li> <li>You may also bring experience with large language model-based tools, artificial intelligence and machine learning workflows, durable data solutions, analytics frameworks, in-depth data analysis, or presenting to senior leaders and executives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>Our Support Engineering organization uses data to understand performance, improve customer outcomes, and improve operational practices. You'll partner across Support Engineering, go-to-market teams, Business Operations, and Product Engineering in an all-remote environment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Senior Named Account Executive, Central Eastern Europe - Digital Natives
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Fluency in English and one of the languages from the CEE (written and spoken). </strong></li> <li><strong>6+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions into Digital Natives companies across Central CEE</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong coaching and mentorship abilities</strong>, with a passion for title: Security Research Analyst, WAF Managed Rules
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City </p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Our team researches web application attacks and turns that research into protections in Cloudflare’s Web Application Firewall (WAF). We build and maintain managed rules that help protect millions of Internet properties from known vulnerabilities, emerging exploits, and new attack techniques.</p> <p>We work at the intersection of vulnerability research, large-scale traffic analysis, and detection engineering. Using threat intelligence and telemetry from Cloudflare’s global network, we identify exploitation patterns, develop mitigations, and measure how well they work against real traffic. We partner with Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to improve coverage while minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate applications.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have hands-on experience in web application security, vulnerability research, or detection engineering, including writing and improving WAF rules, exploit signatures, or comparable detection logic.</li> <li>You understand HTTP/HTTPS, how web applications and proxies process requests, and common vulnerability classes such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, remote code execution, SSRF, and insecure deserialization.</li> <li>You can analyze a vulnerability advisory or proof of concept, reproduce the exploit in a controlled environment, and identify the request characteristics that distinguish exploitation from legitimate traffic.</li> <li>You use SQL to investigate large datasets and a language such as Python, Go, or Rust to build research tools, automate analysis, and validate detections.</li> <li>You make evidence-based tradeoffs between detection coverage, false positives, and performance. You are comfortable investigating ambiguous reports and following issues through to resolution.</li> <li>You work effectively with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing teams, and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in research and coding workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where its outputs need independent validation.</li> <li>You are curious about how attackers exploit web applications and bypass defenses. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for a Security Research Analyst to research web application threats and develop the managed rules that protect Cloudflare customers. You will turn public CVEs, threat intelligence, customer reports, and internal telemetry into tested, effective mitigations.</p> <p>Your work will span the detection lifecycle: understanding an exploit, designing a rule, validating it against malicious and legitimate requests, and measuring its behavior in production. You will collaborate with engineering and research partners to close coverage gaps and continuously improve the quality of our WAF protections.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities:</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research vulnerabilities and exploitation.</strong> Analyze public CVEs, proof-of-concept exploits, and observed attacks to understand root causes, exploit chains, and opportunities for WAF mitigation.</li> <li><strong>Develop and maintain managed rules.</strong> Design, test, and deploy WAF managed rules and exploit signatures, keeping protections effective as applications, exploits, and attacker techniques evolve.</li> <li><strong>Investigate false positives and missed attacks.</strong> Analyze customer reports and request telemetry, reproduce issues, and refine detections to improve protection without unnecessarily blocking legitimate traffic.</li> <li><strong>Validate coverage and resistance to bypasses.</strong> Use targeted penetration testing, exploit variants, and adversarial testing to identify detection gaps and evaluate proposed mitigations.</li> <li><strong>Automate research and validation.</strong> Build tools and reproducible test cases that accelerate exploit analysis, rule validation, regression testing, and traffic analysis.</li> <li><strong>Measure detection quality.</strong> Use SQL, dashboards, and production data to assess rule efficacy, track attack trends, and guide improvements to coverage, false-positive rates, and performance.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across teams.</strong> Partner with Engineering, Product, and other detection teams to deliver reliable protections and resolve recurring customer problems at their roots.</li> <li><strong>Share actionable research.</strong> Document findings, explain mitigation decisions, and contribute to internal research reports and public-facing blogs on vulnerabilities and Internet-wide attack trends.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing WAF rules or contributing to open-source WAF projects, such as ModSecurity or the OWASP Core Rule Set.</li> <li>Experience finding WAF bypasses, analyzing request parsing and encoding differences, or researching novel exploitation techniques.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale security analytics, advanced SQL, columnar databases such as ClickHouse, and visualization tools such as Grafana.</li> <li>Experience building automated exploit-reproduction environments, detection test suites, or CI pipelines for security rules.</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux/UNIX systems, TCP/IP networking, reverse proxies, and the performance constraints of inspecting production traffic.</li> <li>Published security research, conference presentations, open-source security tools, or demonstrated work through bug bounty programs or CTFs.</li> <li>Experience partnering with data science or machine learning teams to combine rule-based detections with other security signals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $216,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re title: Director, Growth Sales (AI & Digital Natives)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: San Francisco Bay Area </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an entrepreneurial Sales Director to lead our DN/AI Growth Segment, focusing on both the acquisition and expansion of our fastest-growing Startup accounts. In this role, you will scale a high-performing team tasked with bringing the world’s most innovative AI companies onto Cloudflare's platform.</p> <p>To thrive, you must bring a founder mentality and deep familiarity with the VC ecosystem to capture high-growth startups at inception. You possess a sharp understanding of the dynamics of the hyperscaler market and the AI landscape, allowing you to position Cloudflare as the definitive infrastructure layer for modern workloads. Finally, you are highly familiar with PLG sales motions, knowing exactly how to identify high-potential, self-serve developer accounts and seamlessly transition them into enterprise expansions.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and exceed quarterly revenue targets, driving both high-velocity new logo acquisition and strategic account expansion within the AI and startup ecosystem.</li> <li>Recruit, coach, and develop a world-class sales team, instilling a high-tempo, execution-oriented culture tailored to technical buyers.</li> <li>Effectively articulate Cloudflare’s value proposition across our connectivity cloud, including Workers AI, R2 storage, network security, and developer platforms.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Growth, and Marketing to seamlessly convert self-serve developer usage into structured enterprise agreements.</li> <li>Act as a key executive sponsor for high-growth startups, founders, and VC partners, positioning Cloudflare as the foundational architecture for the next generation of tech.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You might be a good fit if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in enterprise software sales with at least 3+ leading sales teams</li> <li>A proven track record of leading high-performing sales teams in the cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or developer platform space.</li> <li>A strong understanding of modern application architecture, serverless computing, and how AI startups utilize compute and data storage.</li> <li>Active connections within the tech startup and venture capital ecosystems, with an innate ability to spot and engage high-potential accounts early.</li> <li>Hands-on experience navigating hybrid sales models that blend product-led growth with top-down enterprise execution.</li> <li>A history of thriving in fast-paced, rapidly evolving markets where you can turn ambiguity into clear, actionable sales strategies</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $378,000 - $496,000 OTE.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>
