title: Principal, Developer Platform Positioning
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Developer Platform is the fastest growing set of products in Cloudflare. As part of our explosive growth, we are looking for a Principal, Platform Storytelling to shape how developers, technical leaders, and the broader AI ecosystem understand our platform, and why they should build on it.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, foundational individual contributor role within Developer GTM. You will connect individual products and technical breakthroughs into a compelling platform story, develop differentiated positioning, and bring that story to market through launches, executive voices, and content developers actually read. You will help articulate not just what we have shipped, but our point of view on where software development and AI infrastructure are going.</p> <p>The right person has the product depth of a technical PMM, the writing instincts of an exceptional editor, and an intuition for how developer products earn attention and trust. You can move from a conversation with an engineer to a positioning brief to a keynote opening, and make each one better because you understand the others. As an early member of this team, you will have the autonomy to experiment, learn what resonates, and establish repeatable ways to turn our product momentum into market momentum.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Platform Positioning & Narrative:</strong> Develop the overarching positioning for Cloudflare’s Developer Platform. Make it clear who we are for and why our products are better together.</li> <li><strong>Product Launches & Adoption:</strong> Partner with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations to bring priority capabilities to market. Shape positioning, launch narratives, and audience-specific content that connect technical capabilities to real developer needs. Build momentum beyond announcement day, helping developers move from interest to trying, adopting, and expanding their use of the platform.</li> <li><strong>Executive Storytelling:</strong> Be a strategic writing and narrative partner to Developer Platform leadership. Develop keynotes, presentations, essays, and other executive communications that express a distinctive, technically grounded point of view. Help leaders explain where the market is going, what we believe, and how our products themselves deliver on those beliefs.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Editorial Direction:</strong> Write and edit platform narratives, long form content, web copy, and other external content. Establish a consistent voice without making everything sound the same. Know when a story needs a technical explanation, a sharp argument, a compelling demo, or fewer words. Build credibility through substance.<br><strong>Sales & Partner Enablement:</strong> Translate platform positioning into compelling pitch narratives and competitive differentiation for field and partner teams. Partner with Customer Strategy & Storytelling to ground our claims in customer proof, and with enablement teams to make the strongest narratives repeatable.</li> <li><strong>Market & Developer Insights:</strong> Stay close to developers, customers, the field, and the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. Understand what people are building, where they get stuck, and how they evaluate alternatives. Turn those insights into messaging and recommendations that inform product and GTM strategy.</li> <li><strong>Impact & Measurement:</strong> Establish success measures to evaluate whether our work improves message comprehension, earns relevant developer engagement, supports cross-product activation and usage, and helps the field win.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <p><strong>First 30 days:</strong><strong><br></strong>Establish key relationships, use the products, consume an inordinate amount of content about our platform and the market, and listen to developers and field teams. You can explain where our story is compelling and where it breaks down. You’ve shipped your first meaningful piece of writing.</p> <p><strong>First 6 months:</strong><strong><br></strong>Establish a clear platform narrative and put it to work across priority launches, executive communications, and developer-facing channels. Product and GTM teams are using your positioning because it makes their work sharper. We are hitting a new level of clarity for the platform story that makes each product’s story stronger.</p> <p><strong>First year:</strong><strong><br></strong>Cloudflare’s Developer Platform has a more recognizable point of view and a clearer place in the developer and AI ecosystem. Our launches build on one another rather than telling disconnected product stories. Executive voices reinforce the same strategy without sounding scripted. Your work is measurably helping developers understand, choose, and build on the platform, and helping our field teams turn that interest into commercial impact.</p> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Product Marketing Experience:</strong> 8–10 years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or a related role, including meaningful ownership of positioning and adoption for developer-first products. You have an instinct for which value propositions we should lead with, for which audiences, and why. You have a demonstrated ability to turn a complex portfolio into a clear, differentiated platform story.</li> <li><strong>Technical Fluency:</strong> 5+ years working with developer tools, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML products. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable trying products, reading technical documentation, understanding architectural tradeoffs, and asking questions that earn engineers’ trust.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Editorial Excellence:</strong> Exceptional writing, editing, and presentation skills, with work that demonstrates range across technical, commercial, and executive audiences. Strong judgment about what to say and what to leave out.</li> <li><strong>Developer & AI Instincts:</strong> Curiosity about how software is being built and how AI is changing it. You naturally follow products, competitors, and developer conversations. An instinct for what will “hit” on Hacker News and X.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Builder:</strong> Proven ability to work cross-functionally without direct authority and to navigate ambiguity. A love of chaos and comfort doing unscalable things.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $164,000 - $200,000</li> <li>For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $190,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. customers ship, raising the quality of what they build, and surfacing real-world product insights back to Cloudflare's Product and Engineering teams.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Act as the hands-on technical build partner across a portfolio of strategic customers building on the Cloudflare platform, driving each engagement forward from idea to launch.</li> <li>Shape scalable, resilient architectures on Cloudflare and guide customers on the design decisions that matter — before they become bottlenecks.</li> <li>Hands-on development alongside customer teams to prototype, configure, samples, and technical guidance that customers can learn from, build on, and reuse.</li> <li>Support the full breadth of the Cloudflare platform when engaged — from Workers, storage (KV, R2, D1), and Durable Objects to AI (Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize), security, networking, and observability.</li> <li>Join Customer Engineering rituals — design reviews, planning sessions, and technical working sessions.</li> <li>Surface real-world edge cases, friction, and product gaps directly to Cloudflare's Product and Engineering teams to shape the product roadmap.</li> <li>Establish and maintain trusted technical relationships with customer engineers and technical leaders (Staff+ engineers, Directors, and VPs).</li> <li>Identify opportunities to accelerate the adoption of Cloudflare services, unlocking new capabilities across each customer's tech stack.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the EMEA region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management - Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. Comfortable framing analytical questions, iterating on prompts, and validating AI-generated outputs with sound business judgment and rigorous data checks, while handling sensitive information responsibly - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality. - Maintaining high ownership mentality, demonstrated by developing projects of >6-12 months length - Notion power user or desire to learn -- prior Notion experience is not required, but you have the ability and desire to become a pro Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Outcomes Architect Manager, MEDIT
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness. If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion. - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes. - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership. - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met. - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals. - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value. - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion. - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy. - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation. - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it. - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account. - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans. - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams. - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team. - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity. - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership. - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers. - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes. - Fluency in Italian or Spanish NICE TO HAVES - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes. - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management. - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership. - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path. - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model. - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Outcomes Architect, Nordics (Customer Success)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 3+ years experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working NICE TO HAVES: - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale. - Fluency in additional languages Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €94,000-€105,000per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. You’ll own GTM hiring end to end and help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization, recruiting for new and evolving customer-facing roles, including BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and field sales leadership, that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner closely with the Country Manager, Singapore, sales leadership, and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires. You’ll inherit a global recruiting playbook and develop the operating rhythm for the region. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have a track record of leading engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and supporting professional growth. Your past teams respect you as both a technical leader and a people manager.</li> <li>You have a strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and services.</li> <li>You have taken projects from inception to production and overseen execution to meet commitments in a fast-paced, iterative engineering environment.</li> <li>You connect business goals with technical decisions, explain both the "why" and the "how," and make thoughtful tradeoffs when requirements are uncertain.</li> <li>You work effectively across Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver shared outcomes.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and senior leadership, adapting the level of technical detail to your audience.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in engineering workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You are curious about web security, bot management, fraud and abuse, and the evolving role of AI agents on the Internet. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team building and scaling Cloudflare's products for bot management, fraud detection, and abuse mitigation. You will recruit, mentor, and grow talented engineers, provide technical leadership, and partner closely with Product Management to shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</p> <p>You will partner with detection and research teams to turn their signals into reliable, performant, and easy-to-use customer solutions. Our systems span real-time services running across Cloudflare's global network, APIs and configuration, and high-volume data and analytics pipelines. You will collaborate across engineering and product teams to bring new capabilities into production and continuously improve the customer experience.</p> <h3><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team.</strong> Hire, mentor, and empower engineers through clear feedback, thoughtful career development, and a culture of ownership and technical excellence.</li> <li><strong>Shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</strong> Partner with Product Management to translate customer problems into incremental deliverables, balancing new capabilities with reliability, performance, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership.</strong> Participate in design discussions and guide decisions about scalable distributed services, product integrations, APIs, and analytics.</li> <li><strong>Turn detection signals into customer capabilities.</strong> Partner with detection and research teams to deliver actionable analytics and configurable controls, helping customers balance security, user experience, and privacy.</li> <li><strong>Measure and improve customer outcomes.</strong> Work with Product and detection partners to use feedback and production data to improve effectiveness, reduce unnecessary friction, and make products easier to adopt.</li> <li><strong>Own operational health.</strong> Ensure your team's services have effective observability, safe releases, incident response, and follow-through on improvements.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-team execution.</strong> Resolve dependencies, align priorities across teams, and work with customer-facing partners to address recurring product problems at their roots.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building bot management, fraud detection, application security, or other products that make decisions in an adversarial environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with HTTP, browser technologies, JavaScript, and the tradeoffs between security, privacy, and user experience.</li> <li>Experience integrating machine learning models into production systems or partnering closely with data science and machine learning teams.</li> <li>Experience with high-volume data pipelines, analytics services, or columnar databases such as ClickHouse.</li> <li>Experience with technologies used in our systems, such as Go, Rust, Python, Kafka, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Washington D.C. & New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $261,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $170,000 - $233,000</span></li> </ul> <p>Applications will be accepted until November 30, 2026.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings title: Telco Cloud Field Engineer
location: Home Based - Americas; Home Based - APAC; Home based - EMEA
description: <p><strong>The role of a Telecommunications Field Engineer at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>As part of the Canonical Field Engineering organization, you will lead customers through the design and delivery of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and software-defined networking solutions. Your passion for open-source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G, sovereign AI, and beyond.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Remote-based, Americas and EMEA</span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What your day will look like</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Translate Service Provider requirements into practical telco cloud platform architectures, enabling VNF/CNF, NFV, and MEC workloads at scale</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Provide technical pre-sales consulting to Service Provider teams</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Design and implement telco-grade open source multi-tenant private clouds and micro clouds</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Investigate, report and/or fix software defects uncovered during customer deployments</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Demonstrate advanced Infrastructure as code (IaC) techniques relevant to telco</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Architect and implement advanced, resilient Service Provider Cloud and Application solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Design and deliver software defined infrastructure with OpenStack, Kubernetes, MAAS and Ceph</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Help customers adopt advanced Bare Metal, Public, Private and Hybrid Cloud solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Support customer tenant onboarding, participate in architectural and business capability discussions, and enable successful adoption and production readiness of customer use cases</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Learn from customer engagements and drive meaningful product improvements</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Shape our roadmap to accelerate our growth in the telco market</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco cloud infrastructure technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SR-IOV, DPDK, etc</li> <li>Familiarity with telco architecture and industry standards</li> <li>Working knowledge of at least <strong>one of the following domains</strong>: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS</li> <li>Working knowledge of Linux, Networking, OpenStack and Kubernetes</li> <li>Python software development experience for automation</li> <li>Ability to lead complex projects from start to finish</li> <li>A collaborative, customer-centric mindset with a strong focus on customer success</li> <li>Able to travel up to 25% of the time based on business requirements for events, customer meetings, project delivery</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Additional skills that you might also bring</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Second language such as Spanish, Portuguese or French</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Track record of open source contributions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including sovereign AI, and their potential applications in telco environments, such as network optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.</p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Parental Leave</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote </span></p>

title: Senior Treasury Capital Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰€100,000 - €130,000,  Incentive Awards tied to your performance➕ benefits </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a dynamic Treasury Capital Manager in Dublin to become a key part of the team building the new Monzo European entity. Reporting into the Director of Treasury and Capital, you will shape, develop and implement the Capital management process and infrastructure in tandem with supporting the growth and strategic development of the business. As well as skills and experience in Treasury and Capital Management, the ability to adapt, be creative and work in a fast paced environment with wider Group colleagues will be essential talents as the business grows.</p> <p>As part of a new and growing team, the Treasury Capital Manager will be responsible for ensuring that Monzo effectively manages its capital and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements in Europe. This is an opportunity to be part of something from the start and make a real difference.</p> <p><strong>🔑</strong><strong>You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the planning and production of Monzo Europe’s ICAAP in line with regulatory capital requirements.</li> <li>Develop capital plans and forecasts, including stress testing and scenario analysis.</li> <li>Lead the planning and implementation work in line with Monzo’s recovery and resolution requirements including the Recovery Plan and Solvent Wind Down Plan.</li> <li>Identify the impact of prudential regulatory change and supporting relevant teams to assess and adapt to the challenges.</li> <li>Optimise the capital structure and allocation to support growth and strategic objectives.</li> <li>Prepare and present regular financial reports and forecasts to senior management.</li> <li>Building strong relationships with internal teams such as the business/product collectives to optimize the bank's capital structure and funding strategies.</li> <li>Provide operational coverage for the Director of Treasury and Capital during holidays.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if you have…</strong></p> <ul> <li>A bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field. A Master’s degree or professional qualification (e.g., CFA, ACA, ACCA) is preferred.</li> <li>A minimum of 5 years of experience in Treasury Capital management, within the banking sector, a consultancy, or regulatory body.</li> <li>Have detailed knowledge/experience of the European regulatory requirements, and the ability to interpret what that means for the relatively unique circumstances of our bank.  </li> <li>Have the ability to coordinate, participate and lead projects to produce regulatory deliverables and maintain the Bank’s set of prudential documentation and supporting materials.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.</li> <li>Strong leadership abilities and experience in working across dispersed teams.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰A salary range of €100,000 - €130,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Data Center Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Austin, San Francisco or New York</strong></h3> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>Cloudflare is hiring a Data Center Architect to define and deliver the physical infrastructure behind high-density compute and GPU deployments across our global network. You'll own 3 connected domains: the liquid cooling chain, the low-voltage connectivity layer, and the MV/LV electrical architecture that powers both.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role spanning architecture, detailed design, technical qualification, design governance, commissioning, and operational readiness. You're Cloudflare's owner-side technical lead in these domains: the person who connects what our hardware needs with what colocation providers, equipment manufacturers, and delivery partners can actually build.</p> <p>Scope runs from a single rack in commercial colocation to multi-megawatt compute deployments. You'll design power, cooling, and cabling as one system so they don't fight each other at the rack, in the white space, or during maintenance.</p> <p>If your background is only HVAC design, only cold-plate research, or only utility-scale generation, this role will be wider than you expect. We need someone who can hold the electrical, cooling, and cabling layers together.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>We work with engineering, capacity planning, network strategy, supply chain, and operations to grow Cloudflare's data center and PoP footprint. With colocation providers, hardware suppliers, and delivery partners worldwide, we turn infrastructure requirements into deployments that come online faster, cost less, and work the first time.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <h4>Architecture and reference designs</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own the physical-infrastructure architecture.</strong> Build reference designs for power, liquid cooling, and connectivity for AI and high-density compute, including how they interface at rack, row, and site level. Maintain the standards, templates, and libraries that deployment, operations, and partner teams build from.</li> <li><strong>Translate hardware and capacity needs into engineering requirements.</strong> Turn heat loads, electrical loads, port counts, network topologies, and growth plans into power, cooling, and connectivity requirements and into site and rack qualification criteria.</li> <li><strong>Qualify sites and facility interfaces.</strong> Assess provider power and cooling availability, utility and backup capacity, water supply and return conditions, hydraulic capacity, upstream heat rejection, expansion headroom, maintenance constraints, and contractual boundaries. Give go/no-go recommendations with the risks written down.</li> </ul> <h3>Electrical power architecture (MV/LV)</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead MV and LV electrical architecture:</strong> single-line diagrams, power distribution, switchgear and UPS topology, busway and PDU design, grounding and bonding.</li> <li><strong>Design physical power infrastructure,</strong> AC and DC, including power conversion, backup generation, energy storage, and distribution, with attention to fault levels, selectivity, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Validate designs with modeling:</strong> load-flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, and selectivity studies, checked against measured performance where possible.</li> <li><strong>Define digital power requirements</strong> for monitoring, metering, protection coordination, and control. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>San Francisco, CA </li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare built its reputation helping build a better Internet, defending millions of sites, giving away SSL and DDoS mitigation when the industry charged premium prices. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p> <p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p> <p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p> <p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p> <p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p> <p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p> <p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Rapid response:</h3> <ul> <li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li> <li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li> </ul> <h3>Proactive engineering:</h3> <ul> <li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li> <li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li> <li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li> <li><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</li> <li><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</li> <li><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. title: Beijing Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>Beijing Office Administrators with excellent English</strong> to help take responsibility for the success of our Beijing office and hardware certification lab. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in Beijing.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>
